+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func Verify(ctx context.Context,req model.Request)(model.Result,error){return verify(ctx,req)}
+func verify(ctx context.Context,req model.Request)(model.Result,error){
+	s,e:=Current(req.Root,req.Change);if e!=nil{return model.Result{},e};r:=s.Snapshot.Root;c:=s.Change
+	result:=model.Result{State:s,Reports:map[string]checks.Report{}}
+	if s.Phase!="evals"&&s.Phase!="audit"&&s.Phase!="impl"{return result,coded("P01","unsupported phase %s",s.Phase)}
+	cl,_,e:=loadClaim(r,c);if e!=nil{return result,e};if h,_:=head(r);h!=cl.Base{return result,coded("P05","stale phase base: HEAD %s differs from %s",h,cl.Base)}
+	raw,e:=read(r,changePath(c));if e!=nil{return result,e};if e=unapprovedMetadata(raw,cl.Approved,cl.Phase);e!=nil{return result,e}
+	for _,d:=range project.Check(r){if !d.Warning&&strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message),"stale base"){return result,coded("P05","%s",d.Message)}}
+	if s.Phase=="audit"{normalized,block,e:=auditSubmission(s,raw);_ = normalized;_ = block;return result,e}
+	changes,e:=workChanges(r,cl.Base);if e!=nil{return result,e}
+	iface,_:=contracts.Section(c.Document.Body,"Interface")
+	if len(stringSlice(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"]))>0{
+		for _,ch:=range changes{if ch.Path==changePath(c){continue};allowed:=false;for _,m:=range s.Snapshot.Modules{if m.Name==c.Module&&strings.HasPrefix(ch.Path,m.Dir+"/"){z:=contracts.ResolveZone(strings.TrimPrefix(ch.Path,m.Dir+"/"),m.Zones);allowed=s.Phase=="evals"&&z=="evals"}}
+			if !allowed{return result,coded("Z01","eval_fix forbids %s during %s",ch.Path,s.Phase)}}
+	}else{ds:=checks.Zones(checks.ZoneRequest{Snapshot:s.Snapshot,Module:c.Module,Phase:s.Phase,ChangePath:changePath(c),Base:cl.Base,InterfaceDeclared:strings.TrimSpace(iface)!="",Changes:changes});result.Diagnostics=append(result.Diagnostics,ds...);for _,d:=range ds{if !d.Warning{return result,coded(d.Code,"%s",d.Message)}}}
+	mod:=moduleByName(s.Snapshot,c.Module);if mod==nil{return result,coded("C01","unknown module %s",c.Module)}
+	modules:=[]string{c.Module};if s.Phase=="impl"&&!req.Quick{mode:=configString(s.Snapshot,"verify_dependents");if mode==""{mode="direct"};for _,m:=range s.Snapshot.Modules{if m.Name==c.Module{continue};if mode=="all"&&dependsOn(s.Snapshot,m.Name,c.Module)||mode=="direct"&&contains(m.DependsOn,c.Module){modules=append(modules,m.Name)}}}
+	var firstErr error
+	for _,name:=range modules{
+		report,e:=checks.Evaluate(ctx,checks.HookRequest{Snapshot:s.Snapshot,Module:name,Bin:req.Bin,Timeout:req.Timeout});result.Reports[name]=report
+		if e!=nil&&firstErr==nil{firstErr=e}
+		m:=moduleByName(s.Snapshot,name);if m!=nil{specs:=moduleSpecs(*m);if name==c.Module{if ce:=checks.RequireCoverage(report,specs);ce!=nil&&firstErr==nil{firstErr=ce}}
+			if s.Phase=="evals"&&name==c.Module{ids:=changedIDs(c);if len(stringSlice(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"]))>0{ids=stringSlice(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"]);for _,id:=range ids{covered:=false;for _,tc:=range report.Cases{if contains(tc.IDs,id){covered=true}};if !covered&&firstErr==nil{firstErr=coded("E01","eval_fix missing testcase for %s",id)}};if ce:=checks.RequirePass(report,specs);ce!=nil&&firstErr==nil{firstErr=ce}}else if ce:=checks.RequireFailFirst(report,ids,stringSlice(c.Document.Frontmatter["already_satisfied"]));ce!=nil&&firstErr==nil{firstErr=ce}}
+			}else if s.Phase=="impl"{if ce:=checks.RequirePass(report,specs);ce!=nil&&firstErr==nil{firstErr=ce}}}
+		}
+	}
+	result.Costs=measureCosts(s,modules,result.Reports);result.Diagnostics=append(result.Diagnostics,budgetWarnings(s.Snapshot,result.Costs)...)
+	_ = saveCosts(r,model.CostSnapshot{Run:s.Run,Phase:s.Phase,RecordedAt:time.Now().UTC(),Modules:result.Costs,Diagnostics:budgetOnly(result.Diagnostics)})
+	if firstErr!=nil{return result,firstErr}
+	if s.Phase=="impl"&&!req.Quick{ds,e:=checks.Boundaries(ctx,checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot:s.Snapshot,Bin:req.Bin,Timeout:req.Timeout});result.Diagnostics=append(result.Diagnostics,ds...);if e!=nil{return result,e};for _,d:=range ds{if !d.Warning{return result,coded(d.Code,"%s",d.Message)}}}
+	return result,nil
+}
+func moduleByName(s project.Snapshot,name string)*project.Module{for i:=range s.Modules{if s.Modules[i].Name==name{return &s.Modules[i]}};return nil}
+func moduleSpecs(m project.Module)[]contracts.Item{s,_:=contracts.Section(m.Document.Body,"Specs");items,_:=contracts.ParseItems(s);return items}
+func changedIDs(c project.Change)[]string{ids:=[]string{};for _,x:=range append(append([]contracts.Item{},c.Added...),c.Modified...){ids=append(ids,x.ID)};ids=append(ids,stringSlice(c.Document.Frontmatter["fixes"])...);return ids}
+func contains(a []string,b string)bool{for _,x:=range a{if x==b{return true}};return false}
+func dependsOn(s project.Snapshot,a,b string)bool{seen:=map[string]bool{};var walk func(string)bool;walk=func(x string)bool{if seen[x]{return false};seen[x]=true;m:=moduleByName(s,x);if m==nil{return false};for _,dep:=range m.DependsOn{if dep==b||walk(dep){return true}};return false};return walk(a)}
+func workChanges(root,base string)([]gitstore.Change,error){
+	out,e:=command(root,"diff","--name-status",base,"--");if e!=nil{return nil,e};result:=[]gitstore.Change{};seen:=map[string]bool{};for _,line:=range strings.Split(out,"\n"){fields:=strings.Fields(line);if len(fields)<2{continue};p:=fields[len(fields)-1];result=append(result,gitstore.Change{Path:p,Status:fields[0]});seen[p]=true}
+	untracked,e:=command(root,"ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard");if e!=nil{return nil,e};for _,p:=range strings.Split(untracked,"\n"){if p!=""&&!seen[p]{result=append(result,gitstore.Change{Path:p,Status:"A"})}};return result,nil
+}
+func measureCosts(s model.State,modules []string,reports map[string]checks.Report)[]model.ModuleCost{
+	out:=[]model.ModuleCost{};for _,name:=range modules{m:=moduleByName(s.Snapshot,name);if m==nil{continue};cost:=model.ModuleCost{Module:name,CasesPerSpec:map[string]int{}};for _,tc:=range reports[name].Cases{cost.Seconds+=tc.Seconds;seen:=map[string]bool{};for _,id:=range tc.IDs{if !seen[id]{cost.CasesPerSpec[id]++;seen[id]=true}}}
+		_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root,m.Dir),func(path string,d os.DirEntry,e error)error{if e!=nil||d.IsDir(){return nil};info,e:=d.Info();if e!=nil||!info.Mode().IsRegular(){return nil};rel,e:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root,m.Dir),path);if e!=nil{return nil};zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones);if zone!="evals"&&zone!="disposable"{return nil};data,e:=os.ReadFile(path);if e!=nil{return nil};n:=strings.Count(string(data),"\n");if len(data)>0&&data[len(data)-1]!='\n'{n++};if zone=="evals"{cost.EvalLines+=n}else{cost.DisposableLines+=n};return nil});out=append(out,cost)};return out
+}
+func budgetWarnings(s project.Snapshot,costs []model.ModuleCost)[]project.Diagnostic{
+	b:=configMap(s,"budgets");limit:=15*time.Minute;if v:=str(b["verify_time"]);v!=""{if d,e:=time.ParseDuration(v);e==nil{limit=d}};cases:=15;if n:=integer(b["cases_per_spec"]);n>0{cases=n};ratio:=4.0;if v:=str(b["eval_ratio"]);v!=""{_,_=fmt.Sscanf(v,"%f",&ratio)}
+	ds:=[]project.Diagnostic{};total:=0.0;for _,c:=range costs{total+=c.Seconds;keys:=[]string{};for id:=range c.CasesPerSpec{keys=append(keys,id)};sort.Strings(keys);for _,id:=range keys{if c.CasesPerSpec[id]>cases{ds=append(ds,diag("B02",fmt.Sprintf("%s %s cases %d exceeds limit %d",c.Module,id,c.CasesPerSpec[id],cases),true))}};if c.EvalLines>0&&(c.DisposableLines==0||float64(c.EvalLines)/float64(c.DisposableLines)>ratio){ds=append(ds,diag("B03",fmt.Sprintf("%s eval/disposable ratio %d/%d exceeds limit %g",c.Module,c.EvalLines,c.DisposableLines,ratio),true))}}
+	if total>limit.Seconds(){ds=append(ds,diag("B01",fmt.Sprintf("verify seconds %.3f exceeds limit %s",total,limit),true))};return ds
+}
+func budgetOnly(ds []project.Diagnostic)[]project.Diagnostic{out:=[]project.Diagnostic{};for _,d:=range ds{if strings.HasPrefix(d.Code,"B0"){out=append(out,d)}};return out}
+func saveCosts(root string,s model.CostSnapshot)error{p:=filepath.Join(root,".fireweed","runs",s.Run,s.Phase,"costs.json");if e:=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p),0755);e!=nil{return e};b,e:=json.MarshalIndent(s,"","  ");if e!=nil{return e};return os.WriteFile(p,b,0644)}
+func Costs(root string)([]model.CostSnapshot,error){r,e:=rootOf(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};out:=[]model.CostSnapshot{};_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(r,".fireweed","runs"),func(path string,d os.DirEntry,e error)error{if e!=nil||d.IsDir()||d.Name()!="costs.json"{return nil};b,e:=os.ReadFile(path);if e==nil{var x model.CostSnapshot;if json.Unmarshal(b,&x)==nil{out=append(out,x)}};return nil});sort.Slice(out,func(i,j int)bool{return out[i].RecordedAt.Before(out[j].RecordedAt)});return out,nil}
+

+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/common.go
@@ -0,0 +1,95 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+type claim struct {
+	Worktree string `json:"worktree"`
+	Change string `json:"change"`
+	Run string `json:"run"`
+	Phase string `json:"phase"`
+	Base string `json:"base"`
+	Approved string `json:"approved"`
+	Snapshot project.Snapshot `json:"snapshot"`
+}
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)) }
+func diag(code, msg string, warning bool) project.Diagnostic { return project.Diagnostic{Code:code, Message:msg, Warning:warning} }
+
+func rootOf(root string) (string,error) {
+	r,err:=filepath.Abs(root); if err!=nil{return "",err}; r,err=filepath.EvalSymlinks(r); if err!=nil{return "",err}; return r,nil
+}
+func command(root string, args ...string)(string,error){
+	c:=exec.Command("git",args...); c.Dir=root
+	c.Env=append(os.Environ(),"GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fireweed","GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fireweed@localhost","GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fireweed","GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fireweed@localhost")
+	b,err:=c.CombinedOutput(); if err!=nil{return "",fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s",strings.Join(args," "),err,strings.TrimSpace(string(b)))}
+	return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)),nil
+}
+func commandInput(root string, input []byte,args ...string)(string,error){
+	c:=exec.Command("git",args...); c.Dir=root;c.Stdin=bytes.NewReader(input)
+	c.Env=append(os.Environ(),"GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fireweed","GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fireweed@localhost","GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fireweed","GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fireweed@localhost")
+	b,err:=c.CombinedOutput();if err!=nil{return "",fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s",strings.Join(args," "),err,strings.TrimSpace(string(b)))};return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)),nil
+}
+func head(root string)(string,error){return command(root,"rev-parse","HEAD")}
+func dirty(root string)(bool,error){s,e:=command(root,"status","--porcelain=v1","--untracked-files=all");return s!="",e}
+func read(root,path string)(string,error){b,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path)));return string(b),e}
+func write(root,path,s string)error{p:=filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path));if e:=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p),0755);e!=nil{return e};return os.WriteFile(p,[]byte(s),0644)}
+func str(v any)string{if v==nil{return ""};return fmt.Sprint(v)}
+func integer(v any)int{n,_:=strconv.Atoi(str(v));return n}
+func stringSlice(v any)[]string{a,ok:=v.([]any);if !ok {if b,ok:=v.([]string);ok{return b};return nil};out:=make([]string,0,len(a));for _,x:=range a{out=append(out,str(x))};return out}
+func mapValue(v any)map[string]any{m,_:=v.(map[string]any);return m}
+func configMap(s project.Snapshot,key string)map[string]any{return mapValue(s.Config[key])}
+func configString(s project.Snapshot,key string)string{return str(s.Config[key])}
+func changePath(ch project.Change)string{return filepath.ToSlash(ch.Path)}
+func slugFromPath(path string)string{b:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path),".md");if i:=strings.IndexByte(b,'-');i>=0{return b[i+1:]};return b}
+func allChanges(root string, archived bool)([]project.Change,error){
+	queue,e:=project.Queue(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};if !archived{return queue,nil}
+	ents,e:=os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(root,"changes","archive"));if errors.Is(e,os.ErrNotExist){return queue,nil};if e!=nil{return nil,e}
+	for _,ent:=range ents{if ent.IsDir()||!strings.HasSuffix(ent.Name(),".md"){continue};p:="changes/archive/"+ent.Name();raw,e:=read(root,p);if e!=nil{return nil,e};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(raw);if e!=nil{return nil,e};queue=append(queue,project.Change{Slug:slugFromPath(p),Path:p,Module:str(d.Frontmatter["module"]),Document:d})}
+	return queue,nil
+}
+func selectChange(root,selector string,archived bool)(project.Change,error){
+	all,e:=allChanges(root,archived);if e!=nil{return project.Change{},e}
+	valid:=make([]string,0,len(all));matches:=[]project.Change{}
+	for _,c:=range all{valid=append(valid,c.Slug);p:=changePath(c);if selector==p||selector==filepath.Base(p)||selector==c.Slug{matches=append(matches,c)}}
+	sort.Strings(valid)
+	if len(matches)!=1{return project.Change{},coded("U02","change %q not found or ambiguous; valid slugs: %s",selector,strings.Join(valid,", "))};return matches[0],nil
+}
+func refName(c project.Change)string{return "refs/fireweed/claims/"+c.Slug}
+func loadClaim(root string,c project.Change)(claim,string,error){
+	oid,found,e:=gitstore.Ref(root,refName(c));if e!=nil{return claim{},"",e};if !found{return claim{},"",coded("P02","change has no claim")}
+	b,e:=gitstore.ReadBlob(root,oid);if e!=nil{return claim{},"",e};var cl claim;if e=json.Unmarshal(b,&cl);e!=nil{return claim{},"",e};if cl.Worktree!=root{return claim{},"",coded("P02","change claimed by another worktree")};return cl,oid,nil
+}
+func saveClaim(root string,c project.Change,cl claim,old string)(string,error){b,e:=json.Marshal(cl);if e!=nil{return "",e};oid,e:=gitstore.WriteBlob(root,b);if e!=nil{return "",e};if e=gitstore.CASRef(root,refName(c),old,oid);e!=nil{return "",coded("P02","claim contention: %v",e)};return oid,nil}
+func state(root string,c project.Change,cl claim,oid string)(model.State,error){h,e:=head(root);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};s:=cl.Snapshot;s.Root=root;return model.State{Change:c,Snapshot:s,Run:cl.Run,Phase:cl.Phase,Head:h,PhaseBase:cl.Base,ClaimOID:oid},nil}
+func freshState(root string,c project.Change,cl claim,oid string)(model.State,error){raw,e:=read(root,changePath(c));if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(raw);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};c.Document=d;c.Added,_=items(d,"Added");c.Modified,_=items(d,"Modified");c.Removed,_=items(d,"Removed");return state(root,c,cl,oid)}
+func items(d contracts.Document,section string)([]contracts.Item,error){s,ok:=contracts.Section(d.Body,section);if !ok{return nil,nil};return contracts.ParseItems(s)}
+func setFront(raw string,vals map[string]any)(string,error){d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(raw);if e!=nil{return "",e};if d.Frontmatter==nil{d.Frontmatter=map[string]any{}};for k,v:=range vals{if v==nil{delete(d.Frontmatter,k)}else{d.Frontmatter[k]=v}};return contracts.RenderDocument(d)}
+func phase(c project.Change)string{p:=str(c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]);if p==""{return "queued"};return p}
+func runID()string{return strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixNano(),36)+"-"+strconv.Itoa(os.Getpid())}
+func unapprovedMetadata(raw,approved string,phase string)error{
+	a,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(approved);if e!=nil{return e};b,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(raw);if e!=nil{return coded("P03","change document malformed: %v",e)}
+	if str(b.Frontmatter["phase"])!=phase{return coded("P03","unapproved phase alteration")}
+	for k,v:=range a.Frontmatter{if fmt.Sprintf("%#v",b.Frontmatter[k])!=fmt.Sprintf("%#v",v){return coded("P03","unapproved %s alteration",k)}}
+	for k:=range b.Frontmatter{if _,ok:=a.Frontmatter[k];!ok{return coded("P03","unapproved %s alteration",k)}}
+	for _,section:=range []string{"Motivation","Interface","Added","Modified","Removed","Decisions","Removed decisions"}{av,_:=contracts.Section(a.Body,section);bv,_:=contracts.Section(b.Body,section);if av!=bv{return coded("P03","unapproved author alteration in %s",section)}}
+	return nil
+}
+func commitAll(root,subject string)(string,error){if _,e:=command(root,"add","-A");e!=nil{return "",e};if _,e:=command(root,"commit","-m",subject);e!=nil{return "",e};return head(root)}
+
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..70607526d14e6dac5e43741bcc663a5e14b1363f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go
@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+var findingRE=regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^- (?:\[untestable\] )?([A-Z]+-\d+): "([^"]+)"[^\n]*$`)
+var checkedRE=regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^Checked IDs:\s*([^\n]+)`)
+
+func auditSubmission(s model.State,raw string)(string,bool,error){
+	d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(raw);if e!=nil{return "",false,coded("P09","malformed audit submission: %v",e)}
+	body,_:=contracts.Section(d.Body,"Audit");body=strings.TrimSpace(body)
+	findings:=[]string{};untestable:=false
+	for _,line:=range strings.Split(body,"\n"){m:=findingRE.FindStringSubmatch(line);if m==nil{continue};valid:=false;mod:=moduleByName(s.Snapshot,s.Change.Module);if mod!=nil{for _,spec:=range moduleSpecs(*mod){if spec.ID==m[1]&&strings.Contains(spec.Body,m[2]){valid=true;break}}};if !valid{continue};if integer(d.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"])>0{approved,_:=contracts.Section(s.Change.Document.Body,"Audit");if !strings.Contains(approved,m[1]+":"){continue}};findings=append(findings,line);if strings.Contains(line,"[untestable]"){untestable=true}}
+	if len(findings)>0{return contracts.ReplaceSection(raw,"Audit",strings.Join(findings,"\n")+"\n"),untestable,nil}
+	checked:=checkedRE.FindStringSubmatch(body);if checked==nil||!strings.Contains(body,"No findings"){return "",false,coded("P09","audit requires Checked IDs and No findings")}
+	ids:=strings.FieldsFunc(checked[1],func(r rune)bool{return r==','||r==' '||r=='\t'});required:=changedIDs(s.Change);required=append(required,stringSlice(s.Change.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])...)
+	for _,id:=range required{if !contains(ids,id){return "",false,coded("P09","audit did not check %s",id)}}
+	return contracts.ReplaceSection(raw,"Audit","No findings; checked "+strings.Join(ids,", ")+"\n"),false,nil
+}
+func Done(ctx context.Context,req model.Request)(model.Result,error){
+	r,e:=verify(ctx,reqFull(req));if e!=nil{return r,e};s:=r.State;root:=s.Snapshot.Root;c:=s.Change;cl,oid,e:=loadClaim(root,c);if e!=nil{return r,e};raw,e:=read(root,changePath(c));if e!=nil{return r,e}
+	next:="";block:=false
+	switch s.Phase{
+	case "evals":next="audit";audit:=configMap(s.Snapshot,"audit");if audit["enabled"]==false{next="impl"}
+	case "audit":var untestable bool;raw,untestable,e=auditSubmission(s,raw);if e!=nil{return r,e};a,_:=contracts.Section(raw,"Audit");if strings.Contains(a,"No findings;"){next="impl"}else{max:=2;if n:=integer(configMap(s.Snapshot,"audit")["max_rounds"]);n>0{max=n};round:=integer(c.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]);if untestable||round>=max{block=true;next="audit";reason:="audit findings exceeded round limit";if untestable{reason="audit finding marked untestable"};raw,e=setFront(raw,map[string]any{"blocked":reason});if e!=nil{return r,e};raw=contracts.ReplaceSection(raw,"Questions",a)}else{next="evals";raw,e=setFront(raw,map[string]any{"audit_rounds":round+1});if e!=nil{return r,e}}}
+	case "impl":next="applied"
+	default:return r,coded("P01","unsupported phase %s",s.Phase)
+	}
+	if !block{raw,e=setFront(raw,map[string]any{"phase":next});if e!=nil{return r,e}}
+	raw=appendProvenance(raw,s.Phase,req.Agent,r.Reports,c)
+	if next=="applied"{
+		if e=applyModule(root,c);e!=nil{return r,e}
+		for _,d:=range project.Check(root){if !d.Warning{return r,coded(d.Code,"%s",d.Message)}}
+		archive:="changes/archive/"+filepath.Base(changePath(c));if e=write(root,archive,raw);e!=nil{return r,e};if e=os.Remove(filepath.Join(root,changePath(c)));e!=nil{return r,e}
+	}else{if e=write(root,changePath(c),raw);e!=nil{return r,e}}
+	newHead,e:=commitAll(root,"fireweed: "+c.Slug+" "+s.Phase+" -> "+next);if e!=nil{return r,e}
+	cl.Base=newHead;cl.Phase=next;cl.Approved=raw
+	if next=="applied"||block{_ = gitstore.CASRef(root,refName(c),oid,"");r.State.ClaimOID="";if next=="applied"{c.Path="changes/archive/"+filepath.Base(changePath(c))}}else{oid,e=saveClaim(root,c,cl,oid);if e!=nil{return r,e};r.State.ClaimOID=oid}
+	r.State.Head=newHead;r.State.PhaseBase=newHead;r.State.Phase=next;r.State.Change=c;r.State.Change.Document,_=contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if block{return r,coded("P06","change blocked: %s",str(r.State.Change.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]))};return r,nil
+}
+func reqFull(r model.Request)model.Request{r.Quick=false;return r}
+func appendProvenance(raw,phase,agent string,reports map[string]checks.Report,c project.Change)string{
+	if agent==""{agent="manual"};playbook:=phase;if phase=="impl"&&c.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"]==true{playbook="regenerate"};pb,_:=assets.Playbook(playbook);h:=sha256.Sum256([]byte(pb));total,pass,fail:=0,0,0;for _,report:=range reports{for _,tc:=range report.Cases{total++;if tc.Result=="pass"{pass++}else if tc.Result=="fail"||tc.Result=="error"{fail++}}};line:=fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d",phase,time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),agent,assets.Version(),hex.EncodeToString(h[:]),total,fail,pass)
+	old,_:=contracts.Section(raw,"Provenance");return contracts.ReplaceSection(raw,"Provenance",strings.TrimSpace(old)+"\n"+line+"\n")
+}
+func applyModule(root string,c project.Change)error{
+	snap,e:=project.Load(root);if e!=nil{return e};m:=moduleByName(snap,c.Module);if m==nil{return coded("C01","module %s missing",c.Module)};path:=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir,"SPEC.md"));raw,e:=read(root,path);if e!=nil{return e};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(raw);if e!=nil{return e}
+	for k,v:=range mapValue(c.Document.Frontmatter["set"]){if d.Frontmatter==nil{d.Frontmatter=map[string]any{}};d.Frontmatter[k]=v}
+	sec,_:=contracts.Section(d.Body,"Specs");prior,_:=contracts.ParseItems(sec);byID:=map[string]contracts.Item{};for _,x:=range prior{byID[x.ID]=x};for _,x:=range c.Removed{delete(byID,x.ID)};for _,x:=range append(append([]contracts.Item{},c.Added...),c.Modified...){byID[x.ID]=x};keys:=[]string{};for id:=range byID{keys=append(keys,id)};sort.Strings(keys);parts:=[]string{};for _,id:=range keys{parts=append(parts,strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(byID[id])))};d.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(d.Body,"Specs",strings.Join(parts,"\n\n")+"\n")
+	decisions,_:=contracts.Section(d.Body,"Decisions");removed,_:=contracts.Section(c.Document.Body,"Removed decisions");for _,line:=range strings.Split(removed,"\n"){line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line!=""{decisions=strings.ReplaceAll(decisions,line,"")}}
+	added,_:=contracts.Section(c.Document.Body,"Decisions");added=strings.TrimSpace(added);if added!=""{for _,line:=range strings.Split(added,"\n"){line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line!=""{decisions+="\n- "+c.Slug+": "+line}}};d.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(d.Body,"Decisions",strings.TrimSpace(decisions)+"\n");rendered,e:=contracts.RenderDocument(d);if e!=nil{return e};return write(root,path,rendered)
+}
+
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/prbody.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/prbody.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..53b7fb91f541a1361660e85436516ddb7ff98816
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/prbody.go
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+type endpointConfigError struct{error}
+func IsEndpointConfigError(err error)bool{var target endpointConfigError;return errors.As(err,&target)}
+
+func PRBody(root,revisionRange string)(model.PRBodyReport,error){
+	r,e:=rootOf(root);if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},e};parts:=strings.Split(revisionRange,"..");if len(parts)!=2||parts[0]==""||parts[1]==""{return model.PRBodyReport{},coded("P01","invalid range %q",revisionRange)}
+	a,e:=command(r,"rev-parse","--verify",parts[0]+"^{commit}");if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},coded("P01","resolve range %q: %v",revisionRange,e)};b,e:=command(r,"rev-parse","--verify",parts[1]+"^{commit}");if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},coded("P01","resolve range %q: %v",revisionRange,e)}
+	snap,e:=project.LoadAt(r,b);if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},endpointConfigError{e}}
+	var body strings.Builder;fmt.Fprintf(&body,"# Change summary\n\nRange: `%s..%s`\n\n",a,b)
+	changed,e:=command(r,"diff","--name-only",a,b,"--");if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},e};touched:=map[string]bool{};for _,p:=range strings.Split(changed,"\n"){if strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/")&&strings.HasSuffix(p,".md"){touched[filepath.Base(p)]=true}}
+	list,e:=command(r,"ls-tree","-r","--name-only",b,"changes");if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},e};selected:=[]project.Change{};blocked:=[]string{};for _,p:=range strings.Split(list,"\n"){if p==""||!strings.HasSuffix(p,".md"){continue};data,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(r,b,p);if e!=nil{continue};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(data));if e!=nil{continue};c:=project.Change{Slug:slugFromPath(p),Path:p,Module:str(d.Frontmatter["module"]),Document:d};c.Added,_=items(d,"Added");c.Modified,_=items(d,"Modified");c.Removed,_=items(d,"Removed");if str(d.Frontmatter["blocked"])!=""&&!strings.Contains(p,"/archive/"){blocked=append(blocked,fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s",p,str(d.Frontmatter["blocked"])))};if touched[filepath.Base(p)]{selected=append(selected,c)}}
+	if len(selected)==0{body.WriteString("No selected changes.\n\n")}
+	for _,c:=range selected{kind:="spec";if len(stringSlice(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"]))>0{kind="eval_fix"}else if c.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"]==true{kind="regenerate"}else if len(c.Added)+len(c.Modified)+len(c.Removed)==0{kind="maintenance"}
+		fmt.Fprintf(&body,"## %s\n\nPath: `%s`  Module: %s  Kind: %s  audit_rounds: %d\n\n",c.Slug,c.Path,c.Module,kind,integer(c.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]))
+		prov,_:=contracts.Section(c.Document.Body,"Provenance");body.WriteString("### Provenance\n\n"+prov+"\n")
+		for _,section:=range []string{"Decisions","Removed decisions"}{content,_:=contracts.Section(c.Document.Body,section);fmt.Fprintf(&body,"### %s\n\n%s\n",section,content)}
+		for _,item:=range append(append([]contracts.Item{},c.Added...),c.Modified...){if strings.Contains(item.Tag,"review"){fmt.Fprintf(&body,"- %s: %s\n",item.ID,strings.TrimSpace(item.Body))}}
+		commits:=phaseCommitsAt(r,b,filepath.Base(c.Path));seenFiles:=map[string]bool{};auditLines:=map[string]bool{};for _,oid:=range commits{parent,_:=command(r,"rev-parse",oid+"^");diff,_:=command(r,"diff","--name-only",parent,oid,"--");for _,p:=range strings.Split(diff,"\n"){if p!=""&&!strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/"){seenFiles[p]=true}};for _,p:=range []string{"changes/"+filepath.Base(c.Path),"changes/archive/"+filepath.Base(c.Path)}{raw,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(r,oid,p);if e!=nil{continue};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw));if e!=nil{continue};audit,_:=contracts.Section(d.Body,"Audit");for _,line:=range strings.Split(audit,"\n"){if strings.HasPrefix(line,"- "){auditLines[line]=true}}}}
+		if len(commits)==0{for _,p:=range strings.Split(changed,"\n"){if !strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/")&&p!=""{seenFiles[p]=true}}}
+		files:=[]string{};for p:=range seenFiles{files=append(files,p)};sort.Strings(files);body.WriteString("### Files\n\n");for _,p:=range files{body.WriteString("- `"+p+"`\n")};body.WriteString("\n### Audit findings\n\n");lines:=[]string{};for line:=range auditLines{lines=append(lines,line)};sort.Strings(lines);for _,line:=range lines{body.WriteString(line+"\n")};body.WriteString("\n")
+	}
+	body.WriteString("## Exceptions\n\n");for _,m:=range snap.Modules{for _,item:=range moduleSpecs(m){if strings.HasPrefix(item.Tag,"quarantine:"){fmt.Fprintf(&body,"- %s %s: %s\n",m.Name,item.ID,strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(item.Tag,"quarantine:")))}};if reason:=str(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]);reason!=""{fmt.Fprintf(&body,"- %s boundary opt-out: %s\n",m.Name,reason)}};for _,x:=range blocked{body.WriteString("- blocked "+x+"\n")}
+	out:=model.PRBodyReport{}
+	costs,_:=Costs(r);latest:=map[string]model.CostSnapshot{};for _,record:=range costs{for _,m:=range record.Modules{latest[m.Module]=record}}
+	body.WriteString("\n## Costs\n\n| Module | Seconds | Cases per spec | Eval lines | Disposable lines |\n|---|---:|---|---:|---:|\n");names:=[]string{};for n:=range latest{names=append(names,n)};sort.Strings(names);warned:=map[string]bool{};for _,name:=range names{record:=latest[name];for _,m:=range record.Modules{if m.Module!=name{continue};keys:=[]string{};for id:=range m.CasesPerSpec{keys=append(keys,id)};sort.Strings(keys);pairs:=[]string{};for _,id:=range keys{pairs=append(pairs,fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d",id,m.CasesPerSpec[id]))};fmt.Fprintf(&body,"| %s | %g | %s | %d | %d |\n",name,m.Seconds,strings.Join(pairs,", "),m.EvalLines,m.DisposableLines)};for _,d:=range record.Diagnostics{key:=d.Code+"\x00"+d.Message;if !warned[key]{out.Diagnostics=append(out.Diagnostics,d);warned[key]=true;fmt.Fprintf(&body,"\n- %s: %s",d.Code,d.Message)}}}
+	added,e:=command(r,"diff","--diff-filter=A","--name-only",a,b,"--");if e==nil{for _,p:=range strings.Split(added,"\n"){for _,m:=range snap.Modules{if !strings.HasPrefix(p,m.Dir+"/"){continue};rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(p,m.Dir+"/");if contracts.ResolveZone(rel,m.Zones)!="disposable"{continue};data,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(r,b,p);if e!=nil{continue};binary:=strings.ContainsRune(string(data),'\x00');if !binary&&len(data)<=262144{continue};d:=diag("B04",fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d bytes disposable artifact",p,len(data)),true);out.Diagnostics=append(out.Diagnostics,d);fmt.Fprintf(&body,"\n- B04: %s\n",d.Message)}}}
+	out.Body=body.String();return out,nil
+}
+func phaseCommitsAt(root,endpoint,filename string)[]string{out,_:=command(root,"rev-list",endpoint);result:=[]string{};for _,oid:=range strings.Split(out,"\n"){if oid==""{continue};parent,e:=command(root,"rev-parse",oid+"^");if e!=nil{continue};a:=phaseAt(root,parent,"changes/"+filename);if a==""{a=phaseAt(root,parent,"changes/archive/"+filename)};b:=phaseAt(root,oid,"changes/"+filename);if b==""{b=phaseAt(root,oid,"changes/archive/"+filename)};if b!=""&&a!=b{result=append(result,oid)}};return result}
+
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/recovery.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/recovery.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..6f41a61885b14b53828c886b9a72f7ab5d3852b4
--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func Block(req model.BlockRequest)(model.BlockResult,error){
+	s,e:=Current(req.Root,req.Change);if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};root:=s.Snapshot.Root;c:=s.Change;cl,oid,e:=loadClaim(root,c);if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};if h,_:=head(root);h!=cl.Base{return model.BlockResult{},coded("P05","stale phase base: HEAD changed")}
+	raw,e:=read(root,changePath(c));if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};if e=unapprovedMetadata(raw,cl.Approved,cl.Phase);e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e}
+	for n:=1;;n++{ref:=fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d",c.Slug,n);if _,ok,_:=gitstore.Ref(root,ref);ok{continue}
+		if _,e=command(root,"add","-A");e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};tree,e:=command(root,"write-tree");if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};attemptOID,e:=commandInput(root,nil,"commit-tree",tree,"-p",cl.Base,"-m","fireweed attempt "+c.Slug);if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};if e=gitstore.CASRef(root,ref,"",attemptOID);e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e}
+		if _,e=command(root,"reset","--hard",cl.Base);e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};if _,e=command(root,"clean","-fd");e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e}
+		blocked,e:=setFront(cl.Approved,map[string]any{"blocked":req.Reason});if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};if e=write(root,changePath(c),blocked);e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};h,e:=commitAll(root,"fireweed: block "+c.Slug);if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};_ = gitstore.CASRef(root,refName(c),oid,"");s.Head=h;s.PhaseBase=h;s.ClaimOID="";s.Change.Document,_=contracts.ParseDocument(blocked);return model.BlockResult{State:s,AttemptRef:ref,AttemptOID:attemptOID},nil
+	}
+}
+func restoreAttempt(root string,c interface{ },n int,cl claim)error{
+	// The saved tree is compared to its original phase base so later independent commits survive.
+	change:=cl.Change;slug:=slugFromPath(change);ref:=fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d",slug,n)
+	// git diff between the first parent and the attempt includes additions and deletions.
+	parent,e:=command(root,"rev-parse",ref+"^");if e!=nil{return e};diff,e:=command(root,"diff","--name-status",parent,ref,"--");if e!=nil{return e}
+	for _,line:=range strings.Split(diff,"\n"){fields:=strings.Fields(line);if len(fields)<2{continue};path:=fields[len(fields)-1];if path==change{saved,e:=command(root,"show",ref+":"+path);if e!=nil{continue};current,e:=read(root,path);if e!=nil{return e};for _,section:=range []string{"Decisions","Questions"}{body,ok:=contracts.Section(saved,section);if ok{current=contracts.ReplaceSection(current,section,body)}};if cl.Phase=="audit"{body,ok:=contracts.Section(saved,"Audit");if ok{current=contracts.ReplaceSection(current,"Audit",body)}};if e=write(root,path,current);e!=nil{return e};continue}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(fields[0],"D"){_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path)));continue};b,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,ref,path);if e!=nil{return e};p:=filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path));if e=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p),0755);e!=nil{return e};if e=os.WriteFile(p,b,0644);e!=nil{return e}}
+	return nil
+}
+func Abandon(root,selector string)(string,error){
+	r,e:=rootOf(root);if e!=nil{return "",e};c,e:=selectChange(r,selector,true);if e!=nil{return "",e};if strings.Contains(changePath(c),"/archive/"){return "",coded("P01","applied change cannot be abandoned")};if bad,e:=dirty(r);e!=nil{return "",e}else if bad{return "",coded("P01","dirty worktree")}
+	cl,oid,claimErr:=loadClaim(r,c);if claimErr!=nil&&(!strings.Contains(claimErr.Error(),"has no claim")){return "",claimErr};_ = cl
+	commits,e:=Commits(r,changePath(c));if e!=nil{return "",e};if len(commits)>0{args:=append([]string{"revert","--no-commit"},commits...);if _,e=command(r,args...);e!=nil{return "",e}}
+	if e=os.Remove(filepath.Join(r,changePath(c)));e!=nil{return "",e};h,e:=commitAll(r,"fireweed: abandon "+c.Slug);if e!=nil{return "",e};if oid!=""{_ = gitstore.CASRef(r,refName(c),oid,"")};return h,nil
+}
+func Commits(root,selector string)([]string,error){
+	r,e:=rootOf(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};c,e:=selectChange(r,selector,true);if e!=nil{return nil,e};filename:=filepath.Base(changePath(c));out,e:=command(r,"rev-list","HEAD");if e!=nil{return nil,e};commits:=[]string{}
+	for _,oid:=range strings.Split(out,"\n"){if oid==""{continue};parents,e:=command(r,"rev-list","--parents","-n","1",oid);if e!=nil{return nil,e};fields:=strings.Fields(parents);if len(fields)<2{continue};parent:=fields[1];path:="changes/"+filename;archive:="changes/archive/"+filename;current:=phaseAt(r,oid,path);if current==""{current=phaseAt(r,oid,archive)};previous:=phaseAt(r,parent,path);if previous==""{previous=phaseAt(r,parent,archive)};if current!=""&&current!=previous{commits=append(commits,oid)}};return commits,nil
+}
+func phaseAt(root,rev,path string)string{b,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,rev,path);if e!=nil{return ""};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil{return ""};return str(d.Frontmatter["phase"])}
+func attemptNumber(ref string)int{n,_:=strconv.Atoi(filepath.Base(ref));return n}
+

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func waitingFor(root string,queue []project.Change,i int)(string,string,error){
+	c:=queue[i];if phase(c)=="blocked"||str(c.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"])!=""{return "","",nil}
+	snap,e:=project.Project(root,c.Slug);if e!=nil{return "","",e}
+	deps:=map[string][]string{};for _,m:=range snap.Modules{deps[m.Name]=m.DependsOn}
+	var depends func(string,string,map[string]bool)bool
+	depends=func(a,b string,seen map[string]bool)bool{if seen[a]{return false};seen[a]=true;for _,d:=range deps[a]{if d==b||depends(d,b,seen){return true}};return false}
+	iface,_:=contracts.Section(c.Document.Body,"Interface")
+	for _,prev:=range queue[:i]{if str(prev.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"])==""{continue};if c.Module==prev.Module{return prev.Slug,"same_module",nil};if depends(c.Module,prev.Module,map[string]bool{}){return prev.Slug,"depends_on_blocked",nil};if strings.TrimSpace(iface)!=""&&depends(prev.Module,c.Module,map[string]bool{}){return prev.Slug,"interface_dependency",nil}}
+	return "","",nil
+}
+func Eligible(root string)([]project.Change,error){r,e:=rootOf(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};q,e:=project.Queue(r);if e!=nil{return nil,e};out:=[]project.Change{};for i,c:=range q{if str(c.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"])!=""{continue};w,_,e:=waitingFor(r,q,i);if e!=nil{return nil,e};if w==""{out=append(out,c)}};return out,nil}
+
+func Start(root,selector string)(model.State,error){return start(root,selector,0,false)}
+func StartFromAttempt(root,selector string,attempt int)(model.State,error){return start(root,selector,attempt,true)}
+func start(root,selector string,attempt int,resume bool)(model.State,error){
+	r,e:=rootOf(root);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e}
+	if resume&&attempt<=0{return model.State{},coded("P01","invalid attempt %d",attempt)}
+	if selector!=""{if _,e=selectChange(r,selector,false);e!=nil{return model.State{},e}}
+	bad,e:=dirty(r);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};if bad{return model.State{},coded("P01","dirty worktree")}
+	eligible,e:=Eligible(r);if e!=nil{return model.State{},classifyStale(e)};if len(eligible)==0{return model.State{},coded("P01","no eligible change")}
+	c:=eligible[0];if selector!=""{selected,_:=selectChange(r,selector,false);if selected.Path!=c.Path{return model.State{},coded("P01","change %s is not first eligible change",selector)}}
+	if resume{ref:=fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d",c.Slug,attempt);if _,ok,_:=gitstore.Ref(r,ref);!ok{return model.State{},coded("P01","saved attempt %s not found",ref)}}
+	if _,ok,_:=gitstore.Ref(r,refName(c));ok{return model.State{},coded("P02","change already claimed")}
+	h,e:=head(r);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e}
+	raw,e:=read(r,changePath(c));if e!=nil{return model.State{},e}
+	if !resume&&phase(c)=="queued"{
+		prefix:="";for _,m:=range mustLoad(r).Modules{if m.Name==c.Module{prefix=m.IDPrefix;break}}
+		if prefix!=""{raw=allocateIDs(r,c,raw,prefix)}
+		d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(raw);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};p:="impl";added,_:=items(d,"Added");modified,_:=items(d,"Modified");removed,_:=items(d,"Removed");if len(added)+len(modified)+len(removed)>0||len(stringSlice(d.Frontmatter["fixes"]))>0||len(stringSlice(d.Frontmatter["eval_fix"]))>0{p="evals"};if d.Frontmatter["regenerate"]==true{p="impl"}
+		raw,e=setFront(raw,map[string]any{"phase":p,"run":runID()});if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};c.Document,_=contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	}else{c.Document,_=contracts.ParseDocument(raw)}
+	// Projection validates recorded bases and captures the exact graph approved for the claim.
+	if rawOnDisk,_:=read(r,changePath(c));rawOnDisk!=raw{if e=write(r,changePath(c),raw);e!=nil{return model.State{},e}}
+	snap,e:=project.Project(r,c.Slug);if e!=nil{if raw!= "" {_,_=command(r,"checkout","--",changePath(c))};return model.State{},classifyStale(e)};snap.Root=r
+	if resume||phase(c)!="queued"{if clPhase:=str(c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]);clPhase==""{return model.State{},coded("P01","saved phase missing")}}
+	cl:=claim{Worktree:r,Change:changePath(c),Run:str(c.Document.Frontmatter["run"]),Phase:str(c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]),Base:h,Approved:raw,Snapshot:snap}
+	if cl.Run==""{cl.Run=runID();raw,e=setFront(raw,map[string]any{"run":cl.Run});if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};cl.Approved=raw;_=write(r,changePath(c),raw)}
+	oid,e:=saveClaim(r,c,cl,"");if e!=nil{_,_=command(r,"checkout","--",changePath(c));return model.State{},e}
+	if resume{if e=restoreAttempt(r,c,attempt,cl);e!=nil{_=gitstore.CASRef(r,refName(c),oid,"");return model.State{},e}}
+	if !resume&&c.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"]==true{for _,m:=range snap.Modules{if m.Name==c.Module{_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(r,m.Dir),func(path string,d os.DirEntry,err error)error{if err!=nil||d.IsDir(){return nil};rel,_:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(r,m.Dir),path);if contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones)=="disposable"{_ = os.Remove(path)};return nil});break}}}
+	s,e:=freshState(r,c,cl,oid);if e!=nil{return s,e}
+	if !resume{approvalWarnings(r,c,snap,&s)}
+	return s,nil
+}
+func mustLoad(root string)project.Snapshot{s,_:=project.Load(root);return s}
+func classifyStale(e error)error{if e==nil{return nil};if strings.Contains(e.Error(),"stale base"){return coded("P05","%v",e)};return e}
+func allocateIDs(root string,c project.Change,raw,prefix string)string{
+	re:=regexp.MustCompile(`new:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`);handles:=[]string{};seen:=map[string]bool{};for _,h:=range re.FindAllString(raw,-1){if !seen[h]{handles=append(handles,h);seen[h]=true}}
+	if len(handles)==0{return raw};max:=0;for _,m:=range mustLoad(root).Modules{if m.Name!=c.Module{continue};section,_:=contracts.Section(m.Document.Body,"Specs");specs,_:=contracts.ParseItems(section);for _,s:=range specs{if strings.HasPrefix(s.ID,prefix+"-"){var n int;fmt.Sscanf(s.ID,prefix+"-%d",&n);if n>max{max=n}}}}
+	q,_:=project.Queue(root);for _,x:=range q{for _,s:=range append(append([]contracts.Item{},x.Added...),x.Modified...){var n int;if _,e:=fmt.Sscanf(s.ID,prefix+"-%d",&n);e==nil&&n>max{max=n}}}
+	for _,h:=range handles{max++;raw=strings.ReplaceAll(raw,h,fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d",prefix,max))};return raw
+}
+func approvalWarnings(root string,c project.Change,snap project.Snapshot,s *model.State){
+	base:=configString(snap,"base");if base==""{base="main"};local,le:=gitstore.BaseRef(root,"",base);shared,se:=gitstore.BaseRef(root,"origin",base)
+	approved:=false;for _,rev:=range []string{local,shared}{if rev==""{continue};if _,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,rev,changePath(c));e==nil{approved=true}}
+	if !approved{if le==nil||se==nil{s.Diagnostics=append(s.Diagnostics,diag("P04","change absent from local and shared base",true))}}
+	if c.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"]==true{s.Diagnostics=append(s.Diagnostics,diag("P10","no newer passing drill for regenerate",true))}
+}
+func Current(root,selector string)(model.State,error){r,e:=rootOf(root);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};if selector==""{q,e:=project.Queue(r);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};for _,c:=range q{if cl,oid,e:=loadClaim(r,c);e==nil{return freshState(r,c,cl,oid)}};return model.State{},coded("P02","change has no claim")};c,e:=selectChange(r,selector,false);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};cl,oid,e:=loadClaim(r,c);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};return freshState(r,c,cl,oid)}
+func Release(root,selector string)error{r,e:=rootOf(root);if e!=nil{return e};c,e:=selectChange(r,selector,false);if e!=nil{return e};_,oid,e:=loadClaim(r,c);if e!=nil{return e};return gitstore.CASRef(r,refName(c),oid,"")}
+func Context(root,selector string,full bool)(string,error){s,e:=Current(root,selector);if e!=nil{return "",e};raw,_:=read(s.Snapshot.Root,changePath(s.Change));var b strings.Builder;b.WriteString("# Change\n\n"+raw+"\n");for _,m:=range s.Snapshot.Modules{if m.Name==s.Change.Module{b.WriteString("\n# Projected spec\n\n"+m.Document.Body+"\n");for _,p:=range m.Zones.Interface{matches,_:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root,m.Dir,p));sort.Strings(matches);for _,path:=range matches{data,e:=os.ReadFile(path);if e==nil{b.WriteString("\n# "+path+"\n\n"+string(data)+"\n")}}}};sys,_:=read(s.Snapshot.Root,"SYSTEM.md");b.WriteString("\n# SYSTEM\n\n"+sys+"\n");playbook:=s.Phase;if s.Phase=="impl"&&s.Change.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"]==true{playbook="regenerate"};pb,_:=assets.Playbook(playbook);b.WriteString("\n# Playbook\n\n"+pb+"\n");_ = filepath.WalkDir(s.Snapshot.Root,func(path string,d os.DirEntry,err error)error{if err!=nil||d.IsDir()||strings.Contains(path,string(filepath.Separator)+".git"+string(filepath.Separator)){return nil};rel,_:=filepath.Rel(s.Snapshot.Root,path);if rel==changePath(s.Change)||rel=="SYSTEM.md"{return nil};info,e:=d.Info();if e!=nil{return nil};if full{data,e:=os.ReadFile(path);if e==nil{b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n# %s (%d bytes)\n\n%s\n",rel,info.Size(),data))}}else{b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s %d bytes\n",rel,info.Size()))};return nil});return b.String(),nil}
+

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func Status(root string)(model.StatusReport,error){
+	r,e:=rootOf(root);if e!=nil{return model.StatusReport{},e};snap,e:=project.Load(r);if e!=nil{return model.StatusReport{},e};q,e:=project.Queue(r);if e!=nil{return model.StatusReport{},e};out:=model.StatusReport{Modules:snap.Modules,Queue:[]model.StatusEntry{},Quarantines:[]model.Quarantine{},BoundaryOptOuts:[]model.BoundaryOptOut{},DriftSinceDrill:map[string]int{},PhaseCommits:map[string]int{},Costs:[]model.ModuleCost{}}
+	for i,c:=range q{entry:=model.StatusEntry{Slug:c.Slug,Path:c.Path,Module:c.Module,Phase:phase(c),Blocked:str(c.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]),AuditRounds:integer(c.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"])};entry.WaitingOn,entry.WaitingRule,_=waitingFor(r,q,i);out.Queue=append(out.Queue,entry)}
+	for _,m:=range snap.Modules{for _,spec:=range moduleSpecs(m){if strings.HasPrefix(spec.Tag,"quarantine:"){out.Quarantines=append(out.Quarantines,model.Quarantine{Module:m.Name,ID:spec.ID,Reason:strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(spec.Tag,"quarantine:"))})}};if reason:=str(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]);reason!=""{out.BoundaryOptOuts=append(out.BoundaryOptOuts,model.BoundaryOptOut{Module:m.Name,Reason:reason})};out.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name]=0}
+	archive,_:=allChanges(r,true);applied:=[]struct{c project.Change;t time.Time}{};for _,c:=range archive{if !strings.Contains(changePath(c),"/archive/")||phase(c)!="applied"{continue};d:=implDate(c.Document.Body);applied=append(applied,struct{c project.Change;t time.Time}{c,d});out.PhaseCommits[strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(changePath(c)),".md")],_=countCommits(r,c)}
+	sort.Slice(applied,func(i,j int)bool{if applied[i].t.Equal(applied[j].t){return applied[i].c.Path<applied[j].c.Path};return applied[i].t.After(applied[j].t)})
+	for _,x:=range applied{drill:=latestDrill(r,x.c.Module);if x.t.After(drill){out.DriftSinceDrill[x.c.Module]++}}
+	if len(applied)>=3{module:=applied[0].c.Module;n:=0;for _,x:=range applied{if x.c.Module!=module{break};n++};if n>=3{out.Diagnostics=append(out.Diagnostics,diag("P08",fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d consecutive applied changes",module,n),true))}}
+	base:=configString(snap,"base");if base==""{base="main"};remote:=configString(snap,"remote");if remote==""{remote="origin"};rev,err:=gitstore.BaseRef(r,remote,base);if err!=nil||rev==""{rev,_=gitstore.BaseRef(r,"",base)};for _,x:=range applied{if rev==""{out.Unapproved++;continue};if _,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(r,rev,changePath(x.c));e!=nil{out.Unapproved++}}
+	costs,_:=Costs(r);latest:=map[string]model.CostSnapshot{};for _,snapshot:=range costs{for _,c:=range snapshot.Modules{latest[c.Module]=snapshot}};names:=[]string{};for name:=range latest{names=append(names,name)};sort.Strings(names);warnings:=map[string]bool{};for _,name:=range names{snap:=latest[name];for _,c:=range snap.Modules{if c.Module==name{out.Costs=append(out.Costs,c)}};for _,d:=range snap.Diagnostics{key:=d.Code+"\x00"+d.Message;if !warnings[key]{out.Diagnostics=append(out.Diagnostics,d);warnings[key]=true}}}
+	return out,nil
+}
+func countCommits(root string,c project.Change)(int,error){x,e:=Commits(root,changePath(c));return len(x),e}
+func implDate(body string)time.Time{p,_:=contracts.Section(body,"Provenance");for _,line:=range strings.Split(p,"\n"){fields:=strings.Fields(line);if len(fields)>=3&&fields[0]=="-"&&fields[1]=="impl"{d,_:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,fields[2]);return d}};return time.Time{}}
+func latestDrill(root,module string)time.Time{raw,e:=read(root,".fireweed/drills/"+module+".md");if e!=nil{return time.Time{}};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(raw);if e!=nil{return time.Time{}};t,_:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,str(d.Frontmatter["date"]));return t}
+
+func GC(ctx context.Context,req model.GCRequest)(model.GCResult,error){
+	_ = ctx;r,e:=rootOf(req.Root);if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};snap,e:=project.Load(r);if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};age:=720*time.Hour;if v:=str(configMap(snap,"gc")["drill_max_age"]);v!=""{age,e=time.ParseDuration(v);if e!=nil||age<=0{return model.GCResult{},coded("C01","invalid gc.drill_max_age %q",v)}}
+	now:=req.Now;if now.IsZero(){now=time.Now().UTC()};refs,e:=command(r,"for-each-ref","--format=%(refname) %(objectname)","refs/fireweed");if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};registered:=map[string]bool{};wt,e:=command(r,"worktree","list","--porcelain");if e==nil{for _,line:=range strings.Split(wt,"\n"){if strings.HasPrefix(line,"worktree "){p:=strings.TrimPrefix(line,"worktree ");p,_=filepath.EvalSymlinks(p);registered[p]=true}}}
+	archive:=map[string]bool{};entries,_:=os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(r,"changes","archive"));for _,d:=range entries{if !d.IsDir()&&strings.HasSuffix(d.Name(),".md"){archive[slugFromPath(d.Name())]=true}}
+	result:=model.GCResult{Pruned:[]string{}};for _,line:=range strings.Split(refs,"\n"){fields:=strings.Fields(line);if len(fields)!=2{continue};name,oid:=fields[0],fields[1];prune:=false
+		switch{case strings.HasPrefix(name,"refs/fireweed/claims/"):b,e:=gitstore.ReadBlob(r,oid);if e==nil{var data struct{Worktree string `json:"worktree"`};if json.Unmarshal(b,&data)==nil{p,_:=filepath.EvalSymlinks(data.Worktree);prune=!registered[p]}}
+		case strings.HasPrefix(name,"refs/fireweed/attempts/"):parts:=strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(name,"refs/fireweed/attempts/"),"/");if len(parts)==2{n,e:=strconv.Atoi(parts[1]);prune=e==nil&&n>0&&archive[parts[0]]}
+		case strings.HasPrefix(name,"refs/fireweed/drills/"):parts:=strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(name,"refs/fireweed/drills/"),"/");if len(parts)==2{d,e:=time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000",parts[1]);prune=e==nil&&d.Before(now.Add(-age))}}
+		if prune{if e:=gitstore.CASRef(r,name,oid,"");e==nil{result.Pruned=append(result.Pruned,name)}}}
+	sort.Strings(result.Pruned);return result,nil

+package lifecycle

+	Worktree string `json:"worktree"`

+	Phase string `json:"phase"`

+}
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)) }
+func diag(code, msg string, warning bool) project.Diagnostic { return project.Diagnostic{Code:code, Message:msg, Warning:warning} }
+
+func rootOf(root string) (string,error) {
+	r,err:=filepath.Abs(root); if err!=nil{return "",err}; r,err=filepath.EvalSymlinks(r); if err!=nil{return "",err}; return r,nil
+}
+func command(root string, args ...string)(string,error){
+	c:=exec.Command("git",args...); c.Dir=root
+	c.Env=append(os.Environ(),"GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fireweed","GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fireweed@localhost","GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fireweed","GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fireweed@localhost")
+	b,err:=c.CombinedOutput(); if err!=nil{return "",fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s",strings.Join(args," "),err,strings.TrimSpace(string(b)))}
+	return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)),nil
+}
+func commandInput(root string, input []byte,args ...string)(string,error){
+	c:=exec.Command("git",args...); c.Dir=root;c.Stdin=bytes.NewReader(input)
+	c.Env=append(os.Environ(),"GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fireweed","GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fireweed@localhost","GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fireweed","GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fireweed@localhost")
+	b,err:=c.CombinedOutput();if err!=nil{return "",fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s",strings.Join(args," "),err,strings.TrimSpace(string(b)))};return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)),nil
+}
+func head(root string)(string,error){return command(root,"rev-parse","HEAD")}
+func dirty(root string)(bool,error){s,e:=command(root,"status","--porcelain=v1","--untracked-files=all");return s!="",e}
+func read(root,path string)(string,error){b,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path)));return string(b),e}
+func write(root,path,s string)error{p:=filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path));if e:=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p),0755);e!=nil{return e};return os.WriteFile(p,[]byte(s),0644)}
+func str(v any)string{if v==nil{return ""};return fmt.Sprint(v)}
+func integer(v any)int{n,_:=strconv.Atoi(str(v));return n}
+func stringSlice(v any)[]string{a,ok:=v.([]any);if !ok {if b,ok:=v.([]string);ok{return b};return nil};out:=make([]string,0,len(a));for _,x:=range a{out=append(out,str(x))};return out}
+func mapValue(v any)map[string]any{m,_:=v.(map[string]any);return m}
+func configMap(s project.Snapshot,key string)map[string]any{return mapValue(s.Config[key])}
+func configString(s project.Snapshot,key string)string{return str(s.Config[key])}
+func changePath(ch project.Change)string{return filepath.ToSlash(ch.Path)}
+func slugFromPath(path string)string{b:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path),".md");if i:=strings.IndexByte(b,'-');i>=0{return b[i+1:]};return b}
+func allChanges(root string, archived bool)([]project.Change,error){
+	queue,e:=project.Queue(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};if !archived{return queue,nil}

+	return queue,nil
+}
+func selectChange(root,selector string,archived bool)(project.Change,error){
+	all,e:=allChanges(root,archived);if e!=nil{return project.Change{},e}
+	valid:=make([]string,0,len(all));matches:=[]project.Change{}

+func items(d contracts.Document,section string)([]contracts.Item,error){s,ok:=contracts.Section(d.Body,section);if !ok{return nil,nil};return contracts.ParseItems(s)}
+func setFront(raw string,vals map[string]any)(string,error){d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(raw);if e!=nil{return "",e};if d.Frontmatter==nil{d.Frontmatter=map[string]any{}};for k,v:=range vals{if v==nil{delete(d.Frontmatter,k)}else{d.Frontmatter[k]=v}};return contracts.RenderDocument(d)}
+func phase(c project.Change)string{p:=str(c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]);if p==""{return "queued"};return p}
+func runID()string{return strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixNano(),36)+"-"+strconv.Itoa(os.Getpid())}
+func unapprovedMetadata(raw,approved string,phase string)error{
+	a,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(approved);if e!=nil{return e};b,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(raw);if e!=nil{return coded("P03","change document malformed: %v",e)}

+	for k,v:=range a.Frontmatter{if fmt.Sprintf("%#v",b.Frontmatter[k])!=fmt.Sprintf("%#v",v){return coded("P03","unapproved %s alteration",k)}}
+	for k:=range b.Frontmatter{if _,ok:=a.Frontmatter[k];!ok{return coded("P03","unapproved %s alteration",k)}}
+	for _,section:=range []string{"Motivation","Interface","Added","Modified","Removed","Decisions","Removed decisions"}{av,_:=contracts.Section(a.Body,section);bv,_:=contracts.Section(b.Body,section);if av!=bv{return coded("P03","unapproved author alteration in %s",section)}}
+	return nil
+}
+func commitAll(root,subject string)(string,error){if _,e:=command(root,"add","-A");e!=nil{return "",e};if _,e:=command(root,"commit","-m",subject);e!=nil{return "",e};return head(root)}
+

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"

+)
+
+var findingRE=regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^- (?:\[untestable\] )?([A-Z]+-\d+): "([^"]+)"[^\n]*$`)
+var checkedRE=regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^Checked IDs:\s*([^\n]+)`)
+
+func auditSubmission(s model.State,raw string)(string,bool,error){
+	d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(raw);if e!=nil{return "",false,coded("P09","malformed audit submission: %v",e)}
+	body,_:=contracts.Section(d.Body,"Audit");body=strings.TrimSpace(body)
+	findings:=[]string{};untestable:=false
+	for _,line:=range strings.Split(body,"\n"){m:=findingRE.FindStringSubmatch(line);if m==nil{continue};valid:=false;mod:=moduleByName(s.Snapshot,s.Change.Module);if mod!=nil{for _,spec:=range moduleSpecs(*mod){if spec.ID==m[1]&&strings.Contains(spec.Body,m[2]){valid=true;break}}};if !valid{continue};if integer(d.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"])>0{approved,_:=contracts.Section(s.Change.Document.Body,"Audit");if !strings.Contains(approved,m[1]+":"){continue}};findings=append(findings,line);if strings.Contains(line,"[untestable]"){untestable=true}}
+	if len(findings)>0{return contracts.ReplaceSection(raw,"Audit",strings.Join(findings,"\n")+"\n"),untestable,nil}
+	checked:=checkedRE.FindStringSubmatch(body);if checked==nil||!strings.Contains(body,"No findings"){return "",false,coded("P09","audit requires Checked IDs and No findings")}
+	ids:=strings.FieldsFunc(checked[1],func(r rune)bool{return r==','||r==' '||r=='\t'});required:=changedIDs(s.Change);required=append(required,stringSlice(s.Change.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])...)
+	for _,id:=range required{if !contains(ids,id){return "",false,coded("P09","audit did not check %s",id)}}
+	return contracts.ReplaceSection(raw,"Audit","No findings; checked "+strings.Join(ids,", ")+"\n"),false,nil
+}
+func Done(ctx context.Context,req model.Request)(model.Result,error){
+	r,e:=verify(ctx,reqFull(req));if e!=nil{return r,e};s:=r.State;root:=s.Snapshot.Root;c:=s.Change;cl,oid,e:=loadClaim(root,c);if e!=nil{return r,e};raw,e:=read(root,changePath(c));if e!=nil{return r,e}
+	next:="";block:=false
+	switch s.Phase{
+	case "evals":next="audit";audit:=configMap(s.Snapshot,"audit");if audit["enabled"]==false{next="impl"}
+	case "audit":var untestable bool;raw,untestable,e=auditSubmission(s,raw);if e!=nil{return r,e};a,_:=contracts.Section(raw,"Audit");if strings.Contains(a,"No findings;"){next="impl"}else{max:=2;if n:=integer(configMap(s.Snapshot,"audit")["max_rounds"]);n>0{max=n};round:=integer(c.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]);if untestable||round>=max{block=true;next="audit";reason:="audit findings exceeded round limit";if untestable{reason="audit finding marked untestable"};raw,e=setFront(raw,map[string]any{"blocked":reason});if e!=nil{return r,e};raw=contracts.ReplaceSection(raw,"Questions",a)}else{next="evals";raw,e=setFront(raw,map[string]any{"audit_rounds":round+1});if e!=nil{return r,e}}}
+	case "impl":next="applied"
+	default:return r,coded("P01","unsupported phase %s",s.Phase)

+	if !block{raw,e=setFront(raw,map[string]any{"phase":next});if e!=nil{return r,e}}

+		if e=applyModule(root,c);e!=nil{return r,e}
+		for _,d:=range project.Check(root){if !d.Warning{return r,coded(d.Code,"%s",d.Message)}}
+		archive:="changes/archive/"+filepath.Base(changePath(c));if e=write(root,archive,raw);e!=nil{return r,e};if e=os.Remove(filepath.Join(root,changePath(c)));e!=nil{return r,e}
+	}else{if e=write(root,changePath(c),raw);e!=nil{return r,e}}
+	newHead,e:=commitAll(root,"fireweed: "+c.Slug+" "+s.Phase+" -> "+next);if e!=nil{return r,e}

+func reqFull(r model.Request)model.Request{r.Quick=false;return r}
+func appendProvenance(raw,phase,agent string,reports map[string]checks.Report,c project.Change)string{
+	if agent==""{agent="manual"};playbook:=phase;if phase=="impl"&&c.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"]==true{playbook="regenerate"};pb,_:=assets.Playbook(playbook);h:=sha256.Sum256([]byte(pb));total,pass,fail:=0,0,0;for _,report:=range reports{for _,tc:=range report.Cases{total++;if tc.Result=="pass"{pass++}else if tc.Result=="fail"||tc.Result=="error"{fail++}}};line:=fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d",phase,time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),agent,assets.Version(),hex.EncodeToString(h[:]),total,fail,pass)

+func applyModule(root string,c project.Change)error{
+	snap,e:=project.Load(root);if e!=nil{return e};m:=moduleByName(snap,c.Module);if m==nil{return coded("C01","module %s missing",c.Module)};path:=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir,"SPEC.md"));raw,e:=read(root,path);if e!=nil{return e};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(raw);if e!=nil{return e}
+	for k,v:=range mapValue(c.Document.Frontmatter["set"]){if d.Frontmatter==nil{d.Frontmatter=map[string]any{}};d.Frontmatter[k]=v}
+	sec,_:=contracts.Section(d.Body,"Specs");prior,_:=contracts.ParseItems(sec);byID:=map[string]contracts.Item{};for _,x:=range prior{byID[x.ID]=x};for _,x:=range c.Removed{delete(byID,x.ID)};for _,x:=range append(append([]contracts.Item{},c.Added...),c.Modified...){byID[x.ID]=x};keys:=[]string{};for id:=range byID{keys=append(keys,id)};sort.Strings(keys);parts:=[]string{};for _,id:=range keys{parts=append(parts,strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(byID[id])))};d.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(d.Body,"Specs",strings.Join(parts,"\n\n")+"\n")

+}
+

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"

+)
+
+type endpointConfigError struct{error}
+func IsEndpointConfigError(err error)bool{var target endpointConfigError;return errors.As(err,&target)}
+
+func PRBody(root,revisionRange string)(model.PRBodyReport,error){
+	r,e:=rootOf(root);if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},e};parts:=strings.Split(revisionRange,"..");if len(parts)!=2||parts[0]==""||parts[1]==""{return model.PRBodyReport{},coded("P01","invalid range %q",revisionRange)}
+	a,e:=command(r,"rev-parse","--verify",parts[0]+"^{commit}");if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},coded("P01","resolve range %q: %v",revisionRange,e)};b,e:=command(r,"rev-parse","--verify",parts[1]+"^{commit}");if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},coded("P01","resolve range %q: %v",revisionRange,e)}
+	snap,e:=project.LoadAt(r,b);if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},endpointConfigError{e}}
+	var body strings.Builder;fmt.Fprintf(&body,"# Change summary\n\nRange: `%s..%s`\n\n",a,b)
+	changed,e:=command(r,"diff","--name-only",a,b,"--");if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},e};touched:=map[string]bool{};for _,p:=range strings.Split(changed,"\n"){if strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/")&&strings.HasSuffix(p,".md"){touched[filepath.Base(p)]=true}}
+	list,e:=command(r,"ls-tree","-r","--name-only",b,"changes");if e!=nil{return model.PRBodyReport{},e};selected:=[]project.Change{};blocked:=[]string{};for _,p:=range strings.Split(list,"\n"){if p==""||!strings.HasSuffix(p,".md"){continue};data,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(r,b,p);if e!=nil{continue};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(data));if e!=nil{continue};c:=project.Change{Slug:slugFromPath(p),Path:p,Module:str(d.Frontmatter["module"]),Document:d};c.Added,_=items(d,"Added");c.Modified,_=items(d,"Modified");c.Removed,_=items(d,"Removed");if str(d.Frontmatter["blocked"])!=""&&!strings.Contains(p,"/archive/"){blocked=append(blocked,fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s",p,str(d.Frontmatter["blocked"])))};if touched[filepath.Base(p)]{selected=append(selected,c)}}
+	if len(selected)==0{body.WriteString("No selected changes.\n\n")}
+	for _,c:=range selected{kind:="spec";if len(stringSlice(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"]))>0{kind="eval_fix"}else if c.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"]==true{kind="regenerate"}else if len(c.Added)+len(c.Modified)+len(c.Removed)==0{kind="maintenance"}
+		fmt.Fprintf(&body,"## %s\n\nPath: `%s`  Module: %s  Kind: %s  audit_rounds: %d\n\n",c.Slug,c.Path,c.Module,kind,integer(c.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]))
+		prov,_:=contracts.Section(c.Document.Body,"Provenance");body.WriteString("### Provenance\n\n"+prov+"\n")
+		for _,section:=range []string{"Decisions","Removed decisions"}{content,_:=contracts.Section(c.Document.Body,section);fmt.Fprintf(&body,"### %s\n\n%s\n",section,content)}
+		for _,item:=range append(append([]contracts.Item{},c.Added...),c.Modified...){if strings.Contains(item.Tag,"review"){fmt.Fprintf(&body,"- %s: %s\n",item.ID,strings.TrimSpace(item.Body))}}
+		commits:=phaseCommitsAt(r,b,filepath.Base(c.Path));seenFiles:=map[string]bool{};auditLines:=map[string]bool{};for _,oid:=range commits{parent,_:=command(r,"rev-parse",oid+"^");diff,_:=command(r,"diff","--name-only",parent,oid,"--");for _,p:=range strings.Split(diff,"\n"){if p!=""&&!strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/"){seenFiles[p]=true}};for _,p:=range []string{"changes/"+filepath.Base(c.Path),"changes/archive/"+filepath.Base(c.Path)}{raw,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(r,oid,p);if e!=nil{continue};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw));if e!=nil{continue};audit,_:=contracts.Section(d.Body,"Audit");for _,line:=range strings.Split(audit,"\n"){if strings.HasPrefix(line,"- "){auditLines[line]=true}}}}
+		if len(commits)==0{for _,p:=range strings.Split(changed,"\n"){if !strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/")&&p!=""{seenFiles[p]=true}}}
+		files:=[]string{};for p:=range seenFiles{files=append(files,p)};sort.Strings(files);body.WriteString("### Files\n\n");for _,p:=range files{body.WriteString("- `"+p+"`\n")};body.WriteString("\n### Audit findings\n\n");lines:=[]string{};for line:=range auditLines{lines=append(lines,line)};sort.Strings(lines);for _,line:=range lines{body.WriteString(line+"\n")};body.WriteString("\n")
+	}
+	body.WriteString("## Exceptions\n\n");for _,m:=range snap.Modules{for _,item:=range moduleSpecs(m){if strings.HasPrefix(item.Tag,"quarantine:"){fmt.Fprintf(&body,"- %s %s: %s\n",m.Name,item.ID,strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(item.Tag,"quarantine:")))}};if reason:=str(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]);reason!=""{fmt.Fprintf(&body,"- %s boundary opt-out: %s\n",m.Name,reason)}};for _,x:=range blocked{body.WriteString("- blocked "+x+"\n")}
+	out:=model.PRBodyReport{}
+	costs,_:=Costs(r);latest:=map[string]model.CostSnapshot{};for _,record:=range costs{for _,m:=range record.Modules{latest[m.Module]=record}}
+	body.WriteString("\n## Costs\n\n| Module | Seconds | Cases per spec | Eval lines | Disposable lines |\n|---|---:|---|---:|---:|\n");names:=[]string{};for n:=range latest{names=append(names,n)};sort.Strings(names);warned:=map[string]bool{};for _,name:=range names{record:=latest[name];for _,m:=range record.Modules{if m.Module!=name{continue};keys:=[]string{};for id:=range m.CasesPerSpec{keys=append(keys,id)};sort.Strings(keys);pairs:=[]string{};for _,id:=range keys{pairs=append(pairs,fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d",id,m.CasesPerSpec[id]))};fmt.Fprintf(&body,"| %s | %g | %s | %d | %d |\n",name,m.Seconds,strings.Join(pairs,", "),m.EvalLines,m.DisposableLines)};for _,d:=range record.Diagnostics{key:=d.Code+"\x00"+d.Message;if !warned[key]{out.Diagnostics=append(out.Diagnostics,d);warned[key]=true;fmt.Fprintf(&body,"\n- %s: %s",d.Code,d.Message)}}}
+	added,e:=command(r,"diff","--diff-filter=A","--name-only",a,b,"--");if e==nil{for _,p:=range strings.Split(added,"\n"){for _,m:=range snap.Modules{if !strings.HasPrefix(p,m.Dir+"/"){continue};rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(p,m.Dir+"/");if contracts.ResolveZone(rel,m.Zones)!="disposable"{continue};data,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(r,b,p);if e!=nil{continue};binary:=strings.ContainsRune(string(data),'\x00');if !binary&&len(data)<=262144{continue};d:=diag("B04",fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d bytes disposable artifact",p,len(data)),true);out.Diagnostics=append(out.Diagnostics,d);fmt.Fprintf(&body,"\n- B04: %s\n",d.Message)}}}
+	out.Body=body.String();return out,nil
+}
+func phaseCommitsAt(root,endpoint,filename string)[]string{out,_:=command(root,"rev-list",endpoint);result:=[]string{};for _,oid:=range strings.Split(out,"\n"){if oid==""{continue};parent,e:=command(root,"rev-parse",oid+"^");if e!=nil{continue};a:=phaseAt(root,parent,"changes/"+filename);if a==""{a=phaseAt(root,parent,"changes/archive/"+filename)};b:=phaseAt(root,oid,"changes/"+filename);if b==""{b=phaseAt(root,oid,"changes/archive/"+filename)};if b!=""&&a!=b{result=append(result,oid)}};return result}
+
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/recovery.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/recovery.go
