+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(root, refName(c), old, oid); e != nil {
+		return "", coded("P02", "claim contention: %v", e)
+	}
+	return oid, nil
+}
+func state(root string, c project.Change, cl claim, oid string) (model.State, error) {
+	h, e := head(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	s := cl.Snapshot
+	s.Root = root
+	return model.State{Change: c, Snapshot: s, Run: cl.Run, Phase: cl.Phase, Head: h, PhaseBase: cl.Base, ClaimOID: oid}, nil
+}
+func freshState(root string, c project.Change, cl claim, oid string) (model.State, error) {
+	raw, e := read(root, changePath(c))
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	c.Document = d
+	c.Added, _ = items(d, "Added")
+	c.Modified, _ = items(d, "Modified")
+	c.Removed, _ = items(d, "Removed")
+	return state(root, c, cl, oid)
+}
+func items(d contracts.Document, section string) ([]contracts.Item, error) {
+	s, ok := contracts.Section(d.Body, section)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	return contracts.ParseItems(s)
+}
+func setFront(raw string, vals map[string]any) (string, error) {
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if d.Frontmatter == nil {
+		d.Frontmatter = map[string]any{}
+	}
+	for k, v := range vals {
+		if v == nil {
+			delete(d.Frontmatter, k)
+		} else {
+			d.Frontmatter[k] = v
+		}
+	}
+	return contracts.RenderDocument(d)
+}
+func phase(c project.Change) string {
+	p := str(c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"])
+	if p == "" {
+		return "queued"
+	}
+	return p
+}
+func runID() string {
+	return strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixNano(), 36) + "-" + strconv.Itoa(os.Getpid())
+}
+func unapprovedMetadata(raw, approved string, phase string) error {
+	a, e := contracts.ParseDocument(approved)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	b, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if e != nil {
+		return coded("P03", "change document malformed: %v", e)
+	}
+	if str(b.Frontmatter["phase"]) != phase || str(b.Frontmatter["run"]) != str(a.Frontmatter["run"]) {
+		return coded("P03", "approved run or phase changed")
+	}
+	for k, v := range a.Frontmatter {
+		if fmt.Sprintf("%#v", b.Frontmatter[k]) != fmt.Sprintf("%#v", v) {
+			if k == "audit_rounds" || k == "blocked" { return coded("P03", "approved audit state changed") }
+			if k == "run" || k == "phase" { return coded("P03", "approved run or phase changed") }
+			return coded("P03", "approved author metadata changed: %s", k)
+		}
+	}
+	for k := range b.Frontmatter {
+		if _, ok := a.Frontmatter[k]; !ok {
+			if k == "audit_rounds" || k == "blocked" { return coded("P03", "approved audit state changed") }
+			return coded("P03", "approved author metadata changed: %s", k)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, section := range []string{"Motivation", "Interface", "Added", "Modified", "Removed", "Removed decisions", "Provenance"} {
+		av, _ := contracts.Section(a.Body, section)
+		bv, _ := contracts.Section(b.Body, section)
+		if av != bv {
+			return coded("P03", "approved author metadata changed in %s", section)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func commitAll(root, subject string) (string, error) {
+	if _, e := command(root, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e := command(root, "commit", "-m", subject); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	return head(root)
+}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..3ee2d81fc9287d35c3d96c064f8b800db0996334
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go
@@ -0,0 +1,315 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+var findingRE = regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^- (?:\[untestable\] )?([A-Z]+-\d+): "([^"]+)"[^\n]*$`)
+var checkedRE = regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^Checked IDs:\s*([^\n]+)`)
+
+func auditSubmission(s model.State, raw string) (string, bool, error) {
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", false, coded("P09", "malformed audit submission: %v", e)
+	}
+	body, _ := contracts.Section(d.Body, "Audit")
+	body = strings.TrimSpace(body)
+	findings := []string{}
+	untestable := false
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(body, "\n") {
+		m := findingRE.FindStringSubmatch(line)
+		if m == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		valid := false
+		mod := moduleByName(s.Snapshot, s.Change.Module)
+		if mod != nil {
+			for _, spec := range moduleSpecs(*mod) {
+				if spec.ID == m[1] && strings.Contains(spec.Body, m[2]) {
+					valid = true
+					break
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if !valid {
+			continue
+		}
+		if integer(d.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]) > 0 {
+			cl,_,_:=loadClaim(s.Snapshot.Root,s.Change)
+			prior,_:=contracts.ParseDocument(cl.Approved)
+			approved, _ := contracts.Section(prior.Body, "Audit")
+			if !strings.Contains(approved, m[1]+":") {
+				continue
+			}
+		}
+		findings = append(findings, line)
+		if strings.Contains(line, "[untestable]") {
+			untestable = true
+		}
+	}
+	if len(findings) > 0 {
+		return contracts.ReplaceSection(raw, "Audit", strings.Join(findings, "\n")+"\n"), untestable, nil
+	}
+	checked := checkedRE.FindStringSubmatch(body)
+	if checked == nil || !strings.Contains(body, "No findings") {
+		return "", false, coded("P09", "audit requires Checked IDs and No findings")
+	}
+	ids := strings.FieldsFunc(checked[1], func(r rune) bool { return r == ',' || r == ' ' || r == '\t' })
+	required := changedIDs(s.Change)
+	required = append(required, stringSlice(s.Change.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])...)
+	for _, id := range required {
+		if !contains(ids, id) {
+			return "", false, coded("P09", "audit did not check %s", id)
+		}
+	}
+	return contracts.ReplaceSection(raw, "Audit", "No findings; checked "+strings.Join(ids, ", ")+"\n"), false, nil
+}
+func Done(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	r, e := verify(ctx, reqFull(req))
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	s := r.State
+	root := s.Snapshot.Root
+	c := s.Change
+	cl, oid, e := loadClaim(root, c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	raw, e := read(root, changePath(c))
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	next := ""
+	block := false
+	switch s.Phase {
+	case "evals":
+		next = "audit"
+		audit := configMap(s.Snapshot, "audit")
+		if audit["enabled"] == false {
+			next = "impl"
+		}
+	case "audit":
+		var untestable bool
+		raw, untestable, e = auditSubmission(s, raw)
+		if e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		a, _ := contracts.Section(raw, "Audit")
+		if strings.Contains(a, "No findings;") {
+			next = "impl"
+		} else {
+			max := 2
+			if n := integer(configMap(s.Snapshot, "audit")["max_rounds"]); n > 0 {
+				max = n
+			}
+			round := integer(c.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"])
+			if untestable || round >= max {
+				block = true
+				next = "audit"
+				reason := "audit findings exceeded round limit"
+				if untestable {
+					reason = "audit finding marked untestable"
+				}
+				raw, e = setFront(raw, map[string]any{"blocked": reason})
+				if e != nil {
+					return r, e
+				}
+				raw = contracts.ReplaceSection(raw, "Questions", a)
+			} else {
+				next = "evals"
+				raw, e = setFront(raw, map[string]any{"audit_rounds": round + 1})
+				if e != nil {
+					return r, e
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	case "impl":
+		next = "applied"
+	default:
+		return r, coded("P01", "unsupported phase %s", s.Phase)
+	}
+	if !block {
+		raw, e = setFront(raw, map[string]any{"phase": next})
+		if e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+	}
+	raw = appendProvenance(raw, s.Phase, req.Agent, r.Reports, c)
+	if next == "applied" {
+		pendingBefore, _ := read(root, changePath(c))
+		module := moduleByName(s.Snapshot, c.Module)
+		modulePath := ""
+		moduleBefore := ""
+		if module != nil {
+			modulePath = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(module.Dir, "SPEC.md"))
+			moduleBefore, _ = read(root, modulePath)
+		}
+		if e = applyModule(root, c); e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		archive := "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(changePath(c))
+		if e = write(root, archive, raw); e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		if e = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, changePath(c))); e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		for _, d := range project.Check(root) {
+			if !d.Warning {
+				if modulePath != "" {
+					_ = write(root, modulePath, moduleBefore)
+				}
+				_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, archive))
+				_ = write(root, changePath(c), pendingBefore)
+				return r, coded(d.Code, "%s", d.Message)
+			}
+		}
+	} else {
+		if e = write(root, changePath(c), raw); e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+	}
+	newHead, e := commitAll(root, "fireweed: "+c.Slug+" "+s.Phase+" -> "+next)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	cl.Base = newHead
+	cl.Phase = next
+	cl.Approved = raw
+	if next == "applied" || block {
+		_ = gitstore.CASRef(root, refName(c), oid, "")
+		r.State.ClaimOID = ""
+		if next == "applied" {
+			c.Path = "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(changePath(c))
+		}
+	} else {
+		oid, e = saveClaim(root, c, cl, oid)
+		if e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		r.State.ClaimOID = oid
+	}
+	r.State.Head = newHead
+	r.State.PhaseBase = newHead
+	r.State.Phase = next
+	r.State.Change = c
+	r.State.Change.Document, _ = contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if block {
+		return r, coded("P06", "change blocked: %s", str(r.State.Change.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]))
+	}
+	return r, nil
+}
+func reqFull(r model.Request) model.Request { r.Quick = false; return r }
+func appendProvenance(raw, phase, agent string, reports map[string]checks.Report, c project.Change) string {
+	if agent == "" {
+		agent = "manual"
+	}
+	playbook := phase
+	if phase == "impl" && c.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"] == true {
+		playbook = "regenerate"
+	}
+	pb, _ := assets.Playbook(playbook)
+	h := sha256.Sum256([]byte(pb))
+	total, pass, fail := 0, 0, 0
+	for _, report := range reports {
+		for _, tc := range report.Cases {
+			total++
+			if tc.Result == "pass" {
+				pass++
+			} else if tc.Result == "fail" || tc.Result == "error" {
+				fail++
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	line := fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d", phase, time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), agent, assets.Version(), hex.EncodeToString(h[:]), total, fail, pass)
+	old, _ := contracts.Section(raw, "Provenance")
+	return contracts.ReplaceSection(raw, "Provenance", strings.TrimSpace(old)+"\n"+line+"\n")
+}
+func applyModule(root string, c project.Change) error {
+	snap, e := project.Load(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	m := moduleByName(snap, c.Module)
+	if m == nil {
+		return coded("C01", "module %s missing", c.Module)
+	}
+	path := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir, "SPEC.md"))
+	raw, e := read(root, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	for k, v := range mapValue(c.Document.Frontmatter["set"]) {
+		if d.Frontmatter == nil {
+			d.Frontmatter = map[string]any{}
+		}
+		d.Frontmatter[k] = v
+	}
+	sec, _ := contracts.Section(d.Body, "Specs")
+	prior, _ := contracts.ParseItems(sec)
+	byID := map[string]contracts.Item{}
+	for _, x := range prior {
+		byID[x.ID] = x
+	}
+	for _, x := range c.Removed {
+		delete(byID, x.ID)
+	}
+	for _, x := range append(append([]contracts.Item{}, c.Added...), c.Modified...) {
+		byID[x.ID] = x
+	}
+	keys := []string{}
+	for id := range byID {
+		keys = append(keys, id)
+	}
+	sort.Strings(keys)
+	parts := []string{}
+	for _, id := range keys {
+		parts = append(parts, strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(byID[id])))
+	}
+	d.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(d.Body, "Specs", strings.Join(parts, "\n\n")+"\n")
+	decisions, _ := contracts.Section(d.Body, "Decisions")
+	removed, _ := contracts.Section(c.Document.Body, "Removed decisions")
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(removed, "\n") {
+		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+		if line != "" {
+			decisions = strings.ReplaceAll(decisions, line, "")
+		}
+	}
+	added, _ := contracts.Section(c.Document.Body, "Decisions")
+	added = strings.TrimSpace(added)
+	if added != "" {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(added, "\n") {
+			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+			if line != "" {
+				decisions += "\n- " + c.Slug + ": " + line
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	d.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(d.Body, "Decisions", strings.TrimSpace(decisions)+"\n")
+	rendered, e := contracts.RenderDocument(d)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return write(root, path, rendered)
+}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/prbody.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/prbody.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a884df6d5dde9953857d923ecae4a7f029563117
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/prbody.go
@@ -0,0 +1,284 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+type endpointConfigError struct{ error }
+
+func IsEndpointConfigError(err error) bool {
+	var target endpointConfigError
+	return errors.As(err, &target)
+}
+
+func PRBody(root, revisionRange string) (model.PRBodyReport, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, e
+	}
+	parts := strings.Split(revisionRange, "..")
+	if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] == "" {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", "invalid range %q", revisionRange)
+	}
+	a, e := command(r, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[0]+"^{commit}")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", "resolve range %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
+	}
+	b, e := command(r, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[1]+"^{commit}")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, coded("P01", "resolve range %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
+	}
+	snap, e := project.LoadAt(r, b)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, endpointConfigError{e}
+	}
+	var body strings.Builder
+	fmt.Fprintf(&body, "# Change summary\n\nRange: `%s..%s`\n\n", a, b)
+	changed, e := command(r, "diff", "--name-only", a, b, "--")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, e
+	}
+	touched := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, p := range strings.Split(changed, "\n") {
+		if strings.HasPrefix(p, "changes/") && strings.HasSuffix(p, ".md") {
+			touched[filepath.Base(p)] = true
+		}
+	}
+	list, e := command(r, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", b, "changes")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, e
+	}
+	selected := []project.Change{}
+	blocked := []string{}
+	for _, p := range strings.Split(list, "\n") {
+		if p == "" || !strings.HasSuffix(p, ".md") {
+			continue
+		}
+		data, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, b, p)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(data))
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		c := project.Change{Slug: slugFromPath(p), Path: p, Module: str(d.Frontmatter["module"]), Document: d}
+		c.Added, _ = items(d, "Added")
+		c.Modified, _ = items(d, "Modified")
+		c.Removed, _ = items(d, "Removed")
+		if str(d.Frontmatter["blocked"]) != "" && !strings.Contains(p, "/archive/") {
+			blocked = append(blocked, fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s", p, str(d.Frontmatter["blocked"])))
+		}
+		if touched[filepath.Base(p)] {
+			selected = append(selected, c)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(selected) == 0 {
+		body.WriteString("No selected changes.\n\n")
+	}
+	for _, c := range selected {
+		kind := "spec"
+		if len(stringSlice(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+			kind = "eval_fix"
+		} else if c.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"] == true {
+			kind = "regenerate"
+		} else if len(c.Added)+len(c.Modified)+len(c.Removed) == 0 {
+			kind = "maintenance"
+		}
+		fmt.Fprintf(&body, "## %s\n\nPath: `%s`  Module: %s  Kind: %s  audit_rounds: %d\n\n", c.Slug, c.Path, c.Module, kind, integer(c.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]))
+		prov, _ := contracts.Section(c.Document.Body, "Provenance")
+		body.WriteString("### Provenance\n\n" + prov + "\n")
+		for _, section := range []string{"Decisions", "Removed decisions"} {
+			content, _ := contracts.Section(c.Document.Body, section)
+			fmt.Fprintf(&body, "### %s\n\n%s\n", section, content)
+		}
+		for _, item := range append(append([]contracts.Item{}, c.Added...), c.Modified...) {
+			if strings.Contains(item.Tag, "review") {
+				fmt.Fprintf(&body, "- %s: %s\n", item.ID, strings.TrimSpace(item.Body))
+			}
+		}
+		commits := phaseCommitsAt(r, b, filepath.Base(c.Path))
+		seenFiles := map[string]bool{}
+		stubs:=map[string]bool{}
+		auditLines := map[string]bool{}
+		for _, oid := range commits {
+			parent, _ := command(r, "rev-parse", oid+"^")
+			if phaseAt(r,parent,"changes/"+filepath.Base(c.Path))=="evals"{
+				added,_:=command(r,"diff","--diff-filter=A","--name-only",parent,oid,"--")
+				for _,p:=range strings.Split(added,"\n"){stubs[p]=true}
+			}
+			diff, _ := command(r, "diff", "--name-only", parent, oid, "--")
+			for _, p := range strings.Split(diff, "\n") {
+				if p != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(p, "changes/") {
+					seenFiles[p] = true
+				}
+			}
+			for _, p := range []string{"changes/" + filepath.Base(c.Path), "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(c.Path)} {
+				raw, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, oid, p)
+				if e != nil {
+					continue
+				}
+				d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+				if e != nil {
+					continue
+				}
+				audit, _ := contracts.Section(d.Body, "Audit")
+				for _, line := range strings.Split(audit, "\n") {
+					if strings.HasPrefix(line, "- ") {
+						auditLines[line] = true
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if len(commits) == 0 {
+			for _, p := range strings.Split(changed, "\n") {
+				if !strings.HasPrefix(p, "changes/") && p != "" {
+					seenFiles[p] = true
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		files := []string{}
+		for p := range seenFiles {
+			files = append(files, p)
+		}
+		sort.Strings(files)
+		body.WriteString("### Files\n\n")
+		for _, p := range files {
+			category:="other file"
+			if filepath.Base(p)=="go.mod"||filepath.Base(p)=="SPEC.md"{category="module manifest"}
+			for _,m:=range snap.Modules{if m.Name==c.Module&&strings.HasPrefix(p,m.Dir+"/"){
+				zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(strings.TrimPrefix(p,m.Dir+"/"),m.Zones)
+				switch zone{case "evals":category="eval file";case "interface":category="interface edit";case "preserve":category="preserved file";case "disposable":category="disposable file";if stubs[p]{category="new disposable stub in evals"}}
+			}}
+			for _,pattern:=range stringSlice(snap.Config["worker_writable"]){if contracts.MatchGlob(pattern,p){category="worker_writable file"}}
+			body.WriteString("- `" + p + "` — "+category+"\n")
+		}
+		body.WriteString("\n### Audit findings\n\n")
+		lines := []string{}
+		for line := range auditLines {
+			lines = append(lines, line)
+		}
+		sort.Strings(lines)
+		for _, line := range lines {
+			body.WriteString(line + "\n")
+		}
+		body.WriteString("\n")
+	}
+	body.WriteString("## Exceptions\n\n")
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		for _, item := range moduleSpecs(m) {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(item.Tag, "quarantine:") {
+				fmt.Fprintf(&body, "- %s %s: %s\n", m.Name, item.ID, strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(item.Tag, "quarantine:")))
+			}
+		}
+		if reason := str(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]); reason != "" {
+			fmt.Fprintf(&body, "- %s boundary opt-out: %s\n", m.Name, reason)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, x := range blocked {
+		body.WriteString("- blocked " + x + "\n")
+	}
+	out := model.PRBodyReport{}
+	costs, _ := Costs(r)
+	latest := map[string]model.CostSnapshot{}
+	for _, record := range costs {
+		for _, m := range record.Modules {
+			latest[m.Module] = record
+		}
+	}
+	body.WriteString("\n## Costs\n\n| Module | Seconds | Cases per spec | Eval lines | Disposable lines |\n|---|---:|---|---:|---:|\n")
+	names := []string{}
+	for n := range latest {
+		names = append(names, n)
+	}
+	sort.Strings(names)
+	warned := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, name := range names {
+		record := latest[name]
+		for _, m := range record.Modules {
+			if m.Module != name {
+				continue
+			}
+			keys := []string{}
+			for id := range m.CasesPerSpec {
+				keys = append(keys, id)
+			}
+			sort.Strings(keys)
+			pairs := []string{}
+			for _, id := range keys {
+				pairs = append(pairs, fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d", id, m.CasesPerSpec[id]))
+			}
+			fmt.Fprintf(&body, "| %s | %g | %s | %d | %d |\n", name, m.Seconds, strings.Join(pairs, ", "), m.EvalLines, m.DisposableLines)
+		}
+		for _, d := range record.Diagnostics {
+			key := d.Code + "\x00" + d.Message
+			if !warned[key] {
+				out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, d)
+				warned[key] = true
+				fmt.Fprintf(&body, "\n- %s: %s", d.Code, d.Message)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	added, e := command(r, "diff", "--diff-filter=A", "--name-only", a, b, "--")
+	if e == nil {
+		for _, p := range strings.Split(added, "\n") {
+			for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+				if !strings.HasPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/") {
+					continue
+				}
+				rel := strings.TrimPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/")
+				if contracts.ResolveZone(rel, m.Zones) != "disposable" {
+					continue
+				}
+				data, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, b, p)
+				if e != nil {
+					continue
+				}
+				numstat,_:=command(r,"diff","--numstat",a,b,"--",p)
+				binary := strings.HasPrefix(numstat,"-\t-")
+				if !binary && len(data) <= 262144 {
+					continue
+				}
+				d := diag("B04", fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d bytes disposable artifact", p, len(data)), true)
+				out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, d)
+				fmt.Fprintf(&body, "\n- B04: %s\n", d.Message)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	out.Body = body.String()
+	return out, nil
+}
+func phaseCommitsAt(root, endpoint, filename string) []string {
+	out, _ := command(root, "rev-list", endpoint)
+	result := []string{}
+	for _, oid := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
+		if oid == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		parent, e := command(root, "rev-parse", oid+"^")
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		a := phaseAt(root, parent, "changes/"+filename)
+		if a == "" {
+			a = phaseAt(root, parent, "changes/archive/"+filename)
+		}
+		b := phaseAt(root, oid, "changes/"+filename)
+		if b == "" {
+			b = phaseAt(root, oid, "changes/archive/"+filename)
+		}
+		if b != "" && a != b {
+			result = append(result, oid)
+		}
+	}
+	return result
+}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/recovery.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/recovery.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..1c99ed5bb5d1d2538e2e5a2e86606e23a88152f5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/recovery.go
@@ -0,0 +1,244 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func Block(req model.BlockRequest) (model.BlockResult, error) {
+	s, e := Current(req.Root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	root := s.Snapshot.Root
+	c := s.Change
+	cl, oid, e := loadClaim(root, c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if h, _ := head(root); h != cl.Base {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, coded("P05", "stale phase base: HEAD changed")
+	}
+	raw, e := read(root, changePath(c))
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	if e = unapprovedMetadata(raw, cl.Approved, cl.Phase); e != nil {
+		return model.BlockResult{}, e
+	}
+	for n := 1; ; n++ {
+		ref := fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d", c.Slug, n)
+		if _, ok, _ := gitstore.Ref(root, ref); ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		if _, e = command(root, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+			return model.BlockResult{}, e
+		}
+		tree, e := command(root, "write-tree")
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.BlockResult{}, e
+		}
+		attemptOID, e := commandInput(root, nil, "commit-tree", tree, "-p", cl.Base, "-m", "fireweed attempt "+c.Slug)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.BlockResult{}, e
+		}
+		if e = gitstore.CASRef(root, ref, "", attemptOID); e != nil {
+			return model.BlockResult{}, e
+		}
+		if _, e = command(root, "reset", "--hard", cl.Base); e != nil {
+			return model.BlockResult{}, e
+		}
+		if _, e = command(root, "clean", "-fd"); e != nil {
+			return model.BlockResult{}, e
+		}
+		blocked, e := setFront(cl.Approved, map[string]any{"blocked": req.Reason})
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.BlockResult{}, e
+		}
+		if e = write(root, changePath(c), blocked); e != nil {
+			return model.BlockResult{}, e
+		}
+		h, e := commitAll(root, "fireweed: block "+c.Slug)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.BlockResult{}, e
+		}
+		_ = gitstore.CASRef(root, refName(c), oid, "")
+		s.Head = h
+		s.PhaseBase = h
+		s.ClaimOID = ""
+		s.Change.Document, _ = contracts.ParseDocument(blocked)
+		return model.BlockResult{State: s, AttemptRef: ref, AttemptOID: attemptOID}, nil
+	}
+}
+func restoreAttempt(root string, c interface{}, n int, cl claim) error {
+	// The saved tree is compared to its original phase base so later independent commits survive.
+	change := cl.Change
+	slug := slugFromPath(change)
+	ref := fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d", slug, n)
+	// git diff between the first parent and the attempt includes additions and deletions.
+	parent, e := command(root, "rev-parse", ref+"^")
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	diff, e := command(root, "diff", "--name-status", parent, ref, "--")
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(diff, "\n") {
+		fields := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(fields) < 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		path := fields[len(fields)-1]
+		if path == change {
+			savedBytes, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root,ref,path)
+			if e != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			saved:=string(savedBytes)
+			current, e := read(root, path)
+			if e != nil {
+				return e
+			}
+			for _, section := range []string{"Decisions", "Questions"} {
+				body, ok := contracts.Section(saved, section)
+				if ok {
+					current = contracts.ReplaceSection(current, section, body)
+				}
+			}
+			if cl.Phase == "audit" {
+				body, ok := contracts.Section(saved, "Audit")
+				if ok {
+					current = contracts.ReplaceSection(current, "Audit", body)
+				}
+			}
+			if e = write(root, path, current); e != nil {
+				return e
+			}
+			continue
+		}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(fields[0], "D") {
+			_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path)))
+			continue
+		}
+		b, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, ref, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		p := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path))
+		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		if e = os.WriteFile(p, b, 0644); e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func Abandon(root, selector string) (string, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	c, e := selectChange(r, selector, true)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if strings.Contains(changePath(c), "/archive/") {
+		return "", coded("P01", "applied change cannot be abandoned")
+	}
+	if bad, e := dirty(r); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	} else if bad {
+		return "", coded("P01", "dirty worktree")
+	}
+	cl, oid, claimErr := loadClaim(r, c)
+	if claimErr != nil && (!strings.Contains(claimErr.Error(), "has no claim")) {
+		return "", claimErr
+	}
+	_ = cl
+	commits, e := Commits(r, changePath(c))
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if len(commits) > 0 {
+		args := append([]string{"revert", "--no-commit"}, commits...)
+		if _, e = command(r, args...); e != nil {
+			return "", e
+		}
+	}
+	if e = os.Remove(filepath.Join(r, changePath(c))); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	h, e := commitAll(r, "fireweed: abandon "+c.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if oid != "" {
+		_ = gitstore.CASRef(r, refName(c), oid, "")
+	}
+	return h, nil
+}
+func Commits(root, selector string) ([]string, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	c, e := selectChange(r, selector, true)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	filename := filepath.Base(changePath(c))
+	out, e := command(r, "rev-list", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	commits := []string{}
+	for _, oid := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
+		if oid == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		parents, e := command(r, "rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", oid)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		fields := strings.Fields(parents)
+		if len(fields) < 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		parent := fields[1]
+		path := "changes/" + filename
+		archive := "changes/archive/" + filename
+		current := phaseAt(r, oid, path)
+		if current == "" {
+			current = phaseAt(r, oid, archive)
+		}
+		previous := phaseAt(r, parent, path)
+		if previous == "" {
+			previous = phaseAt(r, parent, archive)
+		}
+		if current != "" && current != previous {
+			commits = append(commits, oid)
+		}
+	}
+	return commits, nil
+}
+func phaseAt(root, rev, path string) string {
+	b, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, rev, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return ""
+	}
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
+	if e != nil {
+		return ""
+	}
+	return str(d.Frontmatter["phase"])
+}
+func attemptNumber(ref string) int { n, _ := strconv.Atoi(filepath.Base(ref)); return n }
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/start.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/start.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e248e958fe8662d34b0b97cf5d145ffdded6426e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/start.go
@@ -0,0 +1,471 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func waitingFor(root string, queue []project.Change, i int) (string, string, error) {
+	c := queue[i]
+	if phase(c) == "blocked" || str(c.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) != "" {
+		return "", "", nil
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Project(root, c.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", "", e
+	}
+	deps := map[string][]string{}
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		deps[m.Name] = m.DependsOn
+	}
+	var depends func(string, string, map[string]bool) bool
+	depends = func(a, b string, seen map[string]bool) bool {
+		if seen[a] {
+			return false
+		}
+		seen[a] = true
+		for _, d := range deps[a] {
+			if d == b || depends(d, b, seen) {
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+		return false
+	}
+	iface, _ := contracts.Section(c.Document.Body, "Interface")
+	for _, prev := range queue[:i] {
+		if str(prev.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if c.Module == prev.Module {
+			return prev.Slug, "same_module", nil
+		}
+		if depends(c.Module, prev.Module, map[string]bool{}) {
+			return prev.Slug, "depends_on_blocked", nil
+		}
+		if strings.TrimSpace(iface) != "" && depends(prev.Module, c.Module, map[string]bool{}) {
+			return prev.Slug, "interface_dependency", nil
+		}
+	}
+	return "", "", nil
+}
+func Eligible(root string) ([]project.Change, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	q, e := project.Queue(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []project.Change{}
+	for i, c := range q {
+		if str(c.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) != "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		w, _, e := waitingFor(r, q, i)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		if w == "" {
+			out = append(out, c)
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+
+func Start(root, selector string) (model.State, error) { return start(root, selector, 0, false) }
+func StartFromAttempt(root, selector string, attempt int) (model.State, error) {
+	return start(root, selector, attempt, true)
+}
+func start(root, selector string, attempt int, resume bool) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if resume && attempt <= 0 {
+		return model.State{}, coded("P01", "invalid attempt %d", attempt)
+	}
+	if selector != "" {
+		if _, e = selectChange(r, selector, false); e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	}
+	bad, e := dirty(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if bad {
+		return model.State{}, coded("P01", "start requires clean worktree")
+	}
+	eligible, e := Eligible(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, classifyStale(e)
+	}
+	if len(eligible) == 0 {
+		return model.State{}, coded("P01", "no eligible change")
+	}
+	c := eligible[0]
+	if selector != "" {
+		selected, _ := selectChange(r, selector, false)
+		if selected.Path != c.Path {
+			return model.State{}, coded("P01", "change is not eligible queue head: %s", selector)
+		}
+	}
+	if resume {
+		ref := fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d", c.Slug, attempt)
+		if _, ok, _ := gitstore.Ref(r, ref); !ok {
+			return model.State{}, coded("P01", "saved attempt %s not found", ref)
+		}
+	}
+	if _, ok, _ := gitstore.Ref(r, refName(c)); ok {
+		return model.State{}, coded("P02", "claim already held: update-ref %s", refName(c))
+	}
+	if !resume {
+		if err := unapprovedLimit(r); err != nil {
+			return model.State{Diagnostics:[]project.Diagnostic{diag("P07",err.Error(),false)}}, err
+		}
+	}
+	h, e := head(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	unstarted := phase(c) == "queued"
+	raw, e := read(r, changePath(c))
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if !resume && phase(c) == "queued" {
+		prefix := ""
+		for _, m := range mustLoad(r).Modules {
+			if m.Name == c.Module {
+				prefix = m.IDPrefix
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if prefix != "" {
+			raw = allocateIDs(r, c, raw, prefix)
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		p := "impl"
+		added, _ := items(d, "Added")
+		modified, _ := items(d, "Modified")
+		removed, _ := items(d, "Removed")
+		if len(added)+len(modified)+len(removed) > 0 || len(stringSlice(d.Frontmatter["fixes"])) > 0 || len(stringSlice(d.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+			p = "evals"
+		}
+		if d.Frontmatter["regenerate"] == true {
+			p = "impl"
+		}
+		raw, e = setFront(raw, map[string]any{"phase": p, "run": runID()})
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		c.Document, _ = contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	} else {
+		c.Document, _ = contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	}
+	// Projection validates recorded bases and captures the exact graph approved for the claim.
+	if rawOnDisk, _ := read(r, changePath(c)); rawOnDisk != raw {
+		if e = write(r, changePath(c), raw); e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Project(r, c.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		if raw != "" {
+			_, _ = command(r, "checkout", "--", changePath(c))
+		}
+		return model.State{}, classifyStale(e)
+	}
+	snap.Root = r
+	if resume || phase(c) != "queued" {
+		if clPhase := str(c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]); clPhase == "" {
+			return model.State{}, coded("P01", "saved phase missing")
+		}
+	}
+	cl := claim{Worktree: r, Change: changePath(c), Run: str(c.Document.Frontmatter["run"]), Phase: str(c.Document.Frontmatter["phase"]), Base: h, Approved: raw, Snapshot: snap}
+	if cl.Run == "" {
+		cl.Run = runID()
+		raw, e = setFront(raw, map[string]any{"run": cl.Run})
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		cl.Approved = raw
+		_ = write(r, changePath(c), raw)
+	}
+	oid, e := saveClaim(r, c, cl, "")
+	if e != nil {
+		_, _ = command(r, "checkout", "--", changePath(c))
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if resume {
+		if e = restoreAttempt(r, c, attempt, cl); e != nil {
+			_ = gitstore.CASRef(r, refName(c), oid, "")
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	}
+	if !resume && unstarted && c.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"] == true {
+		for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+			if m.Name == c.Module {
+				_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(r, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+					if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
+						return nil
+					}
+					rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(r, m.Dir), path)
+					if contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones) == "disposable" {
+						_ = os.Remove(path)
+					}
+					return nil
+				})
+				break
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	s, e := freshState(r, c, cl, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	if !resume {
+		approvalWarnings(r, c, snap, &s)
+	}
+	return s, nil
+}
+func mustLoad(root string) project.Snapshot { s, _ := project.Load(root); return s }
+func classifyStale(e error) error {
+	if e == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if strings.Contains(e.Error(), "stale base") {
+		return coded("P05", "%v", e)
+	}
+	return e
+}
+func allocateIDs(root string, c project.Change, raw, prefix string) string {
+	re := regexp.MustCompile(`new:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`)
+	handles := []string{}
+	seen := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, h := range re.FindAllString(raw, -1) {
+		if !seen[h] {
+			handles = append(handles, h)
+			seen[h] = true
+		}
+	}
+	if len(handles) == 0 {
+		return raw
+	}
+	max := 0
+	for _, m := range mustLoad(root).Modules {
+		if m.Name != c.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		section, _ := contracts.Section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")
+		specs, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section)
+		for _, s := range specs {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(s.ID, prefix+"-") {
+				var n int
+				fmt.Sscanf(s.ID, prefix+"-%d", &n)
+				if n > max {
+					max = n
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	q, _ := project.Queue(root)
+	for _, x := range q {
+		for _, s := range append(append([]contracts.Item{}, x.Added...), x.Modified...) {
+			var n int
+			if _, e := fmt.Sscanf(s.ID, prefix+"-%d", &n); e == nil && n > max {
+				max = n
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, h := range handles {
+		max++
+		raw = strings.ReplaceAll(raw, h, fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d", prefix, max))
+	}
+	return raw
+}
+func approvalWarnings(root string, c project.Change, snap project.Snapshot, s *model.State) {
+	base := configString(snap, "base")
+	if base == "" {
+		base = "main"
+	}
+	local, _ := gitstore.BaseRef(root, "", base)
+	shared, _ := gitstore.BaseRef(root, "origin", base)
+	approved := false
+	for _, rev := range []string{local, shared} {
+		if rev == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if _, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, rev, changePath(c)); e == nil {
+			approved = true
+		}
+	}
+	if !approved { s.Diagnostics = append(s.Diagnostics, diag("P04", "change absent from local and shared base", true)) }
+	if c.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"] == true {
+		latest := time.Time{}
+		all, _ := allChanges(root, true)
+		for _, change := range all {
+			if change.Module == c.Module && phase(change) == "applied" {
+				d := implDate(change.Document.Body)
+				if d.After(latest) {
+					latest = d
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		drill := latestDrill(root, c.Module)
+		report, _ := read(root, ".fireweed/drills/"+c.Module+".md")
+		doc, _ := contracts.ParseDocument(report)
+		if !drill.After(latest) || str(doc.Frontmatter["result"]) != "pass" {
+			s.Diagnostics = append(s.Diagnostics, diag("P10", "no newer passing drill for regenerate", true))
+		}
+	}
+}
+func unapprovedLimit(root string) error {
+	snap, e := project.Load(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	limit := 5
+	if n := integer(configMap(snap, "authoring")["max_unapproved"]); n > 0 {
+		limit = n
+	}
+	base := configString(snap, "base")
+	if base == "" {
+		base = "main"
+	}
+	remote := configString(snap, "remote")
+	if remote == "" {
+		remote = "origin"
+	}
+	rev, e := command(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	all, _ := allChanges(root, true)
+	count := 0
+	for _, c := range all {
+		if !strings.Contains(changePath(c), "/archive/") || phase(c) != "applied" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if _, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, rev, changePath(c)); e != nil {
+			if _,pendingErr:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,rev,"changes/"+filepath.Base(changePath(c)));pendingErr!=nil{count++}
+		}
+	}
+	if count >= limit {
+		return coded("P07", "unapproved archive count %d reaches limit %d", count, limit)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func Current(root, selector string) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if selector == "" {
+		q, e := project.Queue(r)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		for _, c := range q {
+			if cl, oid, e := loadClaim(r, c); e == nil {
+				return freshState(r, c, cl, oid)
+			}
+		}
+		return model.State{}, coded("P02", "change has no claim")
+	}
+	c, e := selectChange(r, selector, false)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	cl, oid, e := loadClaim(r, c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	return freshState(r, c, cl, oid)
+}
+func Release(root, selector string) error {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	c, e := selectChange(r, selector, false)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	_, oid, e := loadClaim(r, c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return gitstore.CASRef(r, refName(c), oid, "")
+}
+func Context(root, selector string, full bool) (string, error) {
+	st, err := Current(root, selector)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	raw, _ := read(st.Snapshot.Root, changePath(st.Change))
+	var b strings.Builder
+	b.WriteString("# Change\n\n" + raw + "\n")
+	for _, m := range st.Snapshot.Modules {
+		if m.Name != st.Change.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		b.WriteString("\n# Projected spec\n\n" + m.Document.Body + "\n")
+		for _, pattern := range m.Zones.Interface {
+			matches, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(st.Snapshot.Root, m.Dir, pattern))
+			sort.Strings(matches)
+			for _, path := range matches {
+				data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+				if err == nil {
+					b.WriteString("\n# " + path + "\n\n" + string(data) + "\n")
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	sys, _ := read(st.Snapshot.Root, "SYSTEM.md")
+	b.WriteString("\n# SYSTEM\n\n" + sys + "\n")
+	playbook := st.Phase
+	if st.Phase == "impl" && st.Change.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"] == true {
+		playbook = "regenerate"
+	}
+	pb, _ := assets.Playbook(playbook)
+	b.WriteString("\n# Playbook\n\n" + pb + "\n")
+	_ = filepath.WalkDir(st.Snapshot.Root, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+		if err != nil || d.IsDir() || strings.Contains(path, string(filepath.Separator)+".git"+string(filepath.Separator)) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(st.Snapshot.Root, path)
+		if rel == changePath(st.Change) || rel == "SYSTEM.md" {
+			return nil
+		}
+		info, err := d.Info()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if full {
+			data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+			if err == nil {
+				b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n# %s (%d bytes)\n\n%s\n", rel, info.Size(), data))
+			}
+		} else {
+			b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s %d bytes\n", rel, info.Size()))
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+	return b.String(), nil
+}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/status_gc.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/status_gc.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a71282cd87b3b78faccb662d275d09d49a228640
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/status_gc.go
@@ -0,0 +1,263 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func Status(root string) (model.StatusReport, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.StatusReport{}, e
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Load(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.StatusReport{}, e
+	}
+	q, e := project.Queue(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.StatusReport{}, e
+	}
+	out := model.StatusReport{Modules: snap.Modules, Queue: []model.StatusEntry{}, Quarantines: []model.Quarantine{}, BoundaryOptOuts: []model.BoundaryOptOut{}, DriftSinceDrill: map[string]int{}, PhaseCommits: map[string]int{}, Costs: []model.ModuleCost{}}
+	for i, c := range q {
+		entry := model.StatusEntry{Slug: c.Slug, Path: c.Path, Module: c.Module, Phase: phase(c), Blocked: str(c.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]), AuditRounds: integer(c.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"])}
+		entry.WaitingOn, entry.WaitingRule, _ = waitingFor(r, q, i)
+		out.Queue = append(out.Queue, entry)
+	}
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		for _, spec := range moduleSpecs(m) {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(spec.Tag, "quarantine:") {
+				out.Quarantines = append(out.Quarantines, model.Quarantine{Module: m.Name, ID: spec.ID, Reason: strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(spec.Tag, "quarantine:"))})
+			}
+		}
+		if reason := str(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]); reason != "" {
+			out.BoundaryOptOuts = append(out.BoundaryOptOuts, model.BoundaryOptOut{Module: m.Name, Reason: reason})
+		}
+		out.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name] = 0
+	}
+	archive, _ := allChanges(r, true)
+	applied := []struct {
+		c project.Change
+		t time.Time
+	}{}
+	for _, c := range archive {
+		if !strings.Contains(changePath(c), "/archive/") || phase(c) != "applied" {
+			continue
+		}
+		d := implDate(c.Document.Body)
+		applied = append(applied, struct {
+			c project.Change
+			t time.Time
+		}{c, d})
+		out.PhaseCommits[strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(changePath(c)), ".md")], _ = countCommits(r, c)
+	}
+	sort.Slice(applied, func(i, j int) bool {
+		if applied[i].t.Equal(applied[j].t) {
+			return applied[i].c.Path < applied[j].c.Path
+		}
+		return applied[i].t.After(applied[j].t)
+	})
+	for _, x := range applied {
+		drill := latestDrill(r, x.c.Module)
+		if x.t.After(drill) {
+			out.DriftSinceDrill[x.c.Module]++
+		}
+	}
+	if len(applied) >= 3 {
+		module := applied[0].c.Module
+		n := 0
+		for _, x := range applied {
+			if x.c.Module != module {
+				break
+			}
+			n++
+		}
+		if n >= 3 {
+			out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, diag("P08", fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d consecutive applied changes", module, n), true))
+		}
+	}
+	base := configString(snap, "base")
+	if base == "" {
+		base = "main"
+	}
+	remote := configString(snap, "remote")
+	if remote == "" {
+		remote = "origin"
+	}
+	rev, err := gitstore.BaseRef(r, remote, base)
+	if err != nil || rev == "" {
+		rev, _ = gitstore.BaseRef(r, "", base)
+	}
+	for _, x := range applied {
+		if rev == "" {
+			out.Unapproved++
+			continue
+		}
+		if _, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, rev, changePath(x.c)); e != nil {
+			pending:="changes/"+filepath.Base(changePath(x.c))
+			if _,pendingErr:=gitstore.ReadAt(r,rev,pending);pendingErr!=nil{out.Unapproved++}
+		}
+	}
+	costs, _ := Costs(r)
+	latest := map[string]model.CostSnapshot{}
+	for _, snapshot := range costs {
+		for _, c := range snapshot.Modules {
+			latest[c.Module] = snapshot
+		}
+	}
+	names := []string{}
+	for name := range latest {
+		names = append(names, name)
+	}
+	sort.Strings(names)
+	warnings := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, name := range names {
+		snap := latest[name]
+		for _, c := range snap.Modules {
+			if c.Module == name {
+				out.Costs = append(out.Costs, c)
+			}
+		}
+		for _, d := range snap.Diagnostics {
+			key := d.Code + "\x00" + d.Message
+			if !warnings[key] {
+				out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, d)
+				warnings[key] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func countCommits(root string, c project.Change) (int, error) {
+	x, e := Commits(root, changePath(c))
+	return len(x), e
+}
+func implDate(body string) time.Time {
+	p, _ := contracts.Section(body, "Provenance")
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(p, "\n") {
+		fields := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(fields) >= 3 && fields[0] == "-" && fields[1] == "impl" {
+			d, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, fields[2])
+			return d
+		}
+	}
+	return time.Time{}
+}
+func latestDrill(root, module string) time.Time {
+	raw, e := read(root, ".fireweed/drills/"+module+".md")
+	if e != nil {
+		return time.Time{}
+	}
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if e != nil {
+		return time.Time{}
+	}
+	if date, ok := d.Frontmatter["date"].(time.Time); ok {
+		return date
+	}
+	value := str(d.Frontmatter["date"])
+	for _, layout := range []string{time.RFC3339Nano, "2006-01-02 15:04:05 +0000 UTC"} {
+		if date, e := time.Parse(layout, value); e == nil {
+			return date
+		}
+	}
+	return time.Time{}
+}
+
+func GC(ctx context.Context, req model.GCRequest) (model.GCResult, error) {
+	_ = ctx
+	r, e := rootOf(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.GCResult{}, e
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Load(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.GCResult{}, e
+	}
+	age := 720 * time.Hour
+	if v := str(configMap(snap, "gc")["drill_max_age"]); v != "" {
+		age, e = time.ParseDuration(v)
+		if e != nil || age <= 0 {
+			return model.GCResult{}, coded("C01", "invalid gc.drill_max_age %q", v)
+		}
+	}
+	now := req.Now
+	if now.IsZero() {
+		now = time.Now().UTC()
+	}
+	refs, e := command(r, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname) %(objectname)", "refs/fireweed")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.GCResult{}, e
+	}
+	registered := map[string]bool{}
+	wt, e := command(r, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
+	if e == nil {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(wt, "\n") {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "worktree ") {
+				p := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "worktree ")
+				p, _ = filepath.EvalSymlinks(p)
+				registered[p] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	archive := map[string]bool{}
+	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(r, "changes", "archive"))
+	for _, d := range entries {
+		if !d.IsDir() && strings.HasSuffix(d.Name(), ".md") {
+			archive[slugFromPath(d.Name())] = true
+		}
+	}
+	result := model.GCResult{Pruned: []string{}}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(refs, "\n") {
+		fields := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(fields) != 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		name, oid := fields[0], fields[1]
+		prune := false
+		switch {
+		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/claims/"):
+			b, e := gitstore.ReadBlob(r, oid)
+			if e == nil {
+				var data struct {
+					Worktree string `json:"worktree"`
+				}
+				if json.Unmarshal(b, &data) == nil {
+					p, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(data.Worktree)
+					prune = !registered[p]
+				}
+			}
+		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/attempts/"):
+			parts := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/attempts/"), "/")
+			if len(parts) == 2 {
+				n, e := strconv.Atoi(parts[1])
+				prune = e == nil && n > 0 && archive[parts[0]]
+			}
+		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/drills/"):
+			parts := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/drills/"), "/")
+			if len(parts) == 2 {
+				d, e := time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000", parts[1])
+				prune = e == nil && d.Before(now.Add(-age))
+			}
+		}
+		if prune {
+			if e := gitstore.CASRef(r, name, oid, ""); e == nil {
+				result.Pruned = append(result.Pruned, name)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(result.Pruned)
+	return result, nil
+}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/verify.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/verify.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cdebd8e01a066c0a54c5b40b09bb9185a1e6d2b4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/verify.go
@@ -0,0 +1,390 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func Verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) { return verify(ctx, req) }
+func verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	s, e := Current(req.Root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.Result{}, e
+	}
+	r := s.Snapshot.Root
+	c := s.Change
+	result := model.Result{State: s, Reports: map[string]checks.Report{}}
+	if s.Phase != "evals" && s.Phase != "audit" && s.Phase != "impl" {
+		return result, coded("P01", "unsupported phase %s", s.Phase)
+	}
+	cl, _, e := loadClaim(r, c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	if h, _ := head(r); h != cl.Base {
+		return result, coded("P05", "stale phase base: HEAD %s differs from %s", h, cl.Base)
+	}
+	raw, e := read(r, changePath(c))
+	if e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	if e = unapprovedMetadata(raw, cl.Approved, cl.Phase); e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	for _, d := range project.Check(r) {
+		if !d.Warning && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message), "stale base") {
+			return result, coded("P05", "%s", d.Message)
+		}
+	}
+	if s.Phase == "audit" {
+		normalized, block, e := auditSubmission(s, raw)
+		_ = normalized
+		_ = block
+		return result, e
+	}
+	changes, e := workChanges(r, cl.Base)
+	if e != nil {
+		return result, e
+	}
+	iface, _ := contracts.Section(c.Document.Body, "Interface")
+	if len(stringSlice(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+		for _, ch := range changes {
+			if ch.Path == changePath(c) {
+				continue
+			}
+			allowed := false
+			for _, m := range s.Snapshot.Modules {
+				if m.Name == c.Module && strings.HasPrefix(ch.Path, m.Dir+"/") {
+					z := contracts.ResolveZone(strings.TrimPrefix(ch.Path, m.Dir+"/"), m.Zones)
+					allowed = s.Phase == "evals" && z == "evals"
+				}
+			}
+			if !allowed {
+				return result, coded("Z01", "eval_fix forbids %s during %s", ch.Path, s.Phase)
+			}
+		}
+	} else {
+		ds := checks.Zones(checks.ZoneRequest{Snapshot: s.Snapshot, Module: c.Module, Phase: s.Phase, ChangePath: changePath(c), Base: cl.Base, InterfaceDeclared: strings.TrimSpace(iface) != "", Changes: changes})
+		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ds...)
+		for _, d := range ds {
+			if !d.Warning {
+				return result, coded(d.Code, "%s", d.Message)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	mod := moduleByName(s.Snapshot, c.Module)
+	if mod == nil {
+		return result, coded("C01", "unknown module %s", c.Module)
+	}
+	modules := []string{c.Module}
+	if s.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
+		mode := configString(s.Snapshot, "verify_dependents")
+		if mode == "" {
+			mode = "direct"
+		}
+		for _, m := range s.Snapshot.Modules {
+			if m.Name == c.Module {
+				continue
+			}
+			if mode == "all" && dependsOn(s.Snapshot, m.Name, c.Module) || mode == "direct" && contains(m.DependsOn, c.Module) {
+				modules = append(modules, m.Name)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	var firstErr error
+	for _, name := range modules {
+		report, hookErr := checks.Evaluate(ctx, checks.HookRequest{Snapshot: s.Snapshot, Module: name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		result.Reports[name] = report
+		_ = saveReport(r,s.Run,s.Phase,name,report)
+		if hookErr != nil && firstErr == nil {
+			firstErr = hookErr
+		}
+		m := moduleByName(s.Snapshot, name)
+		if m == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		specs := moduleSpecs(*m)
+		if name == c.Module {
+			if ce := checks.RequireCoverage(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
+				firstErr = ce
+			}
+		}
+		if s.Phase == "evals" && name == c.Module {
+			if ids := stringSlice(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"]); len(ids) > 0 {
+				for _, id := range ids {
+					covered := false
+					for _, tc := range report.Cases {
+						if contains(tc.IDs, id) {
+							covered = true
+						}
+					}
+					if !covered && firstErr == nil {
+						firstErr = coded("E01", "eval_fix missing testcase for %s", id)
+					}
+				}
+				if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
+					firstErr = ce
+				}
+			} else {
+				if ce := checks.RequireFailFirst(report, changedIDs(c), stringSlice(c.Document.Frontmatter["already_satisfied"])); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
+					firstErr = ce
+				}
+			}
+		} else if s.Phase == "impl" {
+			if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && firstErr == nil {
+				firstErr = ce
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	result.Costs = measureCosts(s, modules, result.Reports)
+	result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, budgetWarnings(s.Snapshot, result.Costs)...)
+	_ = saveCosts(r, model.CostSnapshot{Run: s.Run, Phase: s.Phase, RecordedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Modules: result.Costs, Diagnostics: budgetOnly(result.Diagnostics)})
+	if firstErr != nil {
+		return result, firstErr
+	}
+	if s.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
+		ds, e := checks.Boundaries(ctx, checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: s.Snapshot, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ds...)
+		if e != nil {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(e.Error(),"X02:")||strings.HasPrefix(e.Error(),"X01:"){return result,e}
+			code:="X02";for _,d:=range ds{if d.Code!=""{code=d.Code;break}}
+			return result,coded(code,"%v",e)
+		}
+		for _, d := range ds {
+			if !d.Warning {
+				return result, coded(d.Code, "%s", d.Message)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return result, nil
+}
+func moduleByName(s project.Snapshot, name string) *project.Module {
+	for i := range s.Modules {
+		if s.Modules[i].Name == name {
+			return &s.Modules[i]
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func moduleSpecs(m project.Module) []contracts.Item {
+	s, _ := contracts.Section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")
+	items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(s)
+	return items
+}
+func changedIDs(c project.Change) []string {
+	ids := []string{}
+	for _, x := range append(append([]contracts.Item{}, c.Added...), c.Modified...) {
+		ids = append(ids, x.ID)
+	}
+	ids = append(ids, stringSlice(c.Document.Frontmatter["fixes"])...)
+	return ids
+}
+func contains(a []string, b string) bool {
+	for _, x := range a {
+		if x == b {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
+func dependsOn(s project.Snapshot, a, b string) bool {
+	seen := map[string]bool{}
+	var walk func(string) bool
+	walk = func(x string) bool {
+		if seen[x] {
+			return false
+		}
+		seen[x] = true
+		m := moduleByName(s, x)
+		if m == nil {
+			return false
+		}
+		for _, dep := range m.DependsOn {
+			if dep == b || walk(dep) {
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+		return false
+	}
+	return walk(a)
+}
+func workChanges(root, base string) ([]gitstore.Change, error) {
+	out, e := command(root, "diff", "--name-status", base, "--")
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	result := []gitstore.Change{}
+	seen := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
+		fields := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(fields) < 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		p := fields[len(fields)-1]
+		result = append(result, gitstore.Change{Path: p, Status: fields[0]})
+		seen[p] = true
+	}
+	untracked, e := command(root, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard")
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	for _, p := range strings.Split(untracked, "\n") {
+		if p != "" && !seen[p] {
+			result = append(result, gitstore.Change{Path: p, Status: "A"})
+		}
+	}
+	return result, nil
+}
+func measureCosts(s model.State, modules []string, reports map[string]checks.Report) []model.ModuleCost {
+	out := []model.ModuleCost{}
+	for _, name := range modules {
+		m := moduleByName(s.Snapshot, name)
+		if m == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		cost := model.ModuleCost{Module: name, CasesPerSpec: map[string]int{}}
+		for _, tc := range reports[name].Cases {
+			cost.Seconds += tc.Seconds
+			seen := map[string]bool{}
+			for _, id := range tc.IDs {
+				if !seen[id] {
+					cost.CasesPerSpec[id]++
+					seen[id] = true
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root, m.Dir), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+			if e != nil || d.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			info, e := d.Info()
+			if e != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			rel, e := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(s.Snapshot.Root, m.Dir), path)
+			if e != nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			zone := contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones)
+			if zone != "evals" && zone != "disposable" {
+				return nil
+			}
+			data, e := os.ReadFile(path)
+			if e != nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			n := strings.Count(string(data), "\n")
+			if len(data) > 0 && data[len(data)-1] != '\n' {
+				n++
+			}
+			if zone == "evals" {
+				cost.EvalLines += n
+			} else {
+				cost.DisposableLines += n
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+		out = append(out, cost)
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func budgetWarnings(s project.Snapshot, costs []model.ModuleCost) []project.Diagnostic {
+	b := configMap(s, "budgets")
+	limit := 15 * time.Minute
+	if v := str(b["verify_time"]); v != "" {
+		if d, e := time.ParseDuration(v); e == nil {
+			limit = d
+		}
+	}
+	cases := 15
+	if n := integer(b["cases_per_spec"]); n > 0 {
+		cases = n
+	}
+	ratio := 4.0
+	if v := str(b["eval_ratio"]); v != "" {
+		_, _ = fmt.Sscanf(v, "%f", &ratio)
+	}
+	ds := []project.Diagnostic{}
+	total := 0.0
+	for _, c := range costs {
+		total += c.Seconds
+		keys := []string{}
+		for id := range c.CasesPerSpec {
+			keys = append(keys, id)
+		}
+		sort.Strings(keys)
+		for _, id := range keys {
+			if c.CasesPerSpec[id] > cases {
+				ds = append(ds, diag("B02", fmt.Sprintf("%s %s cases %d exceeds limit %d", c.Module, id, c.CasesPerSpec[id], cases), true))
+			}
+		}
+		if c.EvalLines > 0 && (c.DisposableLines == 0 || float64(c.EvalLines)/float64(c.DisposableLines) > ratio) {
+			ds = append(ds, diag("B03", fmt.Sprintf("%s eval/disposable ratio %d/%d exceeds limit %g", c.Module, c.EvalLines, c.DisposableLines, ratio), true))
+		}
+	}
+	if total > limit.Seconds() {
+		ds = append(ds, diag("B01", fmt.Sprintf("verify seconds %.3f exceeds limit %s", total, limit), true))
+	}
+	return ds
+}
+func budgetOnly(ds []project.Diagnostic) []project.Diagnostic {
+	out := []project.Diagnostic{}
+	for _, d := range ds {
+		if strings.HasPrefix(d.Code, "B0") {
+			out = append(out, d)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func saveCosts(root string, s model.CostSnapshot) error {
+	p := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "runs", s.Run, s.Phase, "costs.json")
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	b, e := json.MarshalIndent(s, "", "  ")
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(p, b, 0644)
+}
+func saveReport(root,run,phase,module string,report checks.Report)error{
+	dir:=filepath.Join(root,".fireweed","runs",run,phase)
+	if e:=os.MkdirAll(dir,0755);e!=nil{return e}
+	b,e:=json.MarshalIndent(report,"","  ");if e!=nil{return e}
+	if e=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,module+".json"),b,0644);e!=nil{return e}
+	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,module+".output.txt"),[]byte(report.Stdout+report.Stderr),0644)
+}
+func Costs(root string) ([]model.CostSnapshot, error) {
+	r, e := rootOf(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []model.CostSnapshot{}
+	_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(r, ".fireweed", "runs"), func(path string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+		if e != nil || d.IsDir() || d.Name() != "costs.json" {
+			return nil
+		}
+		b, e := os.ReadFile(path)
+		if e == nil {
+			var x model.CostSnapshot
+			if json.Unmarshal(b, &x) == nil {
+				out = append(out, x)
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].RecordedAt.Before(out[j].RecordedAt) })
+	return out, nil
+}

func Test_FLOW_059_AuditVerifyChecksSubmissionWithoutAdvancing(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	toAudit(t, root)
	base := head(t, root)
	current, err := workflow.Current(root, "manual")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct{ body, want string }{
		{"No findings\n", "P09: audit requires Checked IDs and No findings"},
		{"Checked IDs: ALP-002\nNo findings\n", "P09: audit did not check ALP-001"},
	} {
		audit(t, root, tc.body)
		before := readFile(t, root, pendingCommitChange)
		for _, quick := range []bool{true, false} {
			result, err := verify(root, quick)
			if err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), tc.want) {
				t.Errorf("audit Verify(quick=%t, %q) = phase %q, error %v; want %s", quick, tc.body, result.State.Phase, err, tc.want)
			}
		}
		if got := readFile(t, root, pendingCommitChange); got != before {
			t.Errorf("rejected Verify changed audit submission: %q", got)
		}
		if head(t, root) != base {
			t.Error("rejected Verify committed")
		}
		if now, err := workflow.Current(root, "manual"); err != nil || now.ClaimOID != current.ClaimOID || now.Phase != "audit" || now.PhaseBase != base {
			t.Errorf("rejected Verify changed claim or phase: %#v, %v", now, err)
		}
	}

	// Findings that Done can process must also pass Verify without being filtered or written.
	audit(t, root, "- ALP-001: \""+newClause+"\" — missing assertion\n- ALP-999: \"Unknown MUST work.\" — invalid finding\n")
	beforeFinding := readFile(t, root, pendingCommitChange)
	if result, err := verify(root, true); err != nil || result.State.Phase != "audit" {
		t.Errorf("finding audit Verify = phase %q, error %v", result.State.Phase, err)
	}
	if got := readFile(t, root, pendingCommitChange); got != beforeFinding || head(t, root) != base {
		t.Error("finding audit Verify normalized submission or committed")
	}

	// A complete submission is accepted by Verify without Done's normalization.
	audit(t, root, "Checked IDs: ALP-001\nNo findings\n")
	before := readFile(t, root, pendingCommitChange)
	if result, err := verify(root, true); err != nil || result.State.Phase != "audit" {
		t.Errorf("complete audit Verify = phase %q, error %v", result.State.Phase, err)
	}
	if got := readFile(t, root, pendingCommitChange); got != before || head(t, root) != base {
		t.Error("successful audit Verify wrote the submission or committed")
	}
	if now, err := workflow.Current(root, "manual"); err != nil || now.ClaimOID != current.ClaimOID || now.Phase != "audit" || now.PhaseBase != base {
		t.Errorf("successful Verify changed claim or phase: %#v, %v", now, err)
	}
	if result, err := done(root); err != nil || result.State.Phase != "impl" {
		t.Errorf("complete audit Done = phase %q, error %v", result.State.Phase, err)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_061_UnknownLifecycleSelectorsNameValidSlugs(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	request := workflow.Request{Root: root, Change: "ghost"}
	operations := []struct {
		name string
		call func(string) error
	}{
		{"Start", func(s string) error { _, err := workflow.Start(root, s); return err }},
		{"StartFromAttempt", func(s string) error { _, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(root, s, 1); return err }},
		{"Current", func(s string) error { _, err := workflow.Current(root, s); return err }},
		{"Context", func(s string) error { _, err := workflow.Context(root, s, false); return err }},
		{"Verify", func(s string) error {
			request.Change = s
			_, err := workflow.Verify(context.Background(), request)
			return err
		}},
		{"Done", func(s string) error {
			request.Change = s
			_, err := workflow.Done(context.Background(), request)
			return err
		}},
		{"Release", func(s string) error { return workflow.Release(root, s) }},
		{"Commits", func(s string) error { _, err := workflow.Commits(root, s); return err }},
		{"Abandon", func(s string) error { _, err := workflow.Abandon(root, s); return err }},
	}
	before := head(t, root)
	for _, selector := range []string{"ghost", "0009-ghost.md"} {
		for _, op := range operations {
			err := op.call(selector)
			if err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "U02:") || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), selector) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "manual") {
				t.Errorf("%s(%q) = %v; want U02 with rejected selector and valid slug manual", op.name, selector, err)
			}
		}
	}
	if head(t, root) != before || git(t, root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all") != "" {
		t.Error("unknown selector changed HEAD or working tree")
	}

	// Commits and Abandon also look up archived documents.
	archive := filepath.Join(root, archivedCommitChange)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(archive), 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	git(t, root, "mv", pendingCommitChange, archivedCommitChange)
	commit(t, root, "archive fixture change")
	for _, op := range operations[len(operations)-2:] {
		err := op.call("ghost")
		if err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "U02:") || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "ghost") || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "manual") {
			t.Errorf("archived %s(ghost) = %v; want U02 with archive slug manual", op.name, err)
		}
	}
}

func abandonGitIdentity(t *testing.T, root string) {
	t.Helper()
	git(t, root, "config", "user.name", "Fixture")
	git(t, root, "config", "user.email", "fixture@example.invalid")
}

func assertAbandonCommit(t *testing.T, root, parent, oid string) {
	t.Helper()
	if !regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{40}$`).MatchString(oid) || oid != head(t, root) {
		t.Errorf("Abandon returned %q; HEAD is %s", oid, head(t, root))
	}
	if got := git(t, root, "rev-parse", "HEAD^"); got != parent {
		t.Errorf("Abandon parent = %s, want %s (one new commit)", got, parent)
	}
	if got := git(t, root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"); got != "" {
		t.Errorf("Abandon left dirty worktree: %s", got)
	}
	for _, path := range []string{pendingCommitChange, archivedCommitChange} {
		if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(root, path)); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Errorf("change remains at %s: %v", path, err)
		}
	}
	// FLOW-094: the only change-document edit is deletion; no new phase is assigned.
	if diff := git(t, root, "diff", "--unified=0", parent, oid, "--", "changes"); strings.Contains(diff, "+phase:") {
		t.Errorf("Abandon assigned a phase in its commit: %s", diff)
	}
}

func assertAbandonRefusal(t *testing.T, root, selector, code string) {
	t.Helper()
	beforeHead := head(t, root)
	beforeTree := git(t, root, "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}")
	beforeStatus := git(t, root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all")
	beforeRefs := releaseRefs(t, root)
	if oid, err := workflow.Abandon(root, selector); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), code+":") || oid != "" {
		t.Errorf("Abandon(%q) = %q, %v; want %s refusal without OID", selector, oid, err, code)
	}
	if got := head(t, root); got != beforeHead {
		t.Errorf("rejected Abandon moved HEAD: %s -> %s", beforeHead, got)
	}
	if got := git(t, root, "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"); got != beforeTree {
		t.Errorf("rejected Abandon changed committed tree: %s -> %s", beforeTree, got)
	}
	if got := git(t, root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"); got != beforeStatus {
		t.Errorf("rejected Abandon changed worktree status: %q -> %q", beforeStatus, got)
	}
	if got := releaseRefs(t, root); got != beforeRefs {

	}
}

func Test_FLOW_089_FLOW_091_FLOW_094_AbandonCleanOwnedSteppedChange(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	abandonGitIdentity(t, root)
	initialSpec := readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md")
	started := start(t, root)
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/step_test.go", "committed eval effect\n")

		t.Fatalf("fixture audit Done = %#v, %v", audited, err)
	}
	phaseCommits, err := workflow.Commits(root, "manual")
	if err != nil || len(phaseCommits) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("fixture phase commits = %v, %v; want evals and audit", phaseCommits, err)
	}
	if got := readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/step_test.go"); got != "committed eval effect\n" {
		t.Fatalf("fixture lacks committed phase effect: %q", got)
	}
	before := head(t, root)
	current, err := workflow.Current(root, "manual")
	if err != nil || current.ClaimOID == "" || current.Run != started.Run {
		t.Fatalf("fixture lost owned claim: %#v, %v", current, err)
	}
	oid, err := workflow.Abandon(root, "manual")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Abandon owned stepped change: %v", err)
	}
	assertAbandonCommit(t, root, before, oid)
	if got := git(t, root, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-status", "-r", oid); got != "D\t"+pendingCommitChange+"\nD\tpackages/alpha/evals/step_test.go" {
		t.Errorf("stepped Abandon effects = %q; want pending change and committed eval removed", got)
	}
	if got := readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md"); got != initialSpec {
		t.Errorf("stepped Abandon changed applied spec: %q", got)
	}
	if claim := git(t, root, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(objectname)", "refs/fireweed/claims/manual"); claim != "" {
		t.Errorf("owned claim remains: %s", claim)
	}
	if _, err := workflow.Current(root, "manual"); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "U02:") {
		t.Errorf("released claim is still current: %v", err)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_090_AbandonRejectsDirtyWorkingTree(t *testing.T) {
	for _, kind := range []string{"tracked", "untracked"} {
		t.Run(kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
			if kind == "tracked" {
				write(t, root, "SYSTEM.md", "dirty tracked content\n")
			} else {
				write(t, root, "stray.txt", "dirty untracked content\n")
			}
			assertAbandonRefusal(t, root, "manual", "P01")
			if kind == "tracked" && readFile(t, root, "SYSTEM.md") != "dirty tracked content\n" {
				t.Error("dirty tracked content changed")
			}
			if kind == "untracked" && readFile(t, root, "stray.txt") != "dirty untracked content\n" {
				t.Error("dirty untracked content changed")
			}
		})
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_091_AbandonRejectsForeignClaim(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	abandonGitIdentity(t, root)
	other := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "linked")
	git(t, root, "worktree", "add", "-b", "linked", other, "HEAD")
	started := start(t, root)
	// The linked worktree is clean and sees the same pending change at HEAD.
	if status := git(t, other, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"); status != "" {
		t.Fatalf("foreign worktree is dirty: %s", status)
	}
	ownerHead := head(t, root)
	ownerChange := readFile(t, root, pendingCommitChange)
	assertAbandonRefusal(t, other, "manual", "P02")
	if head(t, root) != ownerHead || readFile(t, root, pendingCommitChange) != ownerChange {
		t.Error("foreign Abandon changed owner's worktree")
	}
	if current, err := workflow.Current(root, "manual"); err != nil || current.ClaimOID != started.ClaimOID {
		t.Errorf("foreign Abandon replaced owned claim: %#v, %v", current, err)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_092_AbandonAppliedRefusalThenGitRevertToPending(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	abandonGitIdentity(t, root)
	initialSpec := readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md")
	start(t, root)
	evals, err := done(root)
	if err != nil || evals.State.Phase != "audit" {

	}
	audit(t, root, "Checked IDs: ALP-001\nNo findings\n")
	audited, err := done(root)
	if err != nil || audited.State.Phase != "impl" {
		t.Fatalf("fixture audit Done = %#v, %v", audited, err)
	}
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/ready", "ready\n")
	applied, err := done(root)
	if err != nil || applied.State.Phase != "applied" {
		t.Fatalf("fixture impl Done = %#v, %v", applied, err)
	}

		t.Fatalf("git revert retained applied archive: %v", err)

		t.Errorf("Abandon after revert changed original spec: %q", got)
	}
}
