+
+func selectedPath(root,selector string)(string,error){paths:=[]string{};for _,pattern:=range []string{"changes/*.md","changes/archive/*.md"}{matches,_:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root,pattern));for _,p:=range matches{rel,_:=filepath.Rel(root,p);paths=append(paths,filepath.ToSlash(rel))}};found:=[]string{};valid:=[]string{};for _,p:=range paths{base:=filepath.Base(p);slug:=strings.TrimSuffix(base,".md");if i:=strings.IndexByte(slug,'-');i>=0{slug=slug[i+1:]};valid=append(valid,slug);if selector==p||selector==base||selector==slug||selector==strings.TrimSuffix(base,".md"){found=append(found,p)}};if len(found)==1{return found[0],nil};if len(found)>1{return "",problem("U02","change %q ambiguous; valid slugs: %s",selector,strings.Join(valid,", "))};return "",problem("U02","change %q not found; valid slugs: %s",selector,strings.Join(valid,", "))}
+func phaseAt(root,revision,path string)string{b,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,revision,path);if e!=nil{return ""};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil{return ""};return fmString(d.Frontmatter,"phase")}
+func Commits(root,selector string)([]string,error){root,e:=canonical(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};path,e:=selectedPath(root,selector);if e!=nil{return nil,e};base:=filepath.Base(path);pending,archived:="changes/"+base,"changes/archive/"+base;list,e:=git(root,"rev-list","HEAD");if e!=nil{return nil,e};out:=[]string{};for _,oid:=range strings.Fields(list){parents,_:=git(root,"rev-list","--parents","-n","1",oid);fields:=strings.Fields(parents);if len(fields)<2{continue};parent:=fields[1];current:=phaseAt(root,oid,pending);if current==""{current=phaseAt(root,oid,archived)};prior:=phaseAt(root,parent,pending);if prior==""{prior=phaseAt(root,parent,archived)};if current!=""&&current!=prior{out=append(out,oid)}};return out,nil}
+func Abandon(root,selector string)(string,error){root,e:=canonical(root);if e!=nil{return "",e};if e=clean(root);e!=nil{return "",e};path,e:=selectedPath(root,selector);if e!=nil{return "",e};if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/archive/"){return "",problem("P01","cannot abandon applied change")};c,e:=queued(root,path);if e!=nil{return "",e};cl,oid,ok,e:=loadClaim(root,c);if e!=nil{return "",e};if ok&&cl.Worktree!=root{return "",problem("P02","claim belongs to another worktree")};commits,e:=Commits(root,path);if e!=nil{return "",e};for _,id:=range commits{out,re:=git(root,"diff-tree","--no-commit-id","--name-only","-r",id);if re!=nil{return "",re};for _,file:=range strings.Fields(out){if file==path{continue};before,re:=gitBytes(root,"show",id+"^:"+file);if re==nil{if re=write(root,file,string(before));re!=nil{return "",re}}else{_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root,file))}}};if e=os.Remove(filepath.Join(root,path));e!=nil{return "",e};newHead,e:=commitAll(root,"fireweed: abandon "+c.Slug);if e!=nil{return "",e};if ok{if e=gitstore.CASRef(root,claimName(c),oid,"");e!=nil{return "",e}};return newHead,nil}

+package lifecycle

+
+func depends(modules []project.Module,from,to string)bool{visited:=map[string]bool{};var walk func(string)bool;walk=func(name string)bool{if visited[name]{return false};visited[name]=true;for _,m:=range modules{if m.Name==name{for _,d:=range m.DependsOn{if d==to||walk(d){return true}}}};return false};return walk(from)}
+func waitingFor(q []project.Change,index int,modules []project.Module)(string,string){c:=q[index];if fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"blocked")!=""{return "",""};for j:=0;j<index;j++{b:=q[j];if fmString(b.Document.Frontmatter,"blocked")==""{continue};if b.Module==c.Module{return b.Slug,"same_module"};if depends(modules,c.Module,b.Module){return b.Slug,"depends_on_blocked"};if strings.TrimSpace(section(c.Document.Body,"Interface"))!=""&&depends(modules,b.Module,c.Module){return b.Slug,"interface_dependency"}};return "",""}
+func Eligible(root string)([]project.Change,error){q,e:=project.Queue(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};out:=[]project.Change{};for i,c:=range q{if fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"blocked")!=""{continue};s,e:=project.Project(root,c.Slug);if e!=nil{return nil,e};on,_:=waitingFor(q,i,s.Modules);if on==""{out=append(out,c)}};return out,nil}
+func Status(root string)(model.StatusReport,error){s,e:=project.Load(root);if e!=nil{return model.StatusReport{},e};q,e:=project.Queue(root);if e!=nil{return model.StatusReport{},e};r:=model.StatusReport{Modules:s.Modules,Queue:[]model.StatusEntry{},DriftSinceDrill:map[string]int{},PhaseCommits:map[string]int{},Costs:[]model.ModuleCost{}};for i,c:=range q{p,e:=project.Project(root,c.Slug);if e!=nil{return r,e};on,rule:=waitingFor(q,i,p.Modules);phase:=fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"phase");if phase==""{phase="queued"};r.Queue=append(r.Queue,model.StatusEntry{Slug:c.Slug,Path:c.Path,Module:c.Module,Phase:phase,Blocked:fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"blocked"),WaitingOn:on,WaitingRule:rule,AuditRounds:fmInt(c.Document.Frontmatter,"audit_rounds")})};for _,m:=range s.Modules{r.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name]=0;for _,id:=range asStrings(m.Document.Frontmatter["quarantine"]){r.Quarantines=append(r.Quarantines,model.Quarantine{Module:m.Name,ID:id})};if reason:=fmString(m.Document.Frontmatter,"boundaries_opt_out");reason!=""{r.BoundaryOptOuts=append(r.BoundaryOptOuts,model.BoundaryOptOut{Module:m.Name,Reason:reason})}};snapshots,_:=Costs(root);latest:=map[string]model.ModuleCost{};for _,c:=range snapshots{for _,m:=range c.Modules{latest[m.Module]=m}};for _,m:=range s.Modules{if c,ok:=latest[m.Name];ok{r.Costs=append(r.Costs,c)}};return r,nil}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+ "time"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func removeDisposable(root string,s project.Snapshot,name string)error{m,ok:=module(s,name);if !ok{return nil};return filepath.Walk(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),func(path string,info os.FileInfo,e error)error{if e!=nil||info==nil||!info.Mode().IsRegular(){return nil};rel,re:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),path);if re!=nil{return re};if contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones)=="disposable"{return os.Remove(path)};return nil})}
+func newerDrill(root,module string)bool{matches,_:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root,"changes/archive/*.md"));latest:=time.Time{};for _,path:=range matches{b,e:=os.ReadFile(path);if e!=nil{continue};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil||fmString(d.Frontmatter,"module")!=module||fmString(d.Frontmatter,"phase")!="applied"{continue};for _,line:=range strings.Split(section(string(b),"Provenance"),"\n"){fields:=strings.Fields(line);if len(fields)>=3&&fields[0]=="-"&&fields[1]=="impl"{if t,e:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,fields[2]);e==nil&&t.After(latest){latest=t}}}};b,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root,".fireweed/drills",module+".md"));if e!=nil{return false};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil||fmString(d.Frontmatter,"result")!="pass"{return false};date:=fmString(d.Frontmatter,"date");t,e:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,date);return e==nil&&t.After(latest)}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/verify.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/verify.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d30b1434d33e320a1273df7d2896bf9def15e306
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/verify.go
@@ -0,0 +1,339 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"reflect"
+	"regexp"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+var heading = regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^## ([^\n]+)\s*$`)
+
+func bodyParts(body string) map[string]string {
+	out := map[string]string{}
+	loc := heading.FindAllStringSubmatchIndex(body, -1)
+	for i, m := range loc {
+		end := len(body)
+		if i+1 < len(loc) {
+			end = loc[i+1][0]
+		}
+		out[strings.TrimSpace(body[m[2]:m[3]])] = strings.TrimSpace(body[m[1]:end])
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func approvedError(cl claim, current string) error {
+	old, e := contracts.ParseDocument(cl.Approved)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	now, e := contracts.ParseDocument(current)
+	if e != nil {
+		return problem("P03", "approved author metadata changed: %v", e)
+	}
+	if fmString(now.Frontmatter, "run") != cl.Run || fmString(now.Frontmatter, "phase") != cl.Phase {
+		return problem("P03", "approved run or phase changed")
+	}
+	if fmInt(now.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds") != fmInt(old.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds") || fmString(now.Frontmatter, "blocked") != fmString(old.Frontmatter, "blocked") {
+		return problem("P03", "approved audit state changed")
+	}
+	for _, m := range []map[string]any{old.Frontmatter, now.Frontmatter} {
+		delete(m, "run")
+		delete(m, "phase")
+		delete(m, "audit_rounds")
+		delete(m, "blocked")
+	}
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(old.Frontmatter, now.Frontmatter) {
+		return problem("P03", "approved author metadata changed")
+	}
+	a, b := bodyParts(old.Body), bodyParts(now.Body)
+	for _, name := range []string{"Motivation", "Interface", "Added", "Modified", "Removed", "Removed decisions"} {
+		if a[name] != b[name] {
+			return problem("P03", "approved author metadata changed")
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func module(s project.Snapshot, name string) (project.Module, bool) {
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		if m.Name == name {
+			return m, true
+		}
+	}
+	return project.Module{}, false
+}
+func moduleSpecs(s project.Snapshot, name string) []contracts.Item {
+	m, ok := module(s, name)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil
+	}
+	items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs"))
+	out := []contracts.Item{}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(it.Tag), "quarantine") {
+			out = append(out, it)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func validateHeld(root string, c project.Change, cl claim) error {
+	head, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if head != cl.Base {
+		return problem("P05", "phase base changed from %s to %s", cl.Base, head)
+	}
+	raw, e := read(root, c.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = approvedError(cl, raw); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return stale(root, c)
+}
+func checkZones(root string, c project.Change, cl claim) error {
+	changes, e := gitstore.Changes(root, cl.Base)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if len(asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+		for _, ch := range changes {
+			p := ch.Path
+			if p == "" {
+				p = ch.OldPath
+			}
+			if p == c.Path {
+				continue
+			}
+			m, ok := module(cl.Snapshot, c.Module)
+			if !ok {
+				return problem("Z01", "unknown module %s", c.Module)
+			}
+			zone := ""
+			if strings.HasPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/") {
+				zone = contracts.ResolveZone(strings.TrimPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/"), m.Zones)
+			}
+			if !(cl.Phase == "evals" && zone == "evals") {
+				return problem("Z01", "forbidden %s edit: %s", cl.Phase, p)
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	ds := checks.Zones(checks.ZoneRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Module: c.Module, Phase: cl.Phase, ChangePath: c.Path, Base: cl.Base, InterfaceDeclared: strings.TrimSpace(section(c.Document.Body, "Interface")) != "", Changes: changes})
+	return errDiagnostic(ds)
+}
+func auditSubmission(raw string, c project.Change, s project.Snapshot, approved string) (string, bool, error) {
+	body := section(raw, "Audit")
+	lines := strings.Split(body, "\n")
+	findings := []string{}
+	checked := map[string]bool{}
+	no := false
+	for _, line := range lines {
+		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "Checked IDs:") {
+			for _, id := range strings.FieldsFunc(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "Checked IDs:"), func(r rune) bool { return r == ',' || r == ' ' || r == '\t' }) {
+				checked[id] = true
+			}
+		}
+		if strings.Contains(line, "No findings") {
+			no = true
+		}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "- ") {
+			findings = append(findings, line)
+		}
+	}
+	valid := []string{}
+	specs := map[string]string{}
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		for _, it := range moduleSpecs(s, m.Name) {
+			specs[it.ID] = it.Body
+		}
+	}
+	previous := section(approved, "Audit")
+	for _, line := range findings {
+		match := regexp.MustCompile(`(?:\[untestable\]\s*)?([A-Z]+-\d+):\s*"([^"]+)"`).FindStringSubmatch(line)
+		if len(match) != 3 || !strings.Contains(specs[match[1]], match[2]) {
+			continue
+		}
+		if fmInt(c.Document.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds") > 0 && !strings.Contains(previous, match[1]) {
+			continue
+		}
+		valid = append(valid, line)
+	}
+	if len(valid) > 0 {
+		return strings.Join(valid, "\n") + "\n", true, nil
+	}
+	if !no || len(checked) == 0 {
+		return "", false, problem("P09", "audit requires Checked IDs and No findings")
+	}
+	required := []string{}
+	for _, i := range append(c.Added, c.Modified...) {
+		required = append(required, i.ID)
+	}
+	required = append(required, asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["fixes"])...)
+	required = append(required, asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])...)
+	for _, id := range required {
+		if !checked[id] {
+			return "", false, problem("P09", "audit did not check %s", id)
+		}
+	}
+	ids := []string{}
+	for id := range checked {
+		ids = append(ids, id)
+	}
+	return "No findings; checked " + strings.Join(ids, ", ") + "\n", false, nil
+}
+func Verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) { return verify(ctx, req) }
+func verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	root, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.Result{}, e
+	}
+	c, cl, oid, e := held(root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.Result{}, e
+	}
+	st, e := state(root, c, cl, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.Result{}, e
+	}
+	r := model.Result{State: st, Reports: map[string]checks.Report{}, Costs: []model.ModuleCost{}}
+	if cl.Phase != "evals" && cl.Phase != "audit" && cl.Phase != "impl" {
+		return r, problem("P01", "unsupported phase %s", cl.Phase)
+	}
+	if e = validateHeld(root, c, cl); e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	if e = checkZones(root, c, cl); e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	if cl.Phase == "audit" {
+		raw, _ := read(root, c.Path)
+		_, _, e = auditSubmission(raw, c, cl.Snapshot, cl.Approved)
+		return r, e
+	}
+	targets := []string{c.Module}
+	if cl.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
+		mode := cfgString(cl.Snapshot, "verify_dependents", "direct")
+		for _, m := range cl.Snapshot.Modules {
+			if m.Name == c.Module {
+				continue
+			}
+			direct := false
+			for _, dep := range m.DependsOn {
+				if dep == c.Module {
+					direct = true
+				}
+			}
+			if mode == "all" && depends(cl.Snapshot.Modules, m.Name, c.Module) || mode == "direct" && direct {
+				targets = append(targets, m.Name)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	var first error
+	for _, name := range targets {
+		specs := moduleSpecs(cl.Snapshot, name)
+		report, evalErr := checks.Evaluate(ctx, checks.HookRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Module: name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		r.Reports[name] = report
+		saveReport(root, cl.Run, cl.Phase, name, report)
+		if len(report.Cases) > 0 {
+			if ce := checks.RequireCoverage(report, specs); ce != nil && first == nil {
+				first = ce
+			}
+		}
+		if name == c.Module && cl.Phase == "evals" {
+			if len(asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+				if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && first == nil {
+					first = ce
+				}
+				for _, id := range asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"]) {
+					found := false
+					for _, cas := range report.Cases {
+						for _, x := range cas.IDs {
+							if x == id {
+								found = true
+							}
+						}
+					}
+					if !found && first == nil {
+						first = problem("C10", "no coverage for %s", id)
+					}
+				}
+			} else {
+				ids := []string{}
+				for _, it := range append(c.Added, c.Modified...) {
+					ids = append(ids, it.ID)
+				}
+				ids = append(ids, asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["fixes"])...)
+				if ce := checks.RequireFailFirst(report, ids, asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["already_satisfied"])); ce != nil && first == nil {
+					first = ce
+				}
+			}
+		} else {
+			if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && first == nil {
+				first = ce
+			}
+		}
+		if evalErr != nil && first == nil && len(report.Cases) == 0 {
+			first = evalErr
+		}
+	}
+	r.Costs = measureCosts(root, cl.Snapshot, r.Reports)
+	r.Diagnostics = budgetDiagnostics(cl.Snapshot, r.Costs)
+	saveCosts(root, cl, r.Costs, r.Diagnostics)
+	if cl.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
+		ds, be := checks.Boundaries(ctx, checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, ds...)
+		if be != nil && first == nil {
+			first = be
+		}
+	}
+	return r, first
+}
+func saveReport(root, run, phase, name string, report checks.Report) {
+	dir := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "runs", run, phase)
+	_ = os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755)
+	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
+	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".json"), b, 0644)
+	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".out"), []byte(report.Stdout+report.Stderr), 0644)
+}
+func provenance(req model.Request, phase string, reports map[string]checks.Report) string {
+	agent := req.Agent
+	if agent == "" {
+		agent = "manual"
+	}
+	playbook, _ := assets.Playbook(phase)
+	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(playbook))
+	total, passing, failing := 0, 0, 0
+	for _, r := range reports {
+		for _, c := range r.Cases {
+			total++
+			if c.Result == "pass" {
+				passing++
+			}
+			if c.Result == "fail" || c.Result == "error" {
+				failing++
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d", phase, time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), agent, assets.Version(), hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]), total, failing, passing)
+}
+func appendProvenance(raw, line string) string {
+	old := section(raw, "Provenance")
+	return contracts.ReplaceSection(raw, "Provenance", strings.TrimSpace(old)+"\n"+line+"\n")
+}

+func Context(root,selector string,full bool)(string,error){root,e:=canonical(root);if e!=nil{return "",e};c,cl,_,e:=held(root,selector);if e!=nil{return "",e};var b strings.Builder;raw,e:=read(root,c.Path);if e!=nil{return "",e};fmt.Fprintf(&b,"# Change\n%s\n",raw);for _,m:=range cl.Snapshot.Modules{if m.Name==c.Module{spec,_:=read(root,filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir,"SPEC.md")));fmt.Fprintf(&b,"# Projected spec\n%s\n",m.Document.Body);_ = spec;_ = filepath.Walk(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),func(path string,info os.FileInfo,e error)error{if e!=nil||info==nil||info.IsDir(){return nil};rel,_:=filepath.Rel(root,path);name:=filepath.ToSlash(rel);if name==filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir,"SPEC.md")){return nil};if strings.HasSuffix(name,".go")&& !strings.Contains(name,"/internal/")&&!strings.Contains(name,"/evals/"){content,_:=os.ReadFile(path);fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n# %s\n%s\n",name,content)}else if full{content,_:=os.ReadFile(path);fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n# %s (%d bytes)\n%s\n",name,info.Size(),content)}else{fmt.Fprintf(&b,"%s %d bytes\n",name,info.Size())};return nil})}};system,_:=read(root,"SYSTEM.md");fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n# SYSTEM\n%s\n",system);name:=cl.Phase;if name=="impl"&&fmBool(c.Document.Frontmatter,"regenerate"){name="regenerate"};playbook,e:=assets.Playbook(name);if e==nil{fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n%s\n",playbook)};return b.String(),nil}

+ if resume{phase=fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"phase")};if approved!=original{if e=write(root,c.Path,approved);e!=nil{return model.State{},e}};snapshot,e:=project.Project(root,c.Slug);if e!=nil{if approved!=original{_ = write(root,c.Path,original)};return model.State{},e};snapshot.Root=root;cl=claim{Worktree:root,Change:c.Path,Run:run,Phase:phase,Base:head,Approved:approved,Snapshot:snapshot};oid,e:=saveClaim(root,c,cl,"");if e!=nil{if approved!=original{_ = write(root,c.Path,original)};return model.State{},e};if resume{if e=restoreAttempt(root,c,phase,attempt);e!=nil{return model.State{},e}}else if fmBool(c.Document.Frontmatter,"regenerate")&&fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"phase")==""{_ = removeDisposable(root,snapshot,c.Module)};s,e:=state(root,c,cl,oid);if e!=nil{return s,e};if !existsAtBase(root,c.Path){s.Diagnostics=append(s.Diagnostics,diag("P04","change is absent from local and shared base",true))};if fmBool(c.Document.Frontmatter,"regenerate")&&!newerDrill(root,c.Module){s.Diagnostics=append(s.Diagnostics,diag("P10","no newer passing drill for "+c.Module,true))};return s,nil}

+func lineCount(b []byte)int{if len(b)==0{return 0};n:=0;for _,v:=range b{if v=='\n'{n++}};if b[len(b)-1]!='\n'{n++};return n}
+func measureCosts(root string,s project.Snapshot,reports map[string]checks.Report)[]model.ModuleCost{out:=[]model.ModuleCost{};for name,report:=range reports{m,ok:=module(s,name);if !ok{continue};cost:=model.ModuleCost{Module:name,CasesPerSpec:map[string]int{}};for _,cas:=range report.Cases{cost.Seconds+=cas.Seconds;for _,id:=range cas.IDs{cost.CasesPerSpec[id]++}};_ = filepath.Walk(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),func(path string,info os.FileInfo,e error)error{if e!=nil||info==nil||!info.Mode().IsRegular(){return nil};rel,re:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),path);if re!=nil{return nil};zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones);if zone!="evals"&&zone!="disposable"{return nil};b,re:=os.ReadFile(path);if re!=nil{return nil};if zone=="evals"{cost.EvalLines+=lineCount(b)}else{cost.DisposableLines+=lineCount(b)};return nil});out=append(out,cost)};sort.Slice(out,func(i,j int)bool{return out[i].Module<out[j].Module});return out}

+func saveCosts(root string,cl claim,costs []model.ModuleCost,ds []project.Diagnostic){p:=filepath.Join(root,".fireweed","runs",cl.Run,cl.Phase,"costs.json");_ = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p),0755);b,_:=json.MarshalIndent(model.CostSnapshot{Run:cl.Run,Phase:cl.Phase,RecordedAt:time.Now().UTC(),Modules:costs,Diagnostics:ds},"","  ");_ = os.WriteFile(p,b,0644)}
+func Costs(root string)([]model.CostSnapshot,error){out:=[]model.CostSnapshot{};base:=filepath.Join(root,".fireweed","runs");_ = filepath.Walk(base,func(path string,info os.FileInfo,e error)error{if e!=nil||info==nil||info.IsDir()||filepath.Base(path)!="costs.json"{return nil};b,re:=os.ReadFile(path);if re!=nil{return nil};var c model.CostSnapshot;if json.Unmarshal(b,&c)==nil{out=append(out,c)};return nil});sort.Slice(out,func(i,j int)bool{return out[i].RecordedAt.Before(out[j].RecordedAt)});return out,nil}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..eacd399d5f82e712817ef4ac6cdfc87dac272d84
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go
@@ -0,0 +1,244 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func commitAll(root, subject string) (string, error) {
+	if _, e := git(root, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e := git(root, "commit", "-m", subject); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	return git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+}
+func updateHeld(root string, c project.Change, cl claim, oid, raw, phase string, release bool) (model.State, error) {
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	doc.Frontmatter["phase"] = phase
+	next, e := contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if e = write(root, c.Path, next); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	newHead, e := commitAll(root, "fireweed: "+c.Slug+" "+cl.Phase+" -> "+phase)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	cl.Phase = phase
+	cl.Base = newHead
+	cl.Approved = next
+	if release {
+		if e := Release(root, c.Slug); e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		s := model.State{Change: c, Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Run: cl.Run, Phase: phase, Head: newHead, PhaseBase: newHead}
+		return s, nil
+	}
+	newOID, e := saveClaim(root, c, cl, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	return state(root, c, cl, newOID)
+}
+func Done(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	r, e := verify(ctx, req)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	root, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	c, cl, oid, e := held(root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	raw, e := read(root, c.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	raw = appendProvenance(raw, provenance(req, cl.Phase, r.Reports))
+	switch cl.Phase {
+	case "evals":
+		next := "audit"
+		if !cfgBool(cl.Snapshot, "audit.enabled", true) {
+			next = "impl"
+		}
+		r.State, e = updateHeld(root, c, cl, oid, raw, next, false)
+		return r, e
+	case "audit":
+		normalized, findings, e := auditSubmission(raw, c, cl.Snapshot, cl.Approved)
+		if e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		raw = contracts.ReplaceSection(raw, "Audit", normalized)
+		if findings {
+			round := fmInt(c.Document.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds")
+			blocked := strings.Contains(normalized, "[untestable]") || round >= cfgInt(cl.Snapshot, "audit.max_rounds", 2)
+			if blocked {
+				doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+				if e != nil {
+					return r, e
+				}
+				doc.Frontmatter["blocked"] = "audit findings"
+				raw, e = contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+				if e != nil {
+					return r, e
+				}
+				raw = contracts.ReplaceSection(raw, "Questions", normalized)
+				r.State, e = updateHeld(root, c, cl, oid, raw, "audit", true)
+				if e != nil {
+					return r, e
+				}
+				return r, problem("P06", "change blocked")
+			}
+			doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+			if e != nil {
+				return r, e
+			}
+			doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"] = round + 1
+			raw, e = contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+			if e != nil {
+				return r, e
+			}
+			r.State, e = updateHeld(root, c, cl, oid, raw, "evals", false)
+			return r, e
+		}
+		r.State, e = updateHeld(root, c, cl, oid, raw, "impl", false)
+		return r, e
+	case "impl":
+		if e = apply(root, c, cl, raw); e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		head, e := commitAll(root, "fireweed: apply "+c.Slug)
+		if e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		if e = releaseExact(root, c, oid); e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		r.State = model.State{Change: c, Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Run: cl.Run, Phase: "applied", Head: head, PhaseBase: head}
+		return r, nil
+	}
+	return r, problem("P01", "unsupported phase %s", cl.Phase)
+}
+func releaseExact(root string, c project.Change, oid string) error {
+	return gitstoreCAS(root, claimName(c), oid, "")
+}
+func gitstoreCAS(root, name, old, next string) error { return gitstore.CASRef(root, name, old, next) }
+func apply(root string, c project.Change, cl claim, raw string) error {
+	m, ok := module(cl.Snapshot, c.Module)
+	if !ok {
+		return fmt.Errorf("module %s absent", c.Module)
+	}
+	path := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir, "SPEC.md"))
+	original, e := read(root, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(original)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	current, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc.Body, "Specs"))
+	remove := map[string]bool{}
+	replace := map[string]contracts.Item{}
+	for _, it := range c.Removed {
+		remove[it.ID] = true
+	}
+	for _, it := range c.Modified {
+		replace[it.ID] = it
+	}
+	items := []contracts.Item{}
+	for _, it := range current {
+		if remove[it.ID] {
+			continue
+		}
+		if n, ok := replace[it.ID]; ok {
+			items = append(items, n)
+		} else {
+			items = append(items, it)
+		}
+	}
+	items = append(items, c.Added...)
+	rendered := []string{}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		rendered = append(rendered, strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Specs", "\n"+strings.Join(rendered, "\n\n")+"\n")
+	if set := asMap(c.Document.Frontmatter["set"]); len(set) > 0 {
+		for k, v := range set {
+			doc.Frontmatter[k] = v
+		}
+	}
+	decisions := strings.TrimSpace(section(doc.Body, "Decisions"))
+	removed := strings.TrimSpace(section(c.Document.Body, "Removed decisions"))
+	if removed != "" {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(removed, "\n") {
+			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+			if line != "" {
+				decisions = strings.ReplaceAll(decisions, line, "")
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	added := strings.TrimSpace(section(c.Document.Body, "Decisions"))
+	if added != "" {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(added, "\n") {
+			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+			if line != "" {
+				decisions += "\n- " + c.Slug + ": " + line
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Decisions", strings.TrimSpace(decisions)+"\n")
+	next, e := contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = write(root, path, next); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	archive := "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(c.Path)
+	archiveDoc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	archiveDoc.Frontmatter["phase"] = "applied"
+	archived, e := contracts.RenderDocument(archiveDoc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = write(root, archive, archived); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, c.Path)); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	for _, d := range project.Check(root) {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, archive))
+			_ = write(root, c.Path, cl.Approved)
+			_ = write(root, path, original)
+			return problem(d.Code, "%s", d.Message)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+var _ = regexp.MustCompile

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "encoding/json"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "sort"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+ "time"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func GC(_ context.Context,req model.GCRequest)(model.GCResult,error){root,e:=canonical(req.Root);if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};s,e:=project.Load(root);if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};age:=720*time.Hour;if v:=setting(s,"gc.drill_max_age");v!=nil{str:=v.(string);age,e=time.ParseDuration(str);if e!=nil||age<=0{return model.GCResult{},problem("C01","invalid gc.drill_max_age %q",str)}};now:=req.Now;if now.IsZero(){now=time.Now().UTC()};registered:=map[string]bool{};list,_:=git(root,"worktree","list","--porcelain");for _,line:=range strings.Split(list,"\n"){if strings.HasPrefix(line,"worktree "){p,_:=canonical(strings.TrimPrefix(line,"worktree "));registered[p]=true}};refs,_:=git(root,"for-each-ref","--format=%(refname)","refs/fireweed");result:=model.GCResult{Pruned:[]string{}};for _,ref:=range strings.Fields(refs){remove:=false;switch{case strings.HasPrefix(ref,"refs/fireweed/claims/"):oid,ok,_:=gitstore.Ref(root,ref);if ok{b,re:=gitstore.ReadBlob(root,oid);if re==nil{var entry struct{Worktree string `json:"worktree"`};_ = json.Unmarshal(b,&entry);p,_:=canonical(entry.Worktree);if _,se:=os.Stat(p);se!=nil||!registered[p]{remove=true}}};case strings.HasPrefix(ref,"refs/fireweed/attempts/"):parts:=strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(ref,"refs/fireweed/attempts/"),"/");if len(parts)==2{if n,_:=strconv.Atoi(parts[1]);n>0{matches,_:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root,"changes/archive/*-"+parts[0]+".md"));remove=len(matches)>0}};case strings.HasPrefix(ref,"refs/fireweed/drills/"):parts:=strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(ref,"refs/fireweed/drills/"),"/");if len(parts)==2{date,se:=time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000",parts[1]);if se==nil&&date.Before(now.Add(-age)){remove=true}}};if remove{oid,ok,_:=gitstore.Ref(root,ref);if ok&&gitstore.CASRef(root,ref,oid,"")==nil{result.Pruned=append(result.Pruned,ref)}}};sort.Strings(result.Pruned);return result,nil}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+)
+
+func selectedPath(root,selector string)(string,error){paths:=[]string{};for _,pattern:=range []string{"changes/*.md","changes/archive/*.md"}{matches,_:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root,pattern));for _,p:=range matches{rel,_:=filepath.Rel(root,p);paths=append(paths,filepath.ToSlash(rel))}};found:=[]string{};valid:=[]string{};for _,p:=range paths{base:=filepath.Base(p);slug:=strings.TrimSuffix(base,".md");if i:=strings.IndexByte(slug,'-');i>=0{slug=slug[i+1:]};valid=append(valid,slug);if selector==p||selector==base||selector==slug||selector==strings.TrimSuffix(base,".md"){found=append(found,p)}};if len(found)==1{return found[0],nil};if len(found)>1{return "",problem("U02","change %q ambiguous; valid slugs: %s",selector,strings.Join(valid,", "))};return "",problem("U02","change %q not found; valid slugs: %s",selector,strings.Join(valid,", "))}
+func phaseAt(root,revision,path string)string{b,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,revision,path);if e!=nil{return ""};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil{return ""};return fmString(d.Frontmatter,"phase")}
+func Commits(root,selector string)([]string,error){root,e:=canonical(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};path,e:=selectedPath(root,selector);if e!=nil{return nil,e};base:=filepath.Base(path);pending,archived:="changes/"+base,"changes/archive/"+base;list,e:=git(root,"rev-list","HEAD");if e!=nil{return nil,e};out:=[]string{};for _,oid:=range strings.Fields(list){parents,_:=git(root,"rev-list","--parents","-n","1",oid);fields:=strings.Fields(parents);if len(fields)<2{continue};parent:=fields[1];current:=phaseAt(root,oid,pending);if current==""{current=phaseAt(root,oid,archived)};prior:=phaseAt(root,parent,pending);if prior==""{prior=phaseAt(root,parent,archived)};if current!=""&&current!=prior{out=append(out,oid)}};return out,nil}
+func Abandon(root,selector string)(string,error){root,e:=canonical(root);if e!=nil{return "",e};if e=clean(root);e!=nil{return "",e};path,e:=selectedPath(root,selector);if e!=nil{return "",e};if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/archive/"){return "",problem("P01","cannot abandon applied change")};c,e:=queued(root,path);if e!=nil{return "",e};cl,oid,ok,e:=loadClaim(root,c);if e!=nil{return "",e};if ok&&cl.Worktree!=root{return "",problem("P02","claim belongs to another worktree")};commits,e:=Commits(root,path);if e!=nil{return "",e};for _,id:=range commits{out,re:=git(root,"diff-tree","--no-commit-id","--name-only","-r",id);if re!=nil{return "",re};for _,file:=range strings.Fields(out){if file==path{continue};before,re:=gitBytes(root,"show",id+"^:"+file);if re==nil{if re=write(root,file,string(before));re!=nil{return "",re}}else{_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root,file))}}};if e=os.Remove(filepath.Join(root,path));e!=nil{return "",e};newHead,e:=commitAll(root,"fireweed: abandon "+c.Slug);if e!=nil{return "",e};if ok{if e=gitstore.CASRef(root,claimName(c),oid,"");e!=nil{return "",e}};return newHead,nil}
+var _=fmt.Sprint

+ b.WriteString("\n## Cost\n\n| Module | Seconds | Cases per spec | Eval lines | Disposable lines |\n| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: |\n");costs,_:=Costs(root);latest:=map[string]model.ModuleCost{};saved:=map[string][]project.Diagnostic{};for _,snapshot:=range costs{for _,cost:=range snapshot.Modules{latest[cost.Module]=cost;saved[cost.Module]=snapshot.Diagnostics}};for _,m:=range snapshot.Modules{cost,ok:=latest[m.Name];if !ok{continue};ids:=[]string{};for id:=range cost.CasesPerSpec{ids=append(ids,id)};sort.Strings(ids);counts:=[]string{};for _,id:=range ids{counts=append(counts,fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d",id,cost.CasesPerSpec[id]))};fmt.Fprintf(&b,"| %s | %g | %s | %d | %d |\n",m.Name,cost.Seconds,strings.Join(counts,", "),cost.EvalLines,cost.DisposableLines);for _,d:=range saved[m.Name]{if strings.HasPrefix(d.Code,"B0"){present:=false;for _,v:=range r.Diagnostics{if v==d{present=true}};if !present{r.Diagnostics=append(r.Diagnostics,d);fmt.Fprintf(&b,"%s: %s\n",d.Code,d.Message)}}}}

+func mustGit(root string,args ...string)string{s,_:=git(root,args...);return s}

@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func depends(modules []project.Module,from,to string)bool{visited:=map[string]bool{};var walk func(string)bool;walk=func(name string)bool{if visited[name]{return false};visited[name]=true;for _,m:=range modules{if m.Name==name{for _,d:=range m.DependsOn{if d==to||walk(d){return true}}}};return false};return walk(from)}
+func waitingFor(q []project.Change,index int,modules []project.Module)(string,string){c:=q[index];if fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"blocked")!=""{return "",""};for j:=0;j<index;j++{b:=q[j];if fmString(b.Document.Frontmatter,"blocked")==""{continue};if b.Module==c.Module{return b.Slug,"same_module"};if depends(modules,c.Module,b.Module){return b.Slug,"depends_on_blocked"};if strings.TrimSpace(section(c.Document.Body,"Interface"))!=""&&depends(modules,b.Module,c.Module){return b.Slug,"interface_dependency"}};return "",""}
+func Eligible(root string)([]project.Change,error){q,e:=project.Queue(root);if e!=nil{return nil,e};out:=[]project.Change{};for i,c:=range q{if fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"blocked")!=""{continue};s,e:=project.Project(root,c.Slug);if e!=nil{return nil,e};on,_:=waitingFor(q,i,s.Modules);if on==""{out=append(out,c)}};return out,nil}
+func Status(root string)(model.StatusReport,error){s,e:=project.Load(root);if e!=nil{return model.StatusReport{},e};q,e:=project.Queue(root);if e!=nil{return model.StatusReport{},e};r:=model.StatusReport{Modules:s.Modules,Queue:[]model.StatusEntry{},DriftSinceDrill:map[string]int{},PhaseCommits:map[string]int{},Costs:[]model.ModuleCost{}};for i,c:=range q{p,e:=project.Project(root,c.Slug);if e!=nil{return r,e};on,rule:=waitingFor(q,i,p.Modules);phase:=fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"phase");if phase==""{phase="queued"};r.Queue=append(r.Queue,model.StatusEntry{Slug:c.Slug,Path:c.Path,Module:c.Module,Phase:phase,Blocked:fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"blocked"),WaitingOn:on,WaitingRule:rule,AuditRounds:fmInt(c.Document.Frontmatter,"audit_rounds")})};for _,m:=range s.Modules{r.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name]=0;for _,id:=range asStrings(m.Document.Frontmatter["quarantine"]){r.Quarantines=append(r.Quarantines,model.Quarantine{Module:m.Name,ID:id})};if reason:=fmString(m.Document.Frontmatter,"boundaries_opt_out");reason!=""{r.BoundaryOptOuts=append(r.BoundaryOptOuts,model.BoundaryOptOut{Module:m.Name,Reason:reason})}};snapshots,_:=Costs(root);latest:=map[string]model.ModuleCost{};for _,c:=range snapshots{for _,m:=range c.Modules{latest[m.Module]=m}};for _,m:=range s.Modules{if c,ok:=latest[m.Name];ok{r.Costs=append(r.Costs,c)}};return r,nil}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (

+func removeDisposable(root string,s project.Snapshot,name string)error{m,ok:=module(s,name);if !ok{return nil};return filepath.Walk(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),func(path string,info os.FileInfo,e error)error{if e!=nil||info==nil||!info.Mode().IsRegular(){return nil};rel,re:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),path);if re!=nil{return re};if contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones)=="disposable"{return os.Remove(path)};return nil})}
+func newerDrill(root,module string)bool{matches,_:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root,"changes/archive/*.md"));latest:=time.Time{};for _,path:=range matches{b,e:=os.ReadFile(path);if e!=nil{continue};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil||fmString(d.Frontmatter,"module")!=module||fmString(d.Frontmatter,"phase")!="applied"{continue};for _,line:=range strings.Split(section(string(b),"Provenance"),"\n"){fields:=strings.Fields(line);if len(fields)>=3&&fields[0]=="-"&&fields[1]=="impl"{if t,e:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,fields[2]);e==nil&&t.After(latest){latest=t}}}};b,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root,".fireweed/drills",module+".md"));if e!=nil{return false};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil||fmString(d.Frontmatter,"result")!="pass"{return false};date:=fmString(d.Frontmatter,"date");t,e:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,date);return e==nil&&t.After(latest)}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/verify.go
@@ -0,0 +1,339 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"reflect"
+	"regexp"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+var heading = regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^## ([^\n]+)\s*$`)
+
+func bodyParts(body string) map[string]string {
+	out := map[string]string{}
+	loc := heading.FindAllStringSubmatchIndex(body, -1)
+	for i, m := range loc {
+		end := len(body)
+		if i+1 < len(loc) {
+			end = loc[i+1][0]
+		}
+		out[strings.TrimSpace(body[m[2]:m[3]])] = strings.TrimSpace(body[m[1]:end])
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func approvedError(cl claim, current string) error {
+	old, e := contracts.ParseDocument(cl.Approved)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	now, e := contracts.ParseDocument(current)
+	if e != nil {
+		return problem("P03", "approved author metadata changed: %v", e)
+	}
+	if fmString(now.Frontmatter, "run") != cl.Run || fmString(now.Frontmatter, "phase") != cl.Phase {
+		return problem("P03", "approved run or phase changed")
+	}
+	if fmInt(now.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds") != fmInt(old.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds") || fmString(now.Frontmatter, "blocked") != fmString(old.Frontmatter, "blocked") {
+		return problem("P03", "approved audit state changed")
+	}
+	for _, m := range []map[string]any{old.Frontmatter, now.Frontmatter} {
+		delete(m, "run")
+		delete(m, "phase")
+		delete(m, "audit_rounds")
+		delete(m, "blocked")
+	}
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(old.Frontmatter, now.Frontmatter) {
+		return problem("P03", "approved author metadata changed")
+	}
+	a, b := bodyParts(old.Body), bodyParts(now.Body)
+	for _, name := range []string{"Motivation", "Interface", "Added", "Modified", "Removed", "Removed decisions"} {
+		if a[name] != b[name] {
+			return problem("P03", "approved author metadata changed")
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func module(s project.Snapshot, name string) (project.Module, bool) {
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		if m.Name == name {
+			return m, true
+		}
+	}
+	return project.Module{}, false
+}
+func moduleSpecs(s project.Snapshot, name string) []contracts.Item {
+	m, ok := module(s, name)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil
+	}
+	items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs"))
+	out := []contracts.Item{}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(it.Tag), "quarantine") {
+			out = append(out, it)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func validateHeld(root string, c project.Change, cl claim) error {
+	head, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if head != cl.Base {
+		return problem("P05", "phase base changed from %s to %s", cl.Base, head)
+	}
+	raw, e := read(root, c.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = approvedError(cl, raw); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return stale(root, c)
+}
+func checkZones(root string, c project.Change, cl claim) error {
+	changes, e := gitstore.Changes(root, cl.Base)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if len(asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+		for _, ch := range changes {
+			p := ch.Path
+			if p == "" {
+				p = ch.OldPath
+			}
+			if p == c.Path {
+				continue
+			}
+			m, ok := module(cl.Snapshot, c.Module)
+			if !ok {
+				return problem("Z01", "unknown module %s", c.Module)
+			}
+			zone := ""
+			if strings.HasPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/") {
+				zone = contracts.ResolveZone(strings.TrimPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/"), m.Zones)
+			}
+			if !(cl.Phase == "evals" && zone == "evals") {
+				return problem("Z01", "forbidden %s edit: %s", cl.Phase, p)
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	ds := checks.Zones(checks.ZoneRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Module: c.Module, Phase: cl.Phase, ChangePath: c.Path, Base: cl.Base, InterfaceDeclared: strings.TrimSpace(section(c.Document.Body, "Interface")) != "", Changes: changes})
+	return errDiagnostic(ds)
+}
+func auditSubmission(raw string, c project.Change, s project.Snapshot, approved string) (string, bool, error) {
+	body := section(raw, "Audit")
+	lines := strings.Split(body, "\n")
+	findings := []string{}
+	checked := map[string]bool{}
+	no := false
+	for _, line := range lines {
+		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "Checked IDs:") {
+			for _, id := range strings.FieldsFunc(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "Checked IDs:"), func(r rune) bool { return r == ',' || r == ' ' || r == '\t' }) {
+				checked[id] = true
+			}
+		}
+		if strings.Contains(line, "No findings") {
+			no = true
+		}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "- ") {
+			findings = append(findings, line)
+		}
+	}
+	valid := []string{}
+	specs := map[string]string{}
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		for _, it := range moduleSpecs(s, m.Name) {
+			specs[it.ID] = it.Body
+		}
+	}
+	previous := section(approved, "Audit")
+	for _, line := range findings {
+		match := regexp.MustCompile(`(?:\[untestable\]\s*)?([A-Z]+-\d+):\s*"([^"]+)"`).FindStringSubmatch(line)
+		if len(match) != 3 || !strings.Contains(specs[match[1]], match[2]) {
+			continue
+		}
+		if fmInt(c.Document.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds") > 0 && !strings.Contains(previous, match[1]) {
+			continue
+		}
+		valid = append(valid, line)
+	}
+	if len(valid) > 0 {
+		return strings.Join(valid, "\n") + "\n", true, nil
+	}
+	if !no || len(checked) == 0 {
+		return "", false, problem("P09", "audit requires Checked IDs and No findings")
+	}
+	required := []string{}
+	for _, i := range append(c.Added, c.Modified...) {
+		required = append(required, i.ID)
+	}
+	required = append(required, asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["fixes"])...)
+	required = append(required, asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])...)
+	for _, id := range required {
+		if !checked[id] {
+			return "", false, problem("P09", "audit did not check %s", id)
+		}
+	}
+	ids := []string{}
+	for id := range checked {
+		ids = append(ids, id)
+	}
+	return "No findings; checked " + strings.Join(ids, ", ") + "\n", false, nil
+}
+func Verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) { return verify(ctx, req) }
+func verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	root, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.Result{}, e
+	}
+	c, cl, oid, e := held(root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.Result{}, e
+	}
+	st, e := state(root, c, cl, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.Result{}, e
+	}
+	r := model.Result{State: st, Reports: map[string]checks.Report{}, Costs: []model.ModuleCost{}}
+	if cl.Phase != "evals" && cl.Phase != "audit" && cl.Phase != "impl" {
+		return r, problem("P01", "unsupported phase %s", cl.Phase)
+	}
+	if e = validateHeld(root, c, cl); e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	if e = checkZones(root, c, cl); e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	if cl.Phase == "audit" {
+		raw, _ := read(root, c.Path)
+		_, _, e = auditSubmission(raw, c, cl.Snapshot, cl.Approved)
+		return r, e
+	}
+	targets := []string{c.Module}
+	if cl.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
+		mode := cfgString(cl.Snapshot, "verify_dependents", "direct")
+		for _, m := range cl.Snapshot.Modules {
+			if m.Name == c.Module {
+				continue
+			}
+			direct := false
+			for _, dep := range m.DependsOn {
+				if dep == c.Module {
+					direct = true
+				}
+			}
+			if mode == "all" && depends(cl.Snapshot.Modules, m.Name, c.Module) || mode == "direct" && direct {
+				targets = append(targets, m.Name)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	var first error
+	for _, name := range targets {
+		specs := moduleSpecs(cl.Snapshot, name)
+		report, evalErr := checks.Evaluate(ctx, checks.HookRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Module: name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		r.Reports[name] = report
+		saveReport(root, cl.Run, cl.Phase, name, report)
+		if len(report.Cases) > 0 {
+			if ce := checks.RequireCoverage(report, specs); ce != nil && first == nil {
+				first = ce
+			}
+		}
+		if name == c.Module && cl.Phase == "evals" {
+			if len(asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+				if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && first == nil {
+					first = ce
+				}
+				for _, id := range asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"]) {
+					found := false
+					for _, cas := range report.Cases {
+						for _, x := range cas.IDs {
+							if x == id {
+								found = true
+							}
+						}
+					}
+					if !found && first == nil {
+						first = problem("C10", "no coverage for %s", id)
+					}
+				}
+			} else {
+				ids := []string{}
+				for _, it := range append(c.Added, c.Modified...) {
+					ids = append(ids, it.ID)
+				}
+				ids = append(ids, asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["fixes"])...)
+				if ce := checks.RequireFailFirst(report, ids, asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["already_satisfied"])); ce != nil && first == nil {
+					first = ce
+				}
+			}
+		} else {
+			if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && first == nil {
+				first = ce
+			}
+		}
+		if evalErr != nil && first == nil && len(report.Cases) == 0 {
+			first = evalErr
+		}
+	}
+	r.Costs = measureCosts(root, cl.Snapshot, r.Reports)
+	r.Diagnostics = budgetDiagnostics(cl.Snapshot, r.Costs)
+	saveCosts(root, cl, r.Costs, r.Diagnostics)
+	if cl.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
+		ds, be := checks.Boundaries(ctx, checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, ds...)
+		if be != nil && first == nil {
+			first = be
+		}
+	}
+	return r, first
+}
+func saveReport(root, run, phase, name string, report checks.Report) {
+	dir := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "runs", run, phase)
+	_ = os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755)
+	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
+	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".json"), b, 0644)
+	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".out"), []byte(report.Stdout+report.Stderr), 0644)
+}
+func provenance(req model.Request, phase string, reports map[string]checks.Report) string {
+	agent := req.Agent
+	if agent == "" {
+		agent = "manual"
+	}
+	playbook, _ := assets.Playbook(phase)
+	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(playbook))
+	total, passing, failing := 0, 0, 0
+	for _, r := range reports {
+		for _, c := range r.Cases {
+			total++
+			if c.Result == "pass" {
+				passing++
+			}
+			if c.Result == "fail" || c.Result == "error" {
+				failing++
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d", phase, time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), agent, assets.Version(), hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]), total, failing, passing)
+}
+func appendProvenance(raw, line string) string {
+	old := section(raw, "Provenance")
+	return contracts.ReplaceSection(raw, "Provenance", strings.TrimSpace(old)+"\n"+line+"\n")
+}

+func Block(req model.BlockRequest)(model.BlockResult,error){root,e:=canonical(req.Root);if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};c,cl,oid,e:=held(root,req.Change);if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};if e=validateHeld(root,c,cl);e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};prefix:="refs/fireweed/attempts/"+strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path),".md")+"/";refs,_:=git(root,"for-each-ref","--format=%(refname)",prefix);used:=map[int]bool{};for _,line:=range strings.Split(refs,"\n"){n,_:=strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(line,prefix));if n>0{used[n]=true}};n:=1;for used[n]{n++};ref:=fmt.Sprintf("%s%d",prefix,n);if _,e=git(root,"add","-A");e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};tree,e:=git(root,"write-tree");if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};attempt,e:=git(root,"commit-tree",tree,"-p",cl.Base,"-m","fireweed attempt "+c.Slug);if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};if e=gitstore.CASRef(root,ref,"",attempt);e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};if _,e=git(root,"reset","--hard",cl.Base);e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};_,_=git(root,"clean","-fd");doc,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(cl.Approved);if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};doc.Frontmatter["blocked"]=req.Reason;raw,e:=contracts.RenderDocument(doc);if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};if e=write(root,c.Path,raw);e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};head,e:=commitAll(root,"fireweed: block "+c.Slug);if e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};if e=gitstore.CASRef(root,claimName(c),oid,"");e!=nil{return model.BlockResult{},e};s,e:=project.Project(root,c.Slug);if e!=nil{s=cl.Snapshot};s.Root=root;c.Document=doc;c.Added,_=contracts.ParseItems(section(raw,"Added"));return model.BlockResult{State:model.State{Change:c,Snapshot:s,Run:cl.Run,Phase:cl.Phase,Head:head,PhaseBase:head},AttemptRef:ref,AttemptOID:attempt},nil}
+func restoreAttempt(root string,c project.Change,phase string,n int)error{ref:=fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d",strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path),".md"),n);out,e:=git(root,"diff","--name-status",ref+"^",ref);if e!=nil{return e};for _,line:=range strings.Split(out,"\n"){parts:=strings.Split(line,"\t");if len(parts)<2{continue};status,path:=parts[0],parts[len(parts)-1];if path==c.Path{savedBytes,se:=gitBytes(root,"show",ref+":"+path);if se!=nil{continue};saved,se:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(savedBytes));if se!=nil{continue};currentRaw,re:=read(root,path);if re!=nil{return re};current,re:=contracts.ParseDocument(currentRaw);if re!=nil{return re};for _,sectionName:=range []string{"Decisions","Questions"}{if body,ok:=contracts.Section(saved.Body,sectionName);ok{current.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(current.Body,sectionName,body)}};if phase=="audit"{if body,ok:=contracts.Section(saved.Body,"Audit");ok{current.Body=contracts.ReplaceSection(current.Body,"Audit",body)}};rendered,re:=contracts.RenderDocument(current);if re!=nil{return re};if re=write(root,path,rendered);re!=nil{return re};continue};if strings.HasPrefix(status,"D"){_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path)));continue};b,se:=gitBytes(root,"show",ref+":"+path);if se!=nil{return se};if e=write(root,path,string(b));e!=nil{return e}};return nil}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "strings"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+)
+
+func Context(root,selector string,full bool)(string,error){root,e:=canonical(root);if e!=nil{return "",e};c,cl,_,e:=held(root,selector);if e!=nil{return "",e};var b strings.Builder;raw,e:=read(root,c.Path);if e!=nil{return "",e};fmt.Fprintf(&b,"# Change\n%s\n",raw);for _,m:=range cl.Snapshot.Modules{if m.Name==c.Module{spec,_:=read(root,filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir,"SPEC.md")));fmt.Fprintf(&b,"# Projected spec\n%s\n",m.Document.Body);_ = spec;_ = filepath.Walk(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),func(path string,info os.FileInfo,e error)error{if e!=nil||info==nil||info.IsDir(){return nil};rel,_:=filepath.Rel(root,path);name:=filepath.ToSlash(rel);if name==filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir,"SPEC.md")){return nil};if strings.HasSuffix(name,".go")&& !strings.Contains(name,"/internal/")&&!strings.Contains(name,"/evals/"){content,_:=os.ReadFile(path);fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n# %s\n%s\n",name,content)}else if full{content,_:=os.ReadFile(path);fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n# %s (%d bytes)\n%s\n",name,info.Size(),content)}else{fmt.Fprintf(&b,"%s %d bytes\n",name,info.Size())};return nil})}};system,_:=read(root,"SYSTEM.md");fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n# SYSTEM\n%s\n",system);name:=cl.Phase;if name=="impl"&&fmBool(c.Document.Frontmatter,"regenerate"){name="regenerate"};playbook,e:=assets.Playbook(name);if e==nil{fmt.Fprintf(&b,"\n%s\n",playbook)};return b.String(),nil}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "crypto/rand"
+ "encoding/hex"
+ "encoding/json"
+ "fmt"

+
+type claim struct { Worktree string `json:"worktree"`; Change string `json:"change"`; Run string `json:"run"`; Phase string `json:"phase"`; Base string `json:"base"`; Approved string `json:"approved"`; Snapshot project.Snapshot `json:"snapshot"` }
+func problem(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf(code+": "+format,args...) }
+func canonical(root string)(string,error){ p,e:=filepath.Abs(root); if e!=nil{return "",e}; return filepath.EvalSymlinks(p) }
+func git(root string,args ...string)(string,error){ c:=exec.Command("git",args...);c.Dir=root;b,e:=c.CombinedOutput();if e!=nil{return "",fmt.Errorf("git %s: %s: %w",strings.Join(args," "),strings.TrimSpace(string(b)),e)};return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)),nil }
+func gitBytes(root string,args ...string)([]byte,error){c:=exec.Command("git",args...);c.Dir=root;return c.Output()}
+func read(root,path string)(string,error){b,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path)));return string(b),e}
+func write(root,path,value string)error{p:=filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(path));if e:=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p),0755);e!=nil{return e};return os.WriteFile(p,[]byte(value),0644)}
+func fmString(m map[string]any,key string)string{v,_:=m[key].(string);return v}
+func fmInt(m map[string]any,key string)int{switch v:=m[key].(type){case int:return v;case float64:return int(v);case string:n,_:=strconv.Atoi(v);return n};return 0}
+func fmBool(m map[string]any,key string)bool{v,_:=m[key].(bool);return v}
+func asMap(v any)map[string]any{m,_:=v.(map[string]any);return m}
+func asStrings(v any)[]string{var out []string;switch x:=v.(type){case []any:for _,a:=range x{out=append(out,fmt.Sprint(a))};case []string:return x;case string:if x!=""{out=append(out,x)}};return out}
+func configMap(s project.Snapshot,path string)map[string]any{m:=s.Config;for _,p:=range strings.Split(path,"."){m=asMap(m[p])};return m}
+func setting(s project.Snapshot,path string)any{ps:=strings.Split(path,".");m:=s.Config;for _,p:=range ps[:len(ps)-1]{m=asMap(m[p])};return m[ps[len(ps)-1]]}
+func cfgInt(s project.Snapshot,path string,def int)int{v:=setting(s,path);if v==nil{return def};switch n:=v.(type){case int:return n;case float64:return int(n)};return def}
+func cfgString(s project.Snapshot,path,def string)string{v,_:=setting(s,path).(string);if v==""{return def};return v}
+func cfgBool(s project.Snapshot,path string,def bool)bool{v:=setting(s,path);if v==nil{return def};b,ok:=v.(bool);if !ok{return def};return b}
+func diag(code,msg string,warn bool)project.Diagnostic{return project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Message:msg,Warning:warn}}
+func errDiagnostic(ds []project.Diagnostic)error{for _,d:=range ds{if !d.Warning{return problem(d.Code,"%s",d.Message)}};return nil}
+func clean(root string)error{out,e:=git(root,"status","--porcelain","--untracked-files=all");if e!=nil{return e};if out!=""{return problem("P01","start requires clean worktree")};return nil}
+func queued(root,selector string)(project.Change,error){q,e:=project.Queue(root);if e!=nil{return project.Change{},e};var found []project.Change;for _,c:=range q{if selector==c.Slug||selector==strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path),".md")||selector==filepath.Base(c.Path)||selector==c.Path{found=append(found,c)}};if len(found)==1{return found[0],nil};valid:=[]string{};for _,c:=range q{valid=append(valid,c.Slug)};if len(found)>1{return project.Change{},problem("U02","change %q ambiguous; valid slugs: %s",selector,strings.Join(valid,", "))};return project.Change{},problem("U02","change %q not found; valid slugs: %s",selector,strings.Join(valid,", "))}
+func claimName(c project.Change)string{return "refs/fireweed/claims/"+strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path),".md")}
+func loadClaim(root string,c project.Change)(claim,string,bool,error){name:=claimName(c);oid,ok,e:=gitstore.Ref(root,name);if e!=nil||!ok{return claim{},oid,ok,e};b,e:=gitstore.ReadBlob(root,oid);if e!=nil{return claim{},oid,true,e};var cl claim;if e=json.Unmarshal(b,&cl);e!=nil{return cl,oid,true,e};return cl,oid,true,nil}
+func saveClaim(root string,c project.Change,cl claim,old string)(string,error){b,e:=json.Marshal(cl);if e!=nil{return "",e};oid,e:=gitstore.WriteBlob(root,b);if e!=nil{return "",e};if e=gitstore.CASRef(root,claimName(c),old,oid);e!=nil{return "",problem("P02","claim already held: %v",e)};return oid,nil}
+func held(root,selector string)(project.Change,claim,string,error){root,e:=canonical(root);if e!=nil{return project.Change{},claim{},"",e};if selector==""{q,e:=project.Queue(root);if e!=nil{return project.Change{},claim{},"",e};for _,c:=range q{cl,oid,ok,e:=loadClaim(root,c);if e!=nil{return c,cl,oid,e};if ok&&cl.Worktree==root{return c,cl,oid,nil}};return project.Change{},claim{},"",problem("P02","worktree holds no change")};c,e:=queued(root,selector);if e!=nil{return c,claim{},"",e};cl,oid,ok,e:=loadClaim(root,c);if e!=nil{return c,cl,oid,e};if !ok{return c,cl,oid,problem("P02","change has no claim")};if cl.Worktree!=root{return c,cl,oid,problem("P02","claim belongs to another worktree")};return c,cl,oid,nil}
+func state(root string,c project.Change,cl claim,oid string)(model.State,error){b,e:=read(root,c.Path);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};doc,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(b);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};c.Document=doc;c.Added,_=contracts.ParseItems(section(b,"Added"));c.Modified,_=contracts.ParseItems(section(b,"Modified"));c.Removed,_=contracts.ParseItems(section(b,"Removed"));s:=cl.Snapshot;s.Root=root;head,_:=git(root,"rev-parse","HEAD");return model.State{Change:c,Snapshot:s,Run:cl.Run,Phase:cl.Phase,Head:head,PhaseBase:cl.Base,ClaimOID:oid},nil}
+func section(s,name string)string{v,_:=contracts.Section(s,name);return v}
+func Current(root,selector string)(model.State,error){r,e:=canonical(root);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};c,cl,oid,e:=held(r,selector);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};return state(r,c,cl,oid)}
+func randomRun()string{b:=make([]byte,16);_,_=rand.Read(b);return time.Now().UTC().Format("20060102T150405Z")+"-"+hex.EncodeToString(b)}
+var addedHandle=regexp.MustCompile(`new:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`)
+func assignIDs(root string,c project.Change,body string)(string,error){handles:=[]string{};seen:=map[string]bool{};for _,item:=range c.Added{if addedHandle.MatchString(item.ID)&&!seen[item.ID]{handles=append(handles,item.ID);seen[item.ID]=true}};if len(handles)==0{return body,nil};s,e:=project.Load(root);if e!=nil{return body,e};prefix:="";used:=map[string]bool{};for _,m:=range s.Modules{if m.Name==c.Module{prefix=m.IDPrefix};items,_:=contracts.ParseItems(section(m.Document.Body,"Specs"));for _,i:=range items{used[i.ID]=true}};q,_:=project.Queue(root);for _,v:=range q{for _,i:=range append(v.Added,v.Modified...){if !addedHandle.MatchString(i.ID){used[i.ID]=true}}};if prefix==""{return body,fmt.Errorf("module %s absent",c.Module)};next:=1;for _,h:=range handles{for used[fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d",prefix,next)]{next++};id:=fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d",prefix,next);used[id]=true;body=strings.ReplaceAll(body,h,id);next++};return body,nil}
+func initialPhase(c project.Change)string{d:=c.Document.Frontmatter;if p:=fmString(d,"phase");p!=""{return p};if fmBool(d,"regenerate"){return "impl"};if len(c.Added)==0&&len(c.Modified)==0&&len(c.Removed)==0&&len(asStrings(d["fixes"]))==0&&len(asStrings(d["eval_fix"]))==0{return "impl"};return "evals"}
+func stale(root string,c project.Change)error{ss,e:=project.StaleSpecs(root,c.Slug);if e!=nil{return e};for _,x:=range ss{if !x.Recovered{return problem("P05","stale base for %s",x.ID)}};return nil}
+func Start(root,selector string)(model.State,error){return startInternal(root,selector,0,false)}
+func StartFromAttempt(root,selector string,attempt int)(model.State,error){if attempt<=0{return model.State{},problem("P01","invalid attempt %d",attempt)};return startInternal(root,selector,attempt,true)}
+func startInternal(root,selector string,attempt int,resume bool)(model.State,error){root,e:=canonical(root);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};if e=clean(root);e!=nil{return model.State{},e};eligible,e:=Eligible(root);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};if len(eligible)==0{return model.State{},problem("P01","no eligible change")};c:=eligible[0];if selector!=""{selected,se:=queued(root,selector);if se!=nil{return model.State{},se};if selected.Path!=c.Path{return model.State{},problem("P01","change is not eligible queue head")}};if resume{ref:=fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d",strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path),".md"),attempt);if _,ok,_:=gitstore.Ref(root,ref);!ok{return model.State{},problem("P01","attempt %d not found",attempt)}};cl,_,ok,e:=loadClaim(root,c);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};if ok{return model.State{},problem("P02","claim already held: update-ref %s owned by %s",claimName(c),cl.Worktree)};if e=stale(root,c);e!=nil{return model.State{},e};for _,d:=range project.Check(root){if !d.Warning{return model.State{},problem(d.Code,"%s",d.Message)}};head,e:=git(root,"rev-parse","HEAD");if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};original,e:=read(root,c.Path);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};approved:=original;phase:=initialPhase(c);run:=fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"run");if run==""{run=randomRun()};if !resume&&fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"phase")==""{approved,e=assignIDs(root,c,approved);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};doc,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(approved);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e};doc.Frontmatter["run"]=run;doc.Frontmatter["phase"]=phase;approved,e=contracts.RenderDocument(doc);if e!=nil{return model.State{},e}}
+ if resume{phase=fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"phase")};if approved!=original{if e=write(root,c.Path,approved);e!=nil{return model.State{},e}};snapshot,e:=project.Project(root,c.Slug);if e!=nil{if approved!=original{_ = write(root,c.Path,original)};return model.State{},e};snapshot.Root=root;cl=claim{Worktree:root,Change:c.Path,Run:run,Phase:phase,Base:head,Approved:approved,Snapshot:snapshot};oid,e:=saveClaim(root,c,cl,"");if e!=nil{if approved!=original{_ = write(root,c.Path,original)};return model.State{},e};if resume{if e=restoreAttempt(root,c,phase,attempt);e!=nil{return model.State{},e}}else if fmBool(c.Document.Frontmatter,"regenerate")&&fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter,"phase")==""{_ = removeDisposable(root,snapshot,c.Module)};s,e:=state(root,c,cl,oid);if e!=nil{return s,e};if !existsAtBase(root,c.Path){s.Diagnostics=append(s.Diagnostics,diag("P04","change is absent from local and shared base",true))};if fmBool(c.Document.Frontmatter,"regenerate")&&!newerDrill(root,c.Module){s.Diagnostics=append(s.Diagnostics,diag("P10","no newer passing drill for "+c.Module,true))};return s,nil}
+func existsAtBase(root,path string)bool{s,e:=project.Load(root);if e!=nil{return false};base:=cfgString(s,"base","main");remote:=cfgString(s,"remote","origin");for _,ref:=range []string{base,"refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base}{if _,e:=gitBytes(root,"show",ref+":"+path);e==nil{return true}};return false}
+func Release(root,selector string)error{r,e:=canonical(root);if e!=nil{return e};c,_,oid,e:=held(r,selector);if e!=nil{return e};return gitstore.CASRef(r,claimName(c),oid,"")}
+func commitPaths(root,subject string,paths []string)(string,error){return gitstore.Commit(root,subject,paths)}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "encoding/json"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "sort"
+ "strings"
+ "time"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func lineCount(b []byte)int{if len(b)==0{return 0};n:=0;for _,v:=range b{if v=='\n'{n++}};if b[len(b)-1]!='\n'{n++};return n}
+func measureCosts(root string,s project.Snapshot,reports map[string]checks.Report)[]model.ModuleCost{out:=[]model.ModuleCost{};for name,report:=range reports{m,ok:=module(s,name);if !ok{continue};cost:=model.ModuleCost{Module:name,CasesPerSpec:map[string]int{}};for _,cas:=range report.Cases{cost.Seconds+=cas.Seconds;for _,id:=range cas.IDs{cost.CasesPerSpec[id]++}};_ = filepath.Walk(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),func(path string,info os.FileInfo,e error)error{if e!=nil||info==nil||!info.Mode().IsRegular(){return nil};rel,re:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),path);if re!=nil{return nil};zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones);if zone!="evals"&&zone!="disposable"{return nil};b,re:=os.ReadFile(path);if re!=nil{return nil};if zone=="evals"{cost.EvalLines+=lineCount(b)}else{cost.DisposableLines+=lineCount(b)};return nil});out=append(out,cost)};sort.Slice(out,func(i,j int)bool{return out[i].Module<out[j].Module});return out}
+func budgetDiagnostics(s project.Snapshot,costs []model.ModuleCost)[]project.Diagnostic{ds:=[]project.Diagnostic{};limit:=15*time.Minute;if v:=cfgString(s,"budgets.verify_time","");v!=""{if d,e:=time.ParseDuration(v);e==nil{limit=d}};casesLimit:=cfgInt(s,"budgets.cases_per_spec",15);ratio:=cfgInt(s,"budgets.eval_ratio",4);seconds:=0.0;for _,c:=range costs{seconds+=c.Seconds;for id,n:=range c.CasesPerSpec{if n>casesLimit{ds=append(ds,diag("B02",fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d cases; limit %d",id,n,casesLimit),true))}};if c.EvalLines>0&&(c.DisposableLines==0||float64(c.EvalLines)/float64(c.DisposableLines)>float64(ratio)){ds=append(ds,diag("B03",fmt.Sprintf("%s eval/disposable ratio %d/%d exceeds %d",c.Module,c.EvalLines,c.DisposableLines,ratio),true))}};if seconds>limit.Seconds(){ds=append(ds,diag("B01",fmt.Sprintf("verification %.3f seconds exceeds %s (%.0f seconds)",seconds,limit,limit.Seconds()),true))};return ds}
+func saveCosts(root string,cl claim,costs []model.ModuleCost,ds []project.Diagnostic){p:=filepath.Join(root,".fireweed","runs",cl.Run,cl.Phase,"costs.json");_ = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p),0755);b,_:=json.MarshalIndent(model.CostSnapshot{Run:cl.Run,Phase:cl.Phase,RecordedAt:time.Now().UTC(),Modules:costs,Diagnostics:ds},"","  ");_ = os.WriteFile(p,b,0644)}
+func Costs(root string)([]model.CostSnapshot,error){out:=[]model.CostSnapshot{};base:=filepath.Join(root,".fireweed","runs");_ = filepath.Walk(base,func(path string,info os.FileInfo,e error)error{if e!=nil||info==nil||info.IsDir()||filepath.Base(path)!="costs.json"{return nil};b,re:=os.ReadFile(path);if re!=nil{return nil};var c model.CostSnapshot;if json.Unmarshal(b,&c)==nil{out=append(out,c)};return nil});sort.Slice(out,func(i,j int)bool{return out[i].RecordedAt.Before(out[j].RecordedAt)});return out,nil}
+var _=strings.TrimSpace

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..eacd399d5f82e712817ef4ac6cdfc87dac272d84
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go
@@ -0,0 +1,244 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func commitAll(root, subject string) (string, error) {
+	if _, e := git(root, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e := git(root, "commit", "-m", subject); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	return git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+}
+func updateHeld(root string, c project.Change, cl claim, oid, raw, phase string, release bool) (model.State, error) {
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	doc.Frontmatter["phase"] = phase
+	next, e := contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if e = write(root, c.Path, next); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	newHead, e := commitAll(root, "fireweed: "+c.Slug+" "+cl.Phase+" -> "+phase)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	cl.Phase = phase
+	cl.Base = newHead
+	cl.Approved = next
+	if release {
+		if e := Release(root, c.Slug); e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		s := model.State{Change: c, Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Run: cl.Run, Phase: phase, Head: newHead, PhaseBase: newHead}
+		return s, nil
+	}
+	newOID, e := saveClaim(root, c, cl, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	return state(root, c, cl, newOID)
+}
+func Done(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	r, e := verify(ctx, req)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	root, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	c, cl, oid, e := held(root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	raw, e := read(root, c.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	raw = appendProvenance(raw, provenance(req, cl.Phase, r.Reports))
+	switch cl.Phase {
+	case "evals":
+		next := "audit"
+		if !cfgBool(cl.Snapshot, "audit.enabled", true) {
+			next = "impl"
+		}
+		r.State, e = updateHeld(root, c, cl, oid, raw, next, false)
+		return r, e
+	case "audit":
+		normalized, findings, e := auditSubmission(raw, c, cl.Snapshot, cl.Approved)
+		if e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		raw = contracts.ReplaceSection(raw, "Audit", normalized)
+		if findings {
+			round := fmInt(c.Document.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds")
+			blocked := strings.Contains(normalized, "[untestable]") || round >= cfgInt(cl.Snapshot, "audit.max_rounds", 2)
+			if blocked {
+				doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+				if e != nil {
+					return r, e
+				}
+				doc.Frontmatter["blocked"] = "audit findings"
+				raw, e = contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+				if e != nil {
+					return r, e
+				}
+				raw = contracts.ReplaceSection(raw, "Questions", normalized)
+				r.State, e = updateHeld(root, c, cl, oid, raw, "audit", true)
+				if e != nil {
+					return r, e
+				}
+				return r, problem("P06", "change blocked")
+			}
+			doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+			if e != nil {
+				return r, e
+			}
+			doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"] = round + 1
+			raw, e = contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+			if e != nil {
+				return r, e
+			}
+			r.State, e = updateHeld(root, c, cl, oid, raw, "evals", false)
+			return r, e
+		}
+		r.State, e = updateHeld(root, c, cl, oid, raw, "impl", false)
+		return r, e
+	case "impl":
+		if e = apply(root, c, cl, raw); e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		head, e := commitAll(root, "fireweed: apply "+c.Slug)
+		if e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		if e = releaseExact(root, c, oid); e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		r.State = model.State{Change: c, Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Run: cl.Run, Phase: "applied", Head: head, PhaseBase: head}
+		return r, nil
+	}
+	return r, problem("P01", "unsupported phase %s", cl.Phase)
+}
+func releaseExact(root string, c project.Change, oid string) error {
+	return gitstoreCAS(root, claimName(c), oid, "")
+}
+func gitstoreCAS(root, name, old, next string) error { return gitstore.CASRef(root, name, old, next) }
+func apply(root string, c project.Change, cl claim, raw string) error {
+	m, ok := module(cl.Snapshot, c.Module)
+	if !ok {
+		return fmt.Errorf("module %s absent", c.Module)
+	}
+	path := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir, "SPEC.md"))
+	original, e := read(root, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(original)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	current, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc.Body, "Specs"))
+	remove := map[string]bool{}
+	replace := map[string]contracts.Item{}
+	for _, it := range c.Removed {
+		remove[it.ID] = true
+	}
+	for _, it := range c.Modified {
+		replace[it.ID] = it
+	}
+	items := []contracts.Item{}
+	for _, it := range current {
+		if remove[it.ID] {
+			continue
+		}
+		if n, ok := replace[it.ID]; ok {
+			items = append(items, n)
+		} else {
+			items = append(items, it)
+		}
+	}
+	items = append(items, c.Added...)
+	rendered := []string{}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		rendered = append(rendered, strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Specs", "\n"+strings.Join(rendered, "\n\n")+"\n")
+	if set := asMap(c.Document.Frontmatter["set"]); len(set) > 0 {
+		for k, v := range set {
+			doc.Frontmatter[k] = v
+		}
+	}
+	decisions := strings.TrimSpace(section(doc.Body, "Decisions"))
+	removed := strings.TrimSpace(section(c.Document.Body, "Removed decisions"))
+	if removed != "" {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(removed, "\n") {
+			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+			if line != "" {
+				decisions = strings.ReplaceAll(decisions, line, "")
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	added := strings.TrimSpace(section(c.Document.Body, "Decisions"))
+	if added != "" {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(added, "\n") {
+			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+			if line != "" {
+				decisions += "\n- " + c.Slug + ": " + line
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Decisions", strings.TrimSpace(decisions)+"\n")
+	next, e := contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = write(root, path, next); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	archive := "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(c.Path)
+	archiveDoc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	archiveDoc.Frontmatter["phase"] = "applied"
+	archived, e := contracts.RenderDocument(archiveDoc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = write(root, archive, archived); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, c.Path)); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	for _, d := range project.Check(root) {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, archive))
+			_ = write(root, c.Path, cl.Approved)
+			_ = write(root, path, original)
+			return problem(d.Code, "%s", d.Message)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+var _ = regexp.MustCompile

+package lifecycle

+func GC(_ context.Context,req model.GCRequest)(model.GCResult,error){root,e:=canonical(req.Root);if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};s,e:=project.Load(root);if e!=nil{return model.GCResult{},e};age:=720*time.Hour;if v:=setting(s,"gc.drill_max_age");v!=nil{str:=v.(string);age,e=time.ParseDuration(str);if e!=nil||age<=0{return model.GCResult{},problem("C01","invalid gc.drill_max_age %q",str)}};now:=req.Now;if now.IsZero(){now=time.Now().UTC()};registered:=map[string]bool{};list,_:=git(root,"worktree","list","--porcelain");for _,line:=range strings.Split(list,"\n"){if strings.HasPrefix(line,"worktree "){p,_:=canonical(strings.TrimPrefix(line,"worktree "));registered[p]=true}};refs,_:=git(root,"for-each-ref","--format=%(refname)","refs/fireweed");result:=model.GCResult{Pruned:[]string{}};for _,ref:=range strings.Fields(refs){remove:=false;switch{case strings.HasPrefix(ref,"refs/fireweed/claims/"):oid,ok,_:=gitstore.Ref(root,ref);if ok{b,re:=gitstore.ReadBlob(root,oid);if re==nil{var entry struct{Worktree string `json:"worktree"`};_ = json.Unmarshal(b,&entry);p,_:=canonical(entry.Worktree);if _,se:=os.Stat(p);se!=nil||!registered[p]{remove=true}}};case strings.HasPrefix(ref,"refs/fireweed/attempts/"):parts:=strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(ref,"refs/fireweed/attempts/"),"/");if len(parts)==2{if n,_:=strconv.Atoi(parts[1]);n>0{matches,_:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root,"changes/archive/*-"+parts[0]+".md"));remove=len(matches)>0}};case strings.HasPrefix(ref,"refs/fireweed/drills/"):parts:=strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(ref,"refs/fireweed/drills/"),"/");if len(parts)==2{date,se:=time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000",parts[1]);if se==nil&&date.Before(now.Add(-age)){remove=true}}};if remove{oid,ok,_:=gitstore.Ref(root,ref);if ok&&gitstore.CASRef(root,ref,oid,"")==nil{result.Pruned=append(result.Pruned,ref)}}};sort.Strings(result.Pruned);return result,nil}

+package lifecycle
