+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+type claim struct {
+	Worktree string           `json:"worktree"`
+	Change   string           `json:"change"`
+	Run      string           `json:"run"`
+	Phase    string           `json:"phase"`
+	Base     string           `json:"base"`
+	Approved string           `json:"approved"`
+	Snapshot project.Snapshot `json:"snapshot"`
+}
+
+func problem(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf(code+": "+format, args...) }
+func canonical(root string) (string, error) {
+	p, e := filepath.Abs(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	return filepath.EvalSymlinks(p)
+}
+func git(root string, args ...string) (string, error) {
+	c := exec.Command("git", args...)
+	c.Dir = root
+	b, e := c.CombinedOutput()
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s: %s: %w", strings.Join(args, " "), strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), e)
+	}
+	return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), nil
+}
+func gitBytes(root string, args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
+	c := exec.Command("git", args...)
+	c.Dir = root
+	return c.Output()
+}
+func read(root, path string) (string, error) {
+	b, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path)))
+	return string(b), e
+}
+func write(root, path, value string) error {
+	p := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path))
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(p, []byte(value), 0644)
+}
+func fmString(m map[string]any, key string) string {
+	switch v := m[key].(type) {
+	case string: return v
+	case time.Time: return v.Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
+	}
+	return ""
+}
+func fmInt(m map[string]any, key string) int {
+	switch v := m[key].(type) {
+	case int:
+		return v
+	case float64:
+		return int(v)
+	case string:
+		n, _ := strconv.Atoi(v)
+		return n
+	}
+	return 0
+}
+func fmBool(m map[string]any, key string) bool { v, _ := m[key].(bool); return v }
+func asMap(v any) map[string]any               { m, _ := v.(map[string]any); return m }
+func asStrings(v any) []string {
+	var out []string
+	switch x := v.(type) {
+	case []any:
+		for _, a := range x {
+			out = append(out, fmt.Sprint(a))
+		}
+	case []string:
+		return x
+	case string:
+		if x != "" {
+			out = append(out, x)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func configMap(s project.Snapshot, path string) map[string]any {
+	m := s.Config
+	for _, p := range strings.Split(path, ".") {
+		m = asMap(m[p])
+	}
+	return m
+}
+func setting(s project.Snapshot, path string) any {
+	ps := strings.Split(path, ".")
+	m := s.Config
+	for _, p := range ps[:len(ps)-1] {
+		m = asMap(m[p])
+	}
+	return m[ps[len(ps)-1]]
+}
+func cfgInt(s project.Snapshot, path string, def int) int {
+	v := setting(s, path)
+	if v == nil {
+		return def
+	}
+	switch n := v.(type) {
+	case int:
+		return n
+	case float64:
+		return int(n)
+	}
+	return def
+}
+func cfgString(s project.Snapshot, path, def string) string {
+	v, _ := setting(s, path).(string)
+	if v == "" {
+		return def
+	}
+	return v
+}
+func cfgBool(s project.Snapshot, path string, def bool) bool {
+	v := setting(s, path)
+	if v == nil {
+		return def
+	}
+	b, ok := v.(bool)
+	if !ok {
+		return def
+	}
+	return b
+}
+func diag(code, msg string, warn bool) project.Diagnostic {
+	return project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Message: msg, Warning: warn}
+}
+func errDiagnostic(ds []project.Diagnostic) error {
+	for _, d := range ds {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			return problem(d.Code, "%s", d.Message)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func clean(root string) error {
+	out, e := git(root, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all")
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if out != "" {
+		return problem("P01", "start requires clean worktree")
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func queued(root, selector string) (project.Change, error) {
+	q, e := project.Queue(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return project.Change{}, e
+	}
+	var found []project.Change
+	for _, c := range q {
+		if selector == c.Slug || selector == strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(c.Path), ".md") || selector == filepath.Base(c.Path) || selector == c.Path {
+			found = append(found, c)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(found) == 1 {
+		return found[0], nil
+	}
+	valid := []string{}
+	for _, c := range q {
+		valid = append(valid, c.Slug)
+	}
+	if len(found) > 1 {
+		return project.Change{}, problem("U02", "change %q ambiguous; valid slugs: %s", selector, strings.Join(valid, ", "))
+	}
+	return project.Change{}, problem("U02", "change %q not found; valid slugs: %s", selector, strings.Join(valid, ", "))
+}
+func claimName(c project.Change) string {
+	return "refs/fireweed/claims/" + c.Slug
+}
+func loadClaim(root string, c project.Change) (claim, string, bool, error) {
+	name := claimName(c)
+	oid, ok, e := gitstore.Ref(root, name)
+	if e != nil || !ok {
+		return claim{}, oid, ok, e
+	}
+	b, e := gitstore.ReadBlob(root, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return claim{}, oid, true, e
+	}
+	var cl claim
+	if e = json.Unmarshal(b, &cl); e != nil {
+		return cl, oid, true, e
+	}
+	return cl, oid, true, nil
+}
+func saveClaim(root string, c project.Change, cl claim, old string) (string, error) {
+	b, e := json.Marshal(cl)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	oid, e := gitstore.WriteBlob(root, b)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(root, claimName(c), old, oid); e != nil {
+		return "", problem("P02", "claim already held: %v", e)
+	}
+	return oid, nil
+}
+func held(root, selector string) (project.Change, claim, string, error) {
+	root, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return project.Change{}, claim{}, "", e
+	}
+	if selector == "" {
+		q, e := project.Queue(root)
+		if e != nil {
+			return project.Change{}, claim{}, "", e
+		}
+		for _, c := range q {
+			cl, oid, ok, e := loadClaim(root, c)
+			if e != nil {
+				return c, cl, oid, e
+			}
+			if ok && cl.Worktree == root {
+				return c, cl, oid, nil
+			}
+		}
+		return project.Change{}, claim{}, "", problem("P02", "worktree holds no change")
+	}
+	c, e := queued(root, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return c, claim{}, "", e
+	}
+	cl, oid, ok, e := loadClaim(root, c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return c, cl, oid, e
+	}
+	if !ok {
+		return c, cl, oid, problem("P02", "change has no claim")
+	}
+	if cl.Worktree != root {
+		return c, cl, oid, problem("P02", "claim belongs to another worktree")
+	}
+	return c, cl, oid, nil
+}
+func state(root string, c project.Change, cl claim, oid string) (model.State, error) {
+	b, e := read(root, c.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(b)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	c.Document = doc
+	c.Added, _ = contracts.ParseItems(section(b, "Added"))
+	c.Modified, _ = contracts.ParseItems(section(b, "Modified"))
+	c.Removed, _ = contracts.ParseItems(section(b, "Removed"))
+	s := cl.Snapshot
+	s.Root = root
+	head, _ := git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	return model.State{Change: c, Snapshot: s, Run: cl.Run, Phase: cl.Phase, Head: head, PhaseBase: cl.Base, ClaimOID: oid}, nil
+}
+func section(s, name string) string { v, _ := contracts.Section(s, name); return v }
+func Current(root, selector string) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	c, cl, oid, e := held(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	return state(r, c, cl, oid)
+}
+func randomRun() string {
+	b := make([]byte, 16)
+	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
+	return time.Now().UTC().Format("20060102T150405Z") + "-" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
+}
+
+var addedHandle = regexp.MustCompile(`new:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`)
+
+func assignIDs(root string, c project.Change, body string) (string, error) {
+	handles := []string{}
+	seen := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, item := range c.Added {
+		if addedHandle.MatchString(item.ID) && !seen[item.ID] {
+			handles = append(handles, item.ID)
+			seen[item.ID] = true
+		}
+	}
+	if len(handles) == 0 {
+		return body, nil
+	}
+	s, e := project.Load(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return body, e
+	}
+	prefix := ""
+	used := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		if m.Name == c.Module {
+			prefix = m.IDPrefix
+		}
+		items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs"))
+		for _, i := range items {
+			used[i.ID] = true
+		}
+	}
+	q, _ := project.Queue(root)
+	for _, v := range q {
+		for _, i := range append(v.Added, v.Modified...) {
+			if !addedHandle.MatchString(i.ID) {
+				used[i.ID] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if prefix == "" {
+		return body, fmt.Errorf("module %s absent", c.Module)
+	}
+	next := 1
+	for _, h := range handles {
+		for used[fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d", prefix, next)] {
+			next++
+		}
+		id := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d", prefix, next)
+		used[id] = true
+		body = strings.ReplaceAll(body, h, id)
+		next++
+	}
+	return body, nil
+}
+func initialPhase(c project.Change) string {
+	d := c.Document.Frontmatter
+	if p := fmString(d, "phase"); p != "" {
+		return p
+	}
+	if fmBool(d, "regenerate") {
+		return "impl"
+	}
+	if len(c.Added) == 0 && len(c.Modified) == 0 && len(c.Removed) == 0 && len(asStrings(d["fixes"])) == 0 && len(asStrings(d["eval_fix"])) == 0 {
+		return "impl"
+	}
+	return "evals"
+}
+func stale(root string, c project.Change) error {
+	ss, e := project.StaleSpecs(root, c.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	for _, x := range ss {
+		if !x.Recovered {
+			return problem("P05", "stale base for %s", x.ID)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func Start(root, selector string) (model.State, error) {
+	return startInternal(root, selector, 0, false)
+}
+func StartFromAttempt(root, selector string, attempt int) (model.State, error) {
+	if attempt <= 0 {
+		return model.State{}, problem("P01", "invalid attempt %d", attempt)
+	}
+	return startInternal(root, selector, attempt, true)
+}
+func startInternal(root, selector string, attempt int, resume bool) (model.State, error) {
+	root, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if e = clean(root); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	eligible, e := Eligible(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(e.Error()),"stale base") { return model.State{},problem("P05","%v",e) }
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if len(eligible) == 0 {
+		return model.State{}, problem("P01", "no eligible change")
+	}
+	c := eligible[0]
+	if selector != "" {
+		selected, se := queued(root, selector)
+		if se != nil {
+			return model.State{}, se
+		}
+		if selected.Path != c.Path {
+			return model.State{}, problem("P01", "change is not eligible queue head")
+		}
+	}
+	if resume {
+		ref := fmt.Sprintf("refs/fireweed/attempts/%s/%d", c.Slug, attempt)
+		if _, ok, _ := gitstore.Ref(root, ref); !ok {
+			return model.State{}, problem("P01", "attempt %d not found", attempt)
+		}
+	}
+	cl, _, ok, e := loadClaim(root, c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if ok {
+		return model.State{}, problem("P02", "claim already held: update-ref %s owned by %s", claimName(c), cl.Worktree)
+	}
+	for _, d := range project.Check(root) {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message), "stale base") { return model.State{}, problem("P05", "%s", d.Message) }
+			return model.State{}, problem(d.Code, "%s", d.Message)
+		}
+	}
+	if e = stale(root, c); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if status, se := Status(root); se == nil {
+		loaded, _ := project.Load(root)
+		if status.Unapproved >= cfgInt(loaded, "authoring.max_unapproved", 5) {
+			return model.State{Diagnostics: []project.Diagnostic{diag("P07", "unapproved archive limit reached", false)}}, problem("P07", "unapproved archive limit reached")
+		}
+	}
+	head, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	original, e := read(root, c.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	approved := original
+	phase := initialPhase(c)
+	run := fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter, "run")
+	if run == "" {
+		run = randomRun()
+	}
+	if !resume && fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter, "phase") == "" {
+		approved, e = assignIDs(root, c, approved)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(approved)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		doc.Frontmatter["run"] = run
+		doc.Frontmatter["phase"] = phase
+		approved, e = contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	}
+	if resume {
+		phase = fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter, "phase")
+	}
+	if approved != original {
+		if e = write(root, c.Path, approved); e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	}
+	snapshot, e := project.Project(root, c.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		if approved != original {
+			_ = write(root, c.Path, original)
+		}
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	snapshot.Root = root
+	cl = claim{Worktree: root, Change: c.Path, Run: run, Phase: phase, Base: head, Approved: approved, Snapshot: snapshot}
+	oid, e := saveClaim(root, c, cl, "")
+	if e != nil {
+		if approved != original {
+			_ = write(root, c.Path, original)
+		}
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if resume {
+		if e = restoreAttempt(root, c, phase, attempt); e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	} else if fmBool(c.Document.Frontmatter, "regenerate") && fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter, "phase") == "" {
+		_ = removeDisposable(root, snapshot, c.Module)
+	}
+	s, e := state(root, c, cl, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	if !existsAtBase(root, c.Path) {
+		s.Diagnostics = append(s.Diagnostics, diag("P04", "change is absent from local and shared base", true))
+	}
+	if fmBool(c.Document.Frontmatter, "regenerate") && !newerDrill(root, c.Module) {
+		s.Diagnostics = append(s.Diagnostics, diag("P10", "no newer passing drill for "+c.Module, true))
+	}
+	return s, nil
+}
+func existsAtBase(root, path string) bool {
+	s, e := project.Load(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	base := cfgString(s, "base", "main")
+	remote := cfgString(s, "remote", "origin")
+	for _, ref := range []string{base, "refs/remotes/" + remote + "/" + base} {
+		if _, e := gitBytes(root, "show", ref+":"+path); e == nil {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
+func Release(root, selector string) error {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	c, _, oid, e := held(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return gitstore.CASRef(r, claimName(c), oid, "")
+}
+func commitPaths(root, subject string, paths []string) (string, error) {
+	return gitstore.Commit(root, subject, paths)
+}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/costs.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/costs.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..779decdbf5497b37fad502d751b112baa39bf8fa
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/costs.go
@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func lineCount(b []byte) int {
+	if len(b) == 0 {
+		return 0
+	}
+	n := 0
+	for _, v := range b {
+		if v == '\n' {
+			n++
+		}
+	}
+	if b[len(b)-1] != '\n' {
+		n++
+	}
+	return n
+}
+func measureCosts(root string, s project.Snapshot, reports map[string]checks.Report) []model.ModuleCost {
+	out := []model.ModuleCost{}
+	for name, report := range reports {
+		m, ok := module(s, name)
+		if !ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		cost := model.ModuleCost{Module: name, CasesPerSpec: map[string]int{}}
+		for _, cas := range report.Cases {
+			cost.Seconds += cas.Seconds
+			seen:=map[string]bool{}
+			for _, id := range cas.IDs {
+				if !seen[id] { cost.CasesPerSpec[id]++; seen[id]=true }
+			}
+		}
+		_ = filepath.Walk(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), func(path string, info os.FileInfo, e error) error {
+			if e != nil || info == nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			rel, re := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), path)
+			if re != nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			zone := contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones)
+			if zone != "evals" && zone != "disposable" {
+				return nil
+			}
+			b, re := os.ReadFile(path)
+			if re != nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			if zone == "evals" {
+				cost.EvalLines += lineCount(b)
+			} else {
+				cost.DisposableLines += lineCount(b)
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+		out = append(out, cost)
+	}
+	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Module < out[j].Module })
+	return out
+}
+func budgetDiagnostics(s project.Snapshot, costs []model.ModuleCost) []project.Diagnostic {
+	ds := []project.Diagnostic{}
+	limit := 15 * time.Minute
+	if v := cfgString(s, "budgets.verify_time", ""); v != "" {
+		if d, e := time.ParseDuration(v); e == nil {
+			limit = d
+		}
+	}
+	casesLimit := cfgInt(s, "budgets.cases_per_spec", 15)
+	ratio := cfgInt(s, "budgets.eval_ratio", 4)
+	seconds := 0.0
+	for _, c := range costs {
+		seconds += c.Seconds
+		for id, n := range c.CasesPerSpec {
+			if n > casesLimit {
+				ds = append(ds, diag("B02", fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d cases; limit %d", id, n, casesLimit), true))
+			}
+		}
+		if c.EvalLines > 0 && (c.DisposableLines == 0 || float64(c.EvalLines)/float64(c.DisposableLines) > float64(ratio)) {
+			ds = append(ds, diag("B03", fmt.Sprintf("%s eval/disposable ratio %d/%d exceeds %d", c.Module, c.EvalLines, c.DisposableLines, ratio), true))
+		}
+	}
+	if seconds > limit.Seconds() {
+		ds = append(ds, diag("B01", fmt.Sprintf("verification %.3f seconds exceeds %s (%.0f seconds)", seconds, limit, limit.Seconds()), true))
+	}
+	return ds
+}
+func saveCosts(root string, cl claim, costs []model.ModuleCost, ds []project.Diagnostic) {
+	p := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "runs", cl.Run, cl.Phase, "costs.json")
+	_ = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755)
+	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(model.CostSnapshot{Run: cl.Run, Phase: cl.Phase, RecordedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Modules: costs, Diagnostics: ds}, "", "  ")
+	_ = os.WriteFile(p, b, 0644)
+}
+func Costs(root string) ([]model.CostSnapshot, error) {
+	out := []model.CostSnapshot{}
+	base := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "runs")
+	_ = filepath.Walk(base, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, e error) error {
+		if e != nil || info == nil || info.IsDir() || filepath.Base(path) != "costs.json" {
+			return nil
+		}
+		b, re := os.ReadFile(path)
+		if re != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		var c model.CostSnapshot
+		if json.Unmarshal(b, &c) == nil {
+			out = append(out, c)
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].RecordedAt.Before(out[j].RecordedAt) })
+	return out, nil
+}
+
+var _ = strings.TrimSpace
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4fb988283a7a1a5bbcec0a3873e0d22dac0d1014
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go
@@ -0,0 +1,245 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func commitAll(root, subject string) (string, error) {
+	if _, e := git(root, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e := git(root, "commit", "-m", subject); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	return git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+}
+func updateHeld(root string, c project.Change, cl claim, oid, raw, phase string, release bool) (model.State, error) {
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	doc.Frontmatter["phase"] = phase
+	next, e := contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if e = write(root, c.Path, next); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	newHead, e := commitAll(root, "fireweed: "+c.Slug+" "+cl.Phase+" -> "+phase)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	cl.Phase = phase
+	cl.Base = newHead
+	cl.Approved = next
+	if release {
+		if e := Release(root, c.Slug); e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		s := model.State{Change: c, Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Run: cl.Run, Phase: phase, Head: newHead, PhaseBase: newHead}
+		return s, nil
+	}
+	newOID, e := saveClaim(root, c, cl, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	return state(root, c, cl, newOID)
+}
+func Done(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	req.Quick=false
+	r, e := verify(ctx, req)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	root, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	c, cl, oid, e := held(root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	raw, e := read(root, c.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	raw = appendProvenance(raw, provenance(req, cl.Phase, r.Reports))
+	switch cl.Phase {
+	case "evals":
+		next := "audit"
+		if !cfgBool(cl.Snapshot, "audit.enabled", true) {
+			next = "impl"
+		}
+		r.State, e = updateHeld(root, c, cl, oid, raw, next, false)
+		return r, e
+	case "audit":
+		normalized, findings, e := auditSubmission(raw, c, cl.Snapshot, cl.Approved)
+		if e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		raw = contracts.ReplaceSection(raw, "Audit", normalized)
+		if findings {
+			round := fmInt(c.Document.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds")
+			blocked := strings.Contains(normalized, "[untestable]") || round >= cfgInt(cl.Snapshot, "audit.max_rounds", 2)
+			if blocked {
+				doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+				if e != nil {
+					return r, e
+				}
+				doc.Frontmatter["blocked"] = "audit findings"
+				raw, e = contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+				if e != nil {
+					return r, e
+				}
+				raw = contracts.ReplaceSection(raw, "Questions", normalized)
+				r.State, e = updateHeld(root, c, cl, oid, raw, "audit", true)
+				if e != nil {
+					return r, e
+				}
+				return r, problem("P06", "change blocked")
+			}
+			doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+			if e != nil {
+				return r, e
+			}
+			doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"] = round + 1
+			raw, e = contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+			if e != nil {
+				return r, e
+			}
+			r.State, e = updateHeld(root, c, cl, oid, raw, "evals", false)
+			return r, e
+		}
+		r.State, e = updateHeld(root, c, cl, oid, raw, "impl", false)
+		return r, e
+	case "impl":
+		if e = apply(root, c, cl, raw); e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		head, e := commitAll(root, "fireweed: apply "+c.Slug)
+		if e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		if e = releaseExact(root, c, oid); e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		r.State = model.State{Change: c, Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Run: cl.Run, Phase: "applied", Head: head, PhaseBase: head}
+		return r, nil
+	}
+	return r, problem("P01", "unsupported phase %s", cl.Phase)
+}
+func releaseExact(root string, c project.Change, oid string) error {
+	return gitstoreCAS(root, claimName(c), oid, "")
+}
+func gitstoreCAS(root, name, old, next string) error { return gitstore.CASRef(root, name, old, next) }
+func apply(root string, c project.Change, cl claim, raw string) error {
+	m, ok := module(cl.Snapshot, c.Module)
+	if !ok {
+		return fmt.Errorf("module %s absent", c.Module)
+	}
+	path := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir, "SPEC.md"))
+	original, e := read(root, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(original)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	current, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc.Body, "Specs"))
+	remove := map[string]bool{}
+	replace := map[string]contracts.Item{}
+	for _, it := range c.Removed {
+		remove[it.ID] = true
+	}
+	for _, it := range c.Modified {
+		replace[it.ID] = it
+	}
+	items := []contracts.Item{}
+	for _, it := range current {
+		if remove[it.ID] {
+			continue
+		}
+		if n, ok := replace[it.ID]; ok {
+			items = append(items, n)
+		} else {
+			items = append(items, it)
+		}
+	}
+	items = append(items, c.Added...)
+	rendered := []string{}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		rendered = append(rendered, strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Specs", "\n"+strings.Join(rendered, "\n\n")+"\n")
+	if set := asMap(c.Document.Frontmatter["set"]); len(set) > 0 {
+		for k, v := range set {
+			doc.Frontmatter[k] = v
+		}
+	}
+	decisions := strings.TrimSpace(section(doc.Body, "Decisions"))
+	removed := strings.TrimSpace(section(c.Document.Body, "Removed decisions"))
+	if removed != "" {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(removed, "\n") {
+			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+			if line != "" {
+				decisions = strings.ReplaceAll(decisions, line, "")
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	added := strings.TrimSpace(section(c.Document.Body, "Decisions"))
+	if added != "" {
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(added, "\n") {
+			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+			if line != "" {
+				decisions += "\n- " + c.Slug + ": " + line
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Decisions", strings.TrimSpace(decisions)+"\n")
+	next, e := contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = write(root, path, next); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	archive := "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(c.Path)
+	archiveDoc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(raw)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	archiveDoc.Frontmatter["phase"] = "applied"
+	archived, e := contracts.RenderDocument(archiveDoc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = write(root, archive, archived); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, c.Path)); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	for _, d := range project.Check(root) {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, archive))
+			_ = write(root, c.Path, cl.Approved)
+			_ = write(root, path, original)
+			return problem(d.Code, "%s", d.Message)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+var _ = regexp.MustCompile
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/gc.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/gc.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a70fd0c84b4a933c948464fcd04b1b46d8a2e164
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/gc.go
@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func GC(_ context.Context, req model.GCRequest) (model.GCResult, error) {
+	root, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.GCResult{}, e
+	}
+	s, e := project.Load(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.GCResult{}, e
+	}
+	age := 720 * time.Hour
+	if v := setting(s, "gc.drill_max_age"); v != nil {
+		str := fmt.Sprint(v)
+		age, e = time.ParseDuration(str)
+		if e != nil || age <= 0 {
+			return model.GCResult{}, problem("C01", "invalid gc.drill_max_age %q", str)
+		}
+	}
+	now := req.Now
+	if now.IsZero() {
+		now = time.Now().UTC()
+	}
+	registered := map[string]bool{}
+	list, _ := git(root, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(list, "\n") {
+		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "worktree ") {
+			p, _ := canonical(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "worktree "))
+			registered[p] = true
+		}
+	}
+	refs, _ := git(root, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname)", "refs/fireweed")
+	result := model.GCResult{Pruned: []string{}}
+	for _, ref := range strings.Fields(refs) {
+		remove := false
+		switch {
+		case strings.HasPrefix(ref, "refs/fireweed/claims/"):
+			oid, ok, _ := gitstore.Ref(root, ref)
+			if ok {
+				b, re := gitstore.ReadBlob(root, oid)
+				if re == nil {
+					var entry struct {
+						Worktree string `json:"worktree"`
+					}
+					_ = json.Unmarshal(b, &entry)
+					p, _ := canonical(entry.Worktree)
+					if _, se := os.Stat(p); se != nil || !registered[p] {
+						remove = true
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		case strings.HasPrefix(ref, "refs/fireweed/attempts/"):
+			parts := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(ref, "refs/fireweed/attempts/"), "/")
+			if len(parts) == 2 {
+				if n, _ := strconv.Atoi(parts[1]); n > 0 {
+					matches, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root, "changes/archive/*-"+parts[0]+".md"))
+					remove = len(matches) > 0
+				}
+			}
+		case strings.HasPrefix(ref, "refs/fireweed/drills/"):
+			parts := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(ref, "refs/fireweed/drills/"), "/")
+			if len(parts) == 2 {
+				date, se := time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000", parts[1])
+				if se == nil && date.Before(now.Add(-age)) {
+					remove = true
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if remove {
+			oid, ok, _ := gitstore.Ref(root, ref)
+			if ok && gitstore.CASRef(root, ref, oid, "") == nil {
+				result.Pruned = append(result.Pruned, ref)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(result.Pruned)
+	return result, nil
+}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/history.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/history.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..ae5fba0ee74e16db4cf618f4980c12458aa32eb0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/history.go
@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+)
+
+func selectedPath(root, selector string) (string, error) {
+	paths := strings.Fields(mustGit(root,"ls-tree","-r","--name-only","HEAD","changes"))
+	found := []string{}
+	valid := []string{}
+	for _, p := range paths {
+		if !strings.HasSuffix(p,".md") || !(strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/archive/") || strings.Count(p,"/")==1) { continue }
+		base := filepath.Base(p)
+		slug := strings.TrimSuffix(base, ".md")
+		if i := strings.IndexByte(slug, '-'); i >= 0 {
+			slug = slug[i+1:]
+		}
+		valid = append(valid, slug)
+		if selector == p || selector == base || selector == slug || selector == strings.TrimSuffix(base, ".md") {
+			found = append(found, p)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(found) == 1 {
+		return found[0], nil
+	}
+	if len(found) > 1 {
+		return "", problem("U02", "change %q ambiguous; valid slugs: %s", selector, strings.Join(valid, ", "))
+	}
+	return "", problem("U02", "change %q not found; valid slugs: %s", selector, strings.Join(valid, ", "))
+}
+func phaseAt(root, revision, path string) string {
+	b, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, revision, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return ""
+	}
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
+	if e != nil {
+		return ""
+	}
+	return fmString(d.Frontmatter, "phase")
+}
+func Commits(root, selector string) ([]string, error) {
+	root, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	path, e := selectedPath(root, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	base := filepath.Base(path)
+	pending, archived := "changes/"+base, "changes/archive/"+base
+	list, e := git(root, "rev-list", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []string{}
+	for _, oid := range strings.Fields(list) {
+		parents, _ := git(root, "rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", oid)
+		fields := strings.Fields(parents)
+		if len(fields) < 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		parent := fields[1]
+		current := phaseAt(root, oid, pending)
+		if current == "" {
+			current = phaseAt(root, oid, archived)
+		}
+		prior := phaseAt(root, parent, pending)
+		if prior == "" {
+			prior = phaseAt(root, parent, archived)
+		}
+		if current != "" && current != prior {
+			out = append(out, oid)
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func Abandon(root, selector string) (string, error) {
+	root, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if e = clean(root); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	path, e := selectedPath(root, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/archive/") {
+		return "", problem("P01", "cannot abandon applied change")
+	}
+	c, e := queued(root, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	cl, oid, ok, e := loadClaim(root, c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if ok && cl.Worktree != root {
+		return "", problem("P02", "claim belongs to another worktree")
+	}
+	commits, e := Commits(root, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	for _, id := range commits {
+		out, re := git(root, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", id)
+		if re != nil {
+			return "", re
+		}
+		for _, file := range strings.Fields(out) {
+			if file == path {
+				continue
+			}
+			before, re := gitBytes(root, "show", id+"^:"+file)
+			if re == nil {
+				if re = write(root, file, string(before)); re != nil {
+					return "", re
+				}
+			} else {
+				_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, file))
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if e = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, path)); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	newHead, e := commitAll(root, "fireweed: abandon "+c.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if ok {
+		if e = gitstore.CASRef(root, claimName(c), oid, ""); e != nil {
+			return "", e
+		}
+	}
+	return newHead, nil
+}
+
+var _ = fmt.Sprint
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/pr.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/pr.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..300cd5dd4e10a77569b63e7b0f6acdf4df426d62
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/pr.go
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"fmt"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+type endpointConfigError struct{ cause error }
+
+func (e endpointConfigError) Error() string { return e.cause.Error() }
+func (e endpointConfigError) Unwrap() error { return e.cause }
+func IsEndpointConfigError(e error) bool    { _, ok := e.(endpointConfigError); return ok }
+func PRBody(root, revisionRange string) (model.PRBodyReport, error) {
+	parts := strings.Split(revisionRange, "..")
+	if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] == "" {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, problem("P01", "invalid range %q", revisionRange)
+	}
+	begin, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[0]+"^{commit}")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, problem("P01", "resolve %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
+	}
+	end, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[1]+"^{commit}")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, problem("P01", "resolve %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
+	}
+	snapshot, e := project.LoadAt(root, end)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.PRBodyReport{}, endpointConfigError{e}
+	}
+	r := model.PRBodyReport{}
+	var b strings.Builder
+	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# Pull request\n\nRange: %s..%s\n\n", begin, end)
+	changed, _ := git(root, "diff", "--name-only", begin, end)
+	names := strings.Fields(changed)
+	selected := []string{}
+	for _, name := range names {
+		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "changes/") && strings.HasSuffix(name, ".md") {
+			base := filepath.Base(name)
+			for _, candidate := range []string{"changes/" + base, "changes/archive/" + base} {
+				if _, re := gitstore.ReadAt(root, end, candidate); re == nil {
+					present := false
+					for _, x := range selected {
+						if x == candidate {
+							present = true
+						}
+					}
+					if !present {
+						selected = append(selected, candidate)
+					}
+					break
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(selected)
+	if len(selected) == 0 {
+		b.WriteString("No selected changes.\n")
+	}
+	for _, path := range selected {
+		raw, _ := gitstore.ReadAt(root, end, path)
+		d, _ := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+		name := filepath.Base(path)
+		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n## %s\n\nPath: %s\nModule: %s\n", name, path, fmString(d.Frontmatter, "module"))
+		kind := "spec"
+		if len(asStrings(d.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+			kind = "eval_fix"
+		} else if fmBool(d.Frontmatter, "regenerate") {
+			kind = "regenerate"
+		}
+		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Kind: %s\nAudit rounds: %d\n", kind, fmInt(d.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds"))
+		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n%s\n%s\n%s\n", section(string(raw), "Provenance"), section(string(raw), "Decisions"), section(string(raw), "Removed decisions"))
+		for _, which := range []string{"Added", "Modified"} {
+			items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(string(raw), which))
+			for _, it := range items {
+				if strings.Contains(it.Tag, "review") {
+					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%s %s: %s\n", which, it.ID, strings.TrimSpace(it.Body))
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		all, _ := git(root, "rev-list", end)
+		for _, oid := range strings.Fields(all) {
+			v, re := gitstore.ReadAt(root, oid, path)
+			if re != nil && strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/archive/") {
+				v, re = gitstore.ReadAt(root, oid, "changes/"+filepath.Base(path))
+			}
+			if re != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			audit := section(string(v), "Audit")
+			if strings.Contains(audit, "finding") || strings.Contains(audit, "FINDING") {
+				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Prior audit: %s\n", audit)
+			}
+		}
+		phaseCommits, _ := Commits(root, name)
+		for _, oid := range phaseCommits {
+			files, _ := git(root, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", oid)
+			for _, p := range strings.Fields(files) {
+				if p != path {
+					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%s: %s\n", fileCategory(snapshot,p), p)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	b.WriteString("\n## Endpoint exceptions\n")
+	for _, m := range snapshot.Modules {
+		if reason := fmString(m.Document.Frontmatter, "boundaries_opt_out"); reason != "" {
+			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Boundary opt-out: %s %s\n", m.Name, reason)
+		}
+		specs, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs"))
+		for _, it := range specs {
+			if strings.Contains(it.Tag, "quarantine") {
+				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Quarantine: %s %s %s\n", m.Name, it.ID, it.Tag)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, path := range strings.Fields(mustGit(root, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", end, "changes")) {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/") || strings.Contains(path, "/archive/") || !strings.HasSuffix(path, ".md") {
+			continue
+		}
+		raw, re := gitstore.ReadAt(root, end, path)
+		if re != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		d, re := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+		if re == nil && fmString(d.Frontmatter, "blocked") != "" {
+			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Blocked: %s %s\n", path, fmString(d.Frontmatter, "blocked"))
+		}
+	}
+	b.WriteString("\n## Cost\n\n| Module | Seconds | Cases per spec | Eval lines | Disposable lines |\n| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: |\n")
+	costs, _ := Costs(root)
+	latest := map[string]model.ModuleCost{}
+	saved := map[string][]project.Diagnostic{}
+	for _, snapshot := range costs {
+		for _, cost := range snapshot.Modules {
+			latest[cost.Module] = cost
+			saved[cost.Module] = snapshot.Diagnostics
+		}
+	}
+	for _, m := range snapshot.Modules {
+		cost, ok := latest[m.Name]
+		if !ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		ids := []string{}
+		for id := range cost.CasesPerSpec {
+			ids = append(ids, id)
+		}
+		sort.Strings(ids)
+		counts := []string{}
+		for _, id := range ids {
+			counts = append(counts, fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d", id, cost.CasesPerSpec[id]))
+		}
+		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "| %s | %g | %s | %d | %d |\n", m.Name, cost.Seconds, strings.Join(counts, ", "), cost.EvalLines, cost.DisposableLines)
+		for _, d := range saved[m.Name] {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(d.Code, "B0") {
+				present := false
+				for _, v := range r.Diagnostics {
+					if v == d {
+						present = true
+					}
+				}
+				if !present {
+					r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, d)
+					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%s: %s\n", d.Code, d.Message)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, p := range names {
+		disposable := false
+		for _, m := range snapshot.Modules {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/") && contracts.ResolveZone(strings.TrimPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/"), m.Zones) == "disposable" {
+				disposable = true
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if !disposable {
+			continue
+		}
+		if _, re := gitstore.ReadAt(root, begin, p); re == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		data, re := gitstore.ReadAt(root, end, p)
+		if re != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		if bytes.IndexByte(data, 0) >= 0 || len(data) > 262144 {
+			d := diag("B04", fmt.Sprintf("%s %d bytes", p, len(data)), true)
+			r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, d)
+			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "B04: %s\n", d.Message)
+		}
+	}
+	r.Body = b.String()
+	return r, nil
+}
+func mustGit(root string, args ...string) string { s, _ := git(root, args...); return s }
+func fileCategory(s project.Snapshot,path string)string{for _,w:=range asStrings(s.Config["worker_writable"]){if contracts.MatchGlob(w,path){return "Worker writable"}};for _,m:=range s.Modules{if !strings.HasPrefix(path,m.Dir+"/"){continue};rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,m.Dir+"/");if rel=="go.mod"||rel=="go.sum"{return "Module manifest"};switch contracts.ResolveZone(rel,m.Zones){case "interface":return "Interface edit";case "evals":return "Eval edit";case "preserve":return "Preserved edit";case "disposable":return "Disposable edit"};return "Module other edit"};return "Other edit"}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/queue.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/queue.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..421dd1151d81720d97e87bbe1e377c3fea97ac5c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/queue.go
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func depends(modules []project.Module, from, to string) bool {
+	visited := map[string]bool{}
+	var walk func(string) bool
+	walk = func(name string) bool {
+		if visited[name] {
+			return false
+		}
+		visited[name] = true
+		for _, m := range modules {
+			if m.Name == name {
+				for _, d := range m.DependsOn {
+					if d == to || walk(d) {
+						return true
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		return false
+	}
+	return walk(from)
+}
+func waitingFor(q []project.Change, index int, modules []project.Module) (string, string) {
+	c := q[index]
+	if fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter, "blocked") != "" {
+		return "", ""
+	}
+	for j := 0; j < index; j++ {
+		b := q[j]
+		if fmString(b.Document.Frontmatter, "blocked") == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if b.Module == c.Module {
+			return b.Slug, "same_module"
+		}
+		if depends(modules, c.Module, b.Module) {
+			return b.Slug, "depends_on_blocked"
+		}
+		if strings.TrimSpace(section(c.Document.Body, "Interface")) != "" && depends(modules, b.Module, c.Module) {
+			return b.Slug, "interface_dependency"
+		}
+	}
+	return "", ""
+}
+func Eligible(root string) ([]project.Change, error) {
+	q, e := project.Queue(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []project.Change{}
+	for i, c := range q {
+		if fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter, "blocked") != "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		s, e := project.Project(root, c.Slug)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		on, _ := waitingFor(q, i, s.Modules)
+		if on == "" {
+			out = append(out, c)
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func Status(root string) (model.StatusReport, error) {
+	s, e := project.Load(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.StatusReport{}, e
+	}
+	q, e := project.Queue(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.StatusReport{}, e
+	}
+	r := model.StatusReport{Modules: s.Modules, Queue: []model.StatusEntry{}, DriftSinceDrill: map[string]int{}, PhaseCommits: map[string]int{}, Costs: []model.ModuleCost{}}
+	for i, c := range q {
+		p, e := project.Project(root, c.Slug)
+		if e != nil {
+			return r, e
+		}
+		on, rule := waitingFor(q, i, p.Modules)
+		phase := fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter, "phase")
+		if phase == "" {
+			phase = "queued"
+		}
+		r.Queue = append(r.Queue, model.StatusEntry{Slug: c.Slug, Path: c.Path, Module: c.Module, Phase: phase, Blocked: fmString(c.Document.Frontmatter, "blocked"), WaitingOn: on, WaitingRule: rule, AuditRounds: fmInt(c.Document.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds")})
+	}
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		r.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name] = 0
+		items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs"))
+		for _, item := range items {
+			if match := regexp.MustCompile(`quarantine:\s*(.*)`).FindStringSubmatch(item.Tag); len(match) == 2 {
+				r.Quarantines = append(r.Quarantines, model.Quarantine{Module: m.Name, ID: item.ID, Reason: strings.TrimSpace(match[1])})
+			}
+		}
+		if reason := fmString(m.Document.Frontmatter, "boundaries_opt_out"); reason != "" {
+			r.BoundaryOptOuts = append(r.BoundaryOptOuts, model.BoundaryOptOut{Module: m.Name, Reason: reason})
+		}
+	}
+	archive := strings.Fields(mustGit(root, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "HEAD", "changes/archive"))
+	type applied struct { module, path string; date time.Time }
+	all := []applied{}
+	for _, path := range archive {
+		if !strings.HasSuffix(path,".md") { continue }
+		b,err:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,"HEAD",path);if err!=nil{continue}
+		d,err:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if err!=nil||fmString(d.Frontmatter,"phase")!="applied"{continue}
+		date:=time.Time{}
+		for _,line:=range strings.Split(section(string(b),"Provenance"),"\n") { f:=strings.Fields(line);if len(f)>=3&&f[0]=="-"&&f[1]=="impl"{if v,e:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,f[2]);e==nil { date=v } } }
+		all=append(all,applied{fmString(d.Frontmatter,"module"),path,date})
+		base:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path),".md")
+		commits,_:=Commits(root,path);r.PhaseCommits[base]=len(commits)
+	}
+	sort.Slice(all,func(i,j int)bool{if all[i].date.Equal(all[j].date){return all[i].path<all[j].path};return all[i].date.After(all[j].date)})
+	if len(all)>=3{first:=all[0].module;n:=0;for _,a:=range all{if a.module!=first{break};n++};if n>=3{r.Diagnostics=append(r.Diagnostics,diag("P08",fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d consecutive applied changes",first,n),true))}}
+	for _,m:=range s.Modules{date:=time.Time{};if b,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root,".fireweed/drills",m.Name+".md"));e==nil{if d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));e==nil{date,_=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,fmString(d.Frontmatter,"date"))}};for _,a:=range all{if a.module==m.Name&&a.date.After(date){r.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name]++}}}
+	baseRef,e:=gitstore.BaseRef(root,cfgString(s,"remote","origin"),cfgString(s,"base",""));if e==nil{for _,a:=range all{base:=filepath.Base(a.path);pending:="changes/"+base;if _,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,baseRef,a.path);e==nil{continue};if _,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,baseRef,pending);e==nil{continue};r.Unapproved++}}
+	snapshots, _ := Costs(root)

+	for _, c := range snapshots {

+			for _,d:=range latestDiagnostics[m.Name]{if !strings.HasPrefix(d.Code,"B0"){continue};found:=false;for _,existing:=range r.Diagnostics{if existing==d{found=true}};if !found{r.Diagnostics=append(r.Diagnostics,d)}}

+package lifecycle

+import (

+
+func removeDisposable(root string,s project.Snapshot,name string)error{m,ok:=module(s,name);if !ok{return nil};return filepath.Walk(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),func(path string,info os.FileInfo,e error)error{if e!=nil||info==nil||!info.Mode().IsRegular(){return nil};rel,re:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root,m.Dir),path);if re!=nil{return re};if contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel),m.Zones)=="disposable"{return os.Remove(path)};return nil})}
+func newerDrill(root,module string)bool{matches,_:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root,"changes/archive/*.md"));latest:=time.Time{};for _,path:=range matches{b,e:=os.ReadFile(path);if e!=nil{continue};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil||fmString(d.Frontmatter,"module")!=module||fmString(d.Frontmatter,"phase")!="applied"{continue};for _,line:=range strings.Split(section(string(b),"Provenance"),"\n"){fields:=strings.Fields(line);if len(fields)>=3&&fields[0]=="-"&&fields[1]=="impl"{if t,e:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,fields[2]);e==nil&&t.After(latest){latest=t}}}};b,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root,".fireweed/drills",module+".md"));if e!=nil{return false};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e!=nil||fmString(d.Frontmatter,"result")!="pass"{return false};date:=fmString(d.Frontmatter,"date");t,e:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,date);return e==nil&&t.After(latest)}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"reflect"
+	"regexp"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+var heading = regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^## ([^\n]+)\s*$`)
+
+func bodyParts(body string) map[string]string {
+	out := map[string]string{}
+	loc := heading.FindAllStringSubmatchIndex(body, -1)
+	for i, m := range loc {
+		end := len(body)
+		if i+1 < len(loc) {
+			end = loc[i+1][0]
+		}
+		out[strings.TrimSpace(body[m[2]:m[3]])] = strings.TrimSpace(body[m[1]:end])
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func approvedError(cl claim, current string) error {
+	old, e := contracts.ParseDocument(cl.Approved)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	now, e := contracts.ParseDocument(current)
+	if e != nil {
+		return problem("P03", "approved author metadata changed: %v", e)
+	}
+	if fmString(now.Frontmatter, "run") != cl.Run || fmString(now.Frontmatter, "phase") != cl.Phase {
+		return problem("P03", "approved run or phase changed")
+	}
+	if fmInt(now.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds") != fmInt(old.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds") || fmString(now.Frontmatter, "blocked") != fmString(old.Frontmatter, "blocked") {
+		return problem("P03", "approved audit state changed")
+	}
+	for _, m := range []map[string]any{old.Frontmatter, now.Frontmatter} {
+		delete(m, "run")
+		delete(m, "phase")
+		delete(m, "audit_rounds")
+		delete(m, "blocked")
+	}
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(old.Frontmatter, now.Frontmatter) {
+		return problem("P03", "approved author metadata changed")
+	}
+	a, b := bodyParts(old.Body), bodyParts(now.Body)
+	for _, name := range []string{"Motivation", "Interface", "Added", "Modified", "Removed", "Removed decisions"} {
+		if a[name] != b[name] {
+			return problem("P03", "approved author metadata changed")
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func module(s project.Snapshot, name string) (project.Module, bool) {
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		if m.Name == name {
+			return m, true
+		}
+	}
+	return project.Module{}, false
+}
+func moduleSpecs(s project.Snapshot, name string) []contracts.Item {
+	m, ok := module(s, name)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil
+	}
+	items, _ := contracts.ParseItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs"))
+	out := []contracts.Item{}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(it.Tag), "quarantine") {
+			out = append(out, it)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func validateHeld(root string, c project.Change, cl claim) error {
+	head, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if head != cl.Base {
+		return problem("P05", "phase base changed from %s to %s", cl.Base, head)
+	}
+	raw, e := read(root, c.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = approvedError(cl, raw); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return stale(root, c)
+}
+func checkZones(root string, c project.Change, cl claim) error {
+	changes, e := gitstore.Changes(root, cl.Base)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if len(asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+		for _, ch := range changes {
+			p := ch.Path
+			if p == "" {
+				p = ch.OldPath
+			}
+			if p == c.Path {
+				continue
+			}
+			m, ok := module(cl.Snapshot, c.Module)
+			if !ok {
+				return problem("Z01", "unknown module %s", c.Module)
+			}
+			zone := ""
+			if strings.HasPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/") {
+				zone = contracts.ResolveZone(strings.TrimPrefix(p, m.Dir+"/"), m.Zones)
+			}
+			if !(cl.Phase == "evals" && zone == "evals") {
+				return problem("Z01", "forbidden %s edit: %s", cl.Phase, p)
+			}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	ds := checks.Zones(checks.ZoneRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Module: c.Module, Phase: cl.Phase, ChangePath: c.Path, Base: cl.Base, InterfaceDeclared: strings.TrimSpace(section(c.Document.Body, "Interface")) != "", Changes: changes})
+	return errDiagnostic(ds)
+}
+func auditSubmission(raw string, c project.Change, s project.Snapshot, approved string) (string, bool, error) {
+	body := section(raw, "Audit")
+	lines := strings.Split(body, "\n")
+	findings := []string{}
+	checked := map[string]bool{}
+	no := false
+	for _, line := range lines {
+		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "Checked IDs:") {
+			for _, id := range strings.FieldsFunc(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "Checked IDs:"), func(r rune) bool { return r == ',' || r == ' ' || r == '\t' }) {
+				checked[id] = true
+			}
+		}
+		if strings.Contains(line, "No findings") {
+			no = true
+		}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "- ") {
+			findings = append(findings, line)
+		}
+	}
+	valid := []string{}
+	specs := map[string]string{}
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		for _, it := range moduleSpecs(s, m.Name) {
+			specs[it.ID] = it.Body
+		}
+	}
+	previous := section(approved, "Audit")
+	for _, line := range findings {
+		match := regexp.MustCompile(`(?:\[untestable\]\s*)?([A-Z]+-\d+):\s*"([^"]+)"`).FindStringSubmatch(line)
+		if len(match) != 3 || !strings.Contains(specs[match[1]], match[2]) {
+			continue
+		}
+		if fmInt(c.Document.Frontmatter, "audit_rounds") > 0 && !strings.Contains(previous, match[1]) {
+			continue
+		}
+		valid = append(valid, line)
+	}
+	if len(valid) > 0 {
+		return strings.Join(valid, "\n") + "\n", true, nil
+	}
+	if !no || len(checked) == 0 {
+		return "", false, problem("P09", "audit requires Checked IDs and No findings")
+	}
+	required := []string{}
+	for _, i := range append(c.Added, c.Modified...) {
+		required = append(required, i.ID)
+	}
+	required = append(required, asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["fixes"])...)
+	required = append(required, asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])...)
+	for _, id := range required {
+		if !checked[id] {
+			return "", false, problem("P09", "audit did not check %s", id)
+		}
+	}
+	ids := []string{}
+	for id := range checked {
+		ids = append(ids, id)
+	}
+	return "No findings; checked " + strings.Join(ids, ", ") + "\n", false, nil
+}
+func Verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) { return verify(ctx, req) }
+func surfaced(err error, ds []project.Diagnostic) error {
+	if err == nil { return nil }
+	code, _, ok := contracts.ErrorCode(err)
+	if !ok { for _, d := range ds { if !d.Warning { code=d.Code; break } } }
+	if code != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(),code+":") { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w",code,err) }
+	return err
+}
+func verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	root, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.Result{}, e
+	}
+	c, cl, oid, e := held(root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.Result{}, e
+	}
+	st, e := state(root, c, cl, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.Result{}, e
+	}
+	r := model.Result{State: st, Reports: map[string]checks.Report{}, Costs: []model.ModuleCost{}}
+	if cl.Phase != "evals" && cl.Phase != "audit" && cl.Phase != "impl" {
+		return r, problem("P01", "unsupported phase %s", cl.Phase)
+	}
+	if e = validateHeld(root, c, cl); e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	if e = checkZones(root, c, cl); e != nil {
+		return r, e
+	}
+	if cl.Phase == "audit" {
+		raw, _ := read(root, c.Path)
+		_, _, e = auditSubmission(raw, c, cl.Snapshot, cl.Approved)
+		return r, e
+	}
+	targets := []string{c.Module}
+	if cl.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
+		mode := cfgString(cl.Snapshot, "verify_dependents", "direct")
+		for _, m := range cl.Snapshot.Modules {
+			if m.Name == c.Module {
+				continue
+			}
+			direct := false
+			for _, dep := range m.DependsOn {
+				if dep == c.Module {
+					direct = true
+				}
+			}
+			if mode == "all" && depends(cl.Snapshot.Modules, m.Name, c.Module) || mode == "direct" && direct {
+				targets = append(targets, m.Name)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	var first error
+	for _, name := range targets {
+		specs := moduleSpecs(cl.Snapshot, name)
+		report, evalErr := checks.Evaluate(ctx, checks.HookRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Module: name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		r.Reports[name] = report
+		saveReport(root, cl.Run, cl.Phase, name, report)
+		if len(report.Cases) == 0 && evalErr != nil {
+			if first == nil {
+				first = evalErr
+			}
+			continue
+		}
+		if len(report.Cases) > 0 {
+			if ce := checks.RequireCoverage(report, specs); ce != nil && first == nil {
+				first = ce
+			}
+		}
+		if name == c.Module && cl.Phase == "evals" {
+			if len(asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+				if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && first == nil {
+					first = ce
+				}
+				for _, id := range asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"]) {
+					found := false
+					for _, cas := range report.Cases {
+						for _, x := range cas.IDs {
+							if x == id {
+								found = true
+							}
+						}
+					}
+					if !found && first == nil {
+						first = problem("C10", "no coverage for %s", id)
+					}
+				}
+			} else {
+				ids := []string{}
+				for _, it := range append(c.Added, c.Modified...) {
+					ids = append(ids, it.ID)
+				}
+				ids = append(ids, asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["fixes"])...)
+				if ce := checks.RequireFailFirst(report, ids, asStrings(c.Document.Frontmatter["already_satisfied"])); ce != nil && first == nil {
+					first = ce
+				}
+			}
+		} else {
+			if ce := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); ce != nil && first == nil {
+				first = ce
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	r.Costs = measureCosts(root, cl.Snapshot, r.Reports)
+	r.Diagnostics = budgetDiagnostics(cl.Snapshot, r.Costs)
+	saveCosts(root, cl, r.Costs, r.Diagnostics)
+	if cl.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
+		ds, be := checks.Boundaries(ctx, checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: cl.Snapshot, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, ds...)
+		if be != nil && first == nil {
+			first = be
+		}
+	}
+	return r, surfaced(first,r.Diagnostics)
+}
+func saveReport(root, run, phase, name string, report checks.Report) {
+	dir := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "runs", run, phase)
+	_ = os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755)
+	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
+	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".json"), b, 0644)
+	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".out"), []byte(report.Stdout+report.Stderr), 0644)
+}
+func provenance(req model.Request, phase string, reports map[string]checks.Report) string {
+	agent := req.Agent
+	if agent == "" {
+		agent = "manual"
+	}
+	playbook, _ := assets.Playbook(phase)
+	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(playbook))
+	total, passing, failing := 0, 0, 0
+	for _, r := range reports {
+		for _, c := range r.Cases {
+			total++
+			if c.Result == "pass" {
+				passing++
+			}
+			if c.Result == "fail" || c.Result == "error" {
+				failing++
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d", phase, time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), agent, assets.Version(), hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]), total, failing, passing)
+}
+func appendProvenance(raw, line string) string {
+	old := section(raw, "Provenance")
+	return contracts.ReplaceSection(raw, "Provenance", strings.TrimSpace(old)+"\n"+line+"\n")
+}
